zh.tag: 阿里内部验证的混合架构 AI 代码审查 CLI 工具
zh.what: Open Code Review 是阿里巴巴内部孵化并开源的 AI 代码审查命令行工具，采用确定性流水线加 LLM Agent 的混合架构。它能在代码行级别给出精确评论，并内置 NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入等多语言规则集。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 编写，提供 CLI 主程序、内置规则集与 Agent 集成配置，并附带官网、多语言 README 与 npm 包发布脚本。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，通过 npm 包 @alibaba-group/open-code-review 分发，兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 接口，并支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent。
zh.hot: 背靠阿里内部两年、数万开发者与数百万缺陷的实战验证，加上 22734 星、今日新增 264 星并登上 Go 日榜第 11 名，关注度持续攀升。
uses: 希望把 AI 代码审查接入 CI/CD 的工程团队
使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent 的开发者
需要 NPE、线程安全、SQL 注入等规则检查的 Go/多语言项目
想借鉴混合架构与规则集设计的 AI 工具开发者

en.tag: Alibaba's battle-tested hybrid-architecture AI code review CLI
en.what: Open Code Review is an open-sourced AI code review CLI incubated inside Alibaba, combining deterministic pipelines with an LLM Agent. It produces precise line-level comments and ships with a built-in multi-language ruleset covering NPE, thread-safety, XSS and SQL injection.
en.content: Written in Go, the repo contains the CLI, built-in rule sets and agent integration configs, plus a website, multilingual READMEs and npm publishing setup.
en.stack: Primary language is Go, distributed via the npm package @alibaba-group/open-code-review, compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and integrates with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
en.hot: Backed by two years of internal Alibaba use by tens of thousands of developers and millions of defects found, it has reached 22,734 stars with 264 added today, ranking 11th on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Engineering teams wanting AI code review in CI/CD
Developers using Claude Code, Codex or Cursor agents
Go and multi-language projects needing NPE, thread-safety and SQL injection checks
AI tool builders studying hybrid architecture and ruleset design

zh.tag: 将编码代理转变为多阶段安全审计员的技能
zh.what: 这是一个编码代理技能，通过侦察、覆盖导向狩猎、候选验证、结构化输出、独立记录验证和目标中立报告六个阶段，将代理转变为安全审计员。它编排隔离的代理进行漏洞发现，并生成机器可读的发现记录。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SKILL.md 主技能文件，以及针对不同阶段的提示文件如 RECONNAISSANCE.md、HUNTING.md、ATTACK-CLASSES.md，还有针对特定领域的 MEMORY-SAFETY-AND-BINARY.md、AI-AND-LLM.md、WEB-PROTOCOL-AND-AUTH.md、CLIENT-SIDE.md 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 运行验证脚本（如 validate-coverage-ledger.cjs 和 validate-findings.cjs），并遵循 JSON 模式进行结构化输出。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 1434 颗星，总星数达 5126，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 JavaScript 第 9 名。它源自 Cloudflare 的漏洞发现工具链，提供了可复用的安全审计技能，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 安全工程师和渗透测试人员 —— 利用代理自动化多阶段安全审计，提高漏洞发现效率。
AI 代理开发者 —— 集成此技能到编码代理中，增强其安全审计能力。
DevSecOps 团队 —— 在 CI/CD 流程中自动执行安全审计，生成结构化报告。
安全研究人员 —— 基于此技能构建自定义漏洞挖掘工具链。

en.tag: A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a multi-phase security auditor
en.what: This is a coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor by orchestrating isolated agents through six phases: reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting. It produces machine-readable findings with independently verified claims.
en.content: The repo contains SKILL.md as the main skill file, along with phase-specific prompt files like RECONNAISSANCE.md, HUNTING.md, ATTACK-CLASSES.md, and domain-specific files such as MEMORY-SAFETY-AND-BINARY.md, AI-AND-LLM.md, WEB-PROTOCOL-AND-AUTH.md, and CLIENT-SIDE.md.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, it relies on Node.js for validation scripts (e.g., validate-coverage-ledger.cjs and validate-findings.cjs) and uses JSON schemas for structured output.
en.hot: It gained 1,434 stars today, reaching 5,126 total, and ranked 9th on GitHub Trending (JavaScript). It originated from Cloudflare's vulnerability discovery harness, offering a reusable security audit skill that has attracted significant attention.
uses: Security engineers and penetration testers — automate multi-phase security audits with agents to improve vulnerability discovery efficiency.
AI agent developers — integrate this skill into coding agents to enhance their security auditing capabilities.
DevSecOps teams — automate security audits in CI/CD pipelines and generate structured reports.
Security researchers — build custom vulnerability hunting harnesses based on this skill.

zh.tag: 纯 C 零依赖引擎，把 744B~2.8T MoE 大模型跑在消费级硬件上
zh.what: Colibrì 是一个纯 C 编写、零引擎依赖的 MoE 推理引擎，把显存、内存和磁盘当作统一的多级推理层级，让 744B 到 2.8T 参数的前沿 MoE 模型能在消费级与异构硬件上运行。它同时是开放研究平台，追求推理侧软硬件边界的性能优化，并承诺绝不悄悄改变模型精度或路由语义。
zh.content: 仓库包含每个模型家族一个 C 文件的实现（GLM-5.x、Kimi K3、DeepSeek V4.x、Qwen3.x、OLMoE 等九大家族），统一的 coli chat / coli serve / coli web 前端，以及带实时指标、专家分层和“大脑”可视化的 Web 仪表盘。
zh.stack: 纯 C 实现，零引擎依赖，专家权重从磁盘流式加载；支持 int4 量化，可在 CPU 与多卡 GPU（如 6× RTX 5090）混合环境中运行。
zh.hot: 它以“小引擎跑超大模型”的极简路线直击显存焦虑，29840 颗星、今日 +868 登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜第一，说明本地跑前沿大模型的需求极其旺盛。
uses: 想在本地或自有硬件上跑 744B+ MoE 大模型的个人与实验室研究者
关注推理引擎、内存分层、存储 I/O 与 CPU/GPU 重叠等系统优化的工程师
需要在消费级 GPU 或异构集群上低成本部署大模型的团队
对量化、专家流式加载与投机解码等前沿推理技术感兴趣的学习者

en.tag: Pure C, zero-dep engine running 744B–2.8T MoE models on consumer hardware
en.what: Colibrì is a pure-C, zero-dependency MoE inference engine that treats VRAM, RAM and storage as one multitier hierarchy, letting frontier 744B–2.8T-parameter MoE models run on consumer and heterogeneous hardware. It doubles as an open research platform for inference-side performance across the software/hardware boundary, with a hard guarantee that it never silently changes model precision or router semantics.
en.content: It ships one C file per model family (GLM-5.x, Kimi K3, DeepSeek V4.x, Qwen3.x, OLMoE and more — nine families), a unified coli chat / coli serve / coli web front end, and a web dashboard with live metrics, expert tiers and a 'brain' visualization.
en.stack: Written in pure C with zero engine dependencies, streaming experts from disk; supports int4 quantization and runs across CPU plus multi-GPU setups such as 6× RTX 5090.
en.hot: Its 'tiny engine, immense model' approach directly addresses VRAM anxiety; with 29,840 stars and +868 today it tops GitHub Trending, showing huge demand for running frontier models locally.
uses: Individuals and labs wanting to run 744B+ MoE models on hardware they already own
Engineers working on inference engines, memory tiering, storage I/O and CPU/GPU overlap
Teams needing low-cost deployment of large models on consumer GPUs or heterogeneous clusters
Learners curious about quantization, expert streaming and speculative decoding

zh.tag: 原生 macOS 启动器：热键、剪贴板历史，内存不到 100MB
zh.what: Tinycast 是一款完全原生的 macOS 启动器，用一个全局热键呼出命令面板，快速启动应用、搜索文件、查看剪贴板历史。它还内置计算器、快捷链接、Snippets 和 Apple 快捷指令，并能运行真实的 Raycast 扩展。
zh.content: 仓库为 Swift 编写的 macOS 应用源码，包含 SwiftUI/AppKit 界面、启动器与热键逻辑、剪贴板历史、Spotlight 文件搜索、计算器、Quicklinks、Snippets 等模块，并附有截图与文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Swift 6.0 与 SwiftUI/AppKit 构建，零第三方依赖，无 Electron、无遥测，要求 macOS 26 及以上，采用 AGPL-3.0 许可。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1179 星、总星 5595，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4。它切中了用户对轻量、原生、无 Electron 的 macOS 启动器的需求，还兼容 Raycast 扩展。
uses: macOS 用户想用轻量原生启动器替代 Raycast/Alfred
注重隐私、不希望有遥测或 Electron 开销的开发者
需要剪贴板历史、快捷链接和 Snippets 的效率工具爱好者
想用 Swift 学习原生 macOS 应用开发的开发者

en.tag: A tiny native macOS launcher with hotkeys and clipboard history under 100 MB RAM
en.what: Tinycast is a fully native macOS launcher that summons a command palette with one global hotkey to launch apps, search files, and browse clipboard history. It also packs a calculator, quicklinks, snippets, Apple Shortcuts, and can run real Raycast extensions.
en.content: The repo contains the Swift source of a macOS app, including SwiftUI/AppKit UI, launcher and hotkey logic, clipboard history, Spotlight file search, calculator, Quicklinks, and Snippets modules, plus screenshots and docs.
en.stack: Built with Swift 6.0 and SwiftUI/AppKit, zero third-party dependencies, no Electron and no telemetry, requires macOS 26+, licensed under AGPL-3.0.
en.hot: It gained 1,179 stars today (5,595 total) and hit #4 on GitHub Trending daily. It taps demand for a lightweight, native, Electron-free macOS launcher that also runs Raycast extensions.
uses: macOS users seeking a lightweight native launcher to replace Raycast/Alfred
Developers who care about privacy and avoiding telemetry or Electron overhead
Power users wanting clipboard history, quicklinks, and snippets
Developers learning native macOS app development with Swift

zh.tag: 本地优先的开源 AI 语音工作室：克隆、合成、听写
zh.what: Voicebox 是一个本地运行的 AI 语音工作室，可替代 ElevenLabs 与 WisprFlow。它支持用几秒音频克隆音色、在 7 个 TTS 引擎和 23 种语言中生成语音，并通过全局快捷键向任意输入框听写。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用本体、landing 官网与 docs 文档站，并附带应用截图与图标资源，同时提供 API 与 MCP 集成说明。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，采用本地优先架构，内置本地 LLM 用于文本润色与角色人格，并打包多个 TTS 引擎。
zh.hot: 以 54,383 星、单日新增 417 星冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5，靠的是把语音输入与输出两条链路合并进一个免费本地应用。
uses: 内容创作者：用几秒样本克隆音色，为视频和播客批量生成多语言配音
开发者与 AI 工程师：通过 API 或 MCP 为智能体接入自有音色
注重隐私的用户：模型、语音数据与录音全部留在本机，不上传云端
效率办公人群：用全局快捷键在任意应用中语音听写代替打字

en.tag: The local-first open-source AI voice studio: clone, generate, dictate
en.what: Voicebox is a local-first AI voice studio positioned as a free, open-source alternative to ElevenLabs and WisprFlow. It clones voices from a few seconds of audio, generates speech across 7 TTS engines and 23 languages, and dictates into any text field via a global hotkey.
en.content: The repo ships the desktop app itself plus a landing site and a docs site, along with app screenshots and icon assets, and documents an API and MCP integration.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript with a local-first architecture, it bundles a local LLM for refinement and per-profile personas alongside multiple TTS engines.
en.hot: With 54,383 stars and 417 gained today, it hit #5 on GitHub Trending by merging both halves of the voice I/O loop into one free local app.
uses: Content creators: clone a voice from a few seconds and batch-generate multilingual voiceovers for video and podcasts
Developers and AI engineers: wire custom voices into agents via the API or MCP
Privacy-conscious users: models, voice data and captures all stay on the local machine
Productivity users: dictate into any app with a global hotkey instead of typing

zh.tag: 在 Mac 上虚拟运行 iPhone 的命令行工具
zh.what: vphone-cli 利用 Apple 的 Virtualization.framework 和 PCC 研究虚拟机基础设施，在 macOS 上启动虚拟 iPhone。它自动化了从下载固件、修补引导链到 DFU 恢复和首次启动的完整流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含命令行工具 vphone-cli、用于管理虚拟机的子命令（vm、fw、restore、cfw 等），以及构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Swift 编写，依赖 Python、aria2、wget、openssl、libusb 等工具，通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 周榜排名第 8，本周新增近 2000 star，总 star 过万，因其能在 Mac 上虚拟运行 iPhone 的突破性能力而备受关注。
uses: iOS 开发者和安全研究人员，希望在 Mac 上快速启动虚拟 iPhone 进行测试。
对 iOS 内部机制感兴趣的技术爱好者，想探索 PCC 研究虚拟机基础设施。
需要多设备测试环境的人员，可通过克隆快速创建多个虚拟 iPhone。

en.tag: CLI tool to boot a virtual iPhone on Apple Silicon Macs
en.what: vphone-cli leverages Apple's Virtualization.framework and PCC research VM infrastructure to boot a virtual iPhone on macOS. It automates the entire pipeline from firmware download, boot chain patching, DFU restore, to first boot.
en.content: The repository includes the vphone-cli command-line tool, subcommands for VM management (vm, fw, restore, cfw, etc.), build scripts, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Swift, with dependencies on Python, aria2, wget, openssl, libusb, etc., installed via Homebrew.
en.hot: Ranked #8 on GitHub Trending this week with ~2000 new stars, surpassing 10k total, it gains attention for its groundbreaking ability to run a virtual iPhone on a Mac.
uses: iOS developers and security researchers who want to spin up virtual iPhones on a Mac for testing.
Tech enthusiasts interested in iOS internals, exploring PCC research VM infrastructure.
Those needing multiple test devices, can quickly clone virtual iPhones for parallel testing.

zh.tag: 面向知识工作者的 Claude 插件集，按职能定制 AI 工作流
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 开源的一套 Claude 插件，旨在将 Claude 转变为特定角色、团队和公司的专家。每个插件捆绑了技能、连接器、斜杠命令和子代理，覆盖销售、产品、营销、法律等 11 种职能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 11 个职能插件目录（如 productivity、sales、customer-support 等），每个目录内有技能定义、连接器配置、斜杠命令和子代理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，依赖 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 平台，并集成 Slack、Notion、Jira 等第三方连接器。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 110 星，总星数达 24287，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 7 名，反映出知识工作者对 AI 提效工具的强烈需求。
uses: 知识工作者：通过插件快速获得角色专属的 AI 助手，提升日常工作效率。
团队负责人：定制插件以统一团队工作流程和术语，确保输出一致性。
企业开发者：基于开源插件进行二次开发，集成内部工具和数据源。
Claude 用户：利用现成插件扩展 Claude 功能，无需从零构建。

en.tag: Claude plugins for knowledge workers, customizing AI workflows by job function
en.what: Anthropic open-sources a set of Claude plugins designed to turn Claude into a specialist for your role, team, and company. Each plugin bundles skills, connectors, slash commands, and sub-agents for specific job functions like sales, product, marketing, legal, and more.
en.content: The repo contains 11 job-function plugin directories (e.g., productivity, sales, customer-support), each with skill definitions, connector configurations, slash commands, and sub-agents.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, it relies on Claude Cowork and Claude Code platforms, and integrates third-party connectors like Slack, Notion, and Jira.
en.hot: With 110 stars added today and a total of 24,287 stars, it ranks 7th on GitHub Trending daily, reflecting strong demand for AI productivity tools among knowledge workers.
uses: Knowledge workers: get role-specific AI assistance to boost daily productivity.
Team leads: customize plugins to unify workflows and terminology for consistent output.
Enterprise developers: extend open-source plugins to integrate internal tools and data.
Claude users: leverage ready-made plugins to expand Claude's capabilities without building from scratch.

zh.tag: 开源企业级业务管理平台，集 ERP、CRM、HRM、ATS 与项目管理于一体
zh.what: Ever Gauzy 是一个面向协作、按需和共享经济的开源业务管理平台，提供企业资源规划（ERP）、客户关系管理（CRM）、人力资源管理（HRM）、招聘跟踪（ATS）以及工作与项目管理（PM）等核心功能。它旨在帮助企业在一个统一的系统中管理财务、销售、库存、员工和项目等关键业务流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台源代码，主要使用 TypeScript 编写，提供无头 API、仪表盘、时间跟踪、员工管理、招聘、销售管道、会计发票等模块。还包括详细的文档和部署指南，支持 Gitpod 在线开发。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 TypeScript 为主，基于 Node.js 和 NestJS 构建后端，前端可能使用 Angular 或 React，数据库支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL 等，并采用 AGPL v3 许可证。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 191 颗星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 2 名，总星数达 5084，表明其作为开源 ERP/CRM 替代方案正受到广泛关注。
uses: 中小企业寻求开源 ERP/CRM 解决方案以降低软件成本
开发团队需要可定制、可扩展的业务管理平台进行二次开发
人力资源和招聘团队希望集成 ATS 和员工管理功能
项目管理和咨询公司需要时间跟踪与项目协作工具

en.tag: Open business management platform combining ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS and project management
en.what: Ever Gauzy is an open business management platform for collaborative, on-demand and sharing economies, offering Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Human Resource Management (HRM), Applicant Tracking System (ATS), and Work and Project Management (PM). It aims to help businesses manage key processes like finance, sales, inventory, employees, and projects in one unified system.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform source code, primarily written in TypeScript, offering headless APIs, dashboards, time tracking, employee management, ATS, sales pipelines, accounting/invoicing modules, and more. It also includes detailed documentation and deployment guides, with Gitpod support for online development.
en.stack: The tech stack is primarily TypeScript, with a Node.js and NestJS backend, possibly Angular or React frontend, and support for databases like PostgreSQL and MySQL, under the AGPL v3 license.
en.hot: The project gained 191 stars today, ranking 2nd on GitHub Trending daily list, with a total of 5,084 stars, indicating growing attention as an open-source ERP/CRM alternative.
uses: Small and medium businesses seeking open-source ERP/CRM solutions to reduce software costs
Development teams needing a customizable and extensible business management platform for secondary development
HR and recruitment teams looking to integrate ATS and employee management features
Project management and consulting firms requiring time tracking and project collaboration tools

zh.tag: 开源间隔重复记忆卡片软件，用算法帮你高效背东西
zh.what: Anki 是一款基于间隔重复算法的智能记忆卡片程序，通过科学安排复习时间帮助用户长期记住知识。它支持文字、图片、音频、视频等多种卡片形式，并提供跨平台同步。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Anki 桌面版的完整源代码，涵盖 Rust 核心逻辑、Python 后端、TypeScript/Svelte 前端界面，以及构建脚本、开发文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写核心算法，结合 Python 处理业务逻辑，前端采用 TypeScript 和 Svelte，构建系统基于 Bazel 和 Ninja。
zh.hot: Anki 是间隔重复领域的标杆项目，拥有超过 3 万 star，今日新增 58 star 并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 9 名，反映出持续高涨的学习工具需求。
uses: 学生和语言学习者，用于记忆单词、概念和考试知识点
专业人士备考各类认证考试，如医学、法律、工程等
教育工作者制作和分享教学卡片组
开发者研究间隔重复算法和跨平台桌面应用架构

en.tag: Open-source spaced repetition flashcard program for efficient memorization
en.what: Anki is a smart flashcard program based on spaced repetition algorithms, scheduling reviews to help users retain knowledge long-term. It supports text, images, audio, and video cards with cross-platform sync.
en.content: The repo contains the full source code for Anki's desktop version, including Rust core logic, Python backend, TypeScript/Svelte frontend, build scripts, dev docs, and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust for core algorithms, with Python for business logic, TypeScript and Svelte for the frontend, and a build system based on Bazel and Ninja.
en.hot: Anki is a benchmark project in spaced repetition with over 30k stars, gaining 58 stars today and ranking 9th on GitHub Trending daily, reflecting sustained demand for learning tools.
uses: Students and language learners memorizing vocabulary, concepts, and exam points
Professionals preparing for certification exams in medicine, law, engineering, etc.

en.tag: NSA's open-source, high-end software reverse engineering framework
en.what: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework created and maintained by the NSA Research Directorate, offering a full suite of high-end analysis tools including disassembly, assembly, decompilation, graphing, and scripting. It supports a wide range of processor instruction sets and executable formats, and runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux in both interactive and automated modes.
en.content: The repository holds the complete Ghidra source, organized into feature modules (such as Features/Base), along with build scripts, extension components, and documentation. Users can develop custom extensions and scripts in Java or Python.
en.stack: Primarily written in Java, it builds with JDK 25 and Gradle 9.1.0+, and requires Python3 (3.9–3.14) plus GCC/Clang and make on Linux/macOS.
en.hot: As a heavyweight reverse engineering tool open-sourced by the NSA, Ghidra has long been a top choice for security researchers, accumulating 76,710 stars with 725 added today, ranking 8th on GitHub's daily trending list.

CTF players and bug bounty hunters quickly decompiling and debugging binaries
Enterprise security teams batch-analyzing suspicious samples in automated mode
Developers and researchers extending custom analysis plugins in Java/Python

zh.tag: 终端里的智能体编程助手，用自然语言写代码

en.tag: Reusable computer vision toolkit with model-agnostic detection and annotation utilities
en.what: Supervision is Roboflow's open-source computer vision toolkit offering reusable building blocks from data loading and model output parsing to real-time zone counting and annotation visualization. Students and hobbyists learning CV engineering via tutorials and notebooks

AI tooling enthusiasts looking to plug Claude Code, Codex, and similar agents into research workflows

zh.tag: 开源版 Firebase：基于 Postgres 的一站式后端开发平台

en.tag: The open-source Firebase alternative built on Postgres
en.what: Supabase is a Postgres-centric development platform that recreates Firebase's capabilities using enterprise-grade open-source tools. AI app teams needing Postgres plus vector search
Startups and indie devs seeking an open-source Firebase replacement

zh.what: 这是一套面向 AI 编程代理的工程技能库，把资深工程师的工作流、质量门禁和最佳实践编码成可复用的技能。它覆盖从需求定义到上线的完整开发生命周期，让代理在每个阶段都遵循一致的标准。

zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，通过开放的 skills CLI（npx skills add）安装，可接入 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Copilot、Cline 等 70 多个代理。
zh.hot: 凭借 Addy Osmani 的影响力与 AI 编程代理热潮，项目已获 94,344 颗星，今日新增 354 星，位列 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 3 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理的开发者，希望代理遵循统一工程规范
团队想为 AI 辅助开发引入质量门禁与标准化工作流
个人开发者需要从需求到上线的结构化开发流程模板
对 AI 代理技能包设计感兴趣、想学习或二次开发的人

en.tag: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents
en.what: A collection of engineering skills that encode the workflows, quality gates, and best practices senior engineers use, packaged so AI coding agents follow them consistently. It spans the full development lifecycle from defining requirements to shipping to production.
en.content: The repo is organized as skill packages, offering 25 skills and 9 slash commands (e.g. /spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review, /ship), each automatically activating the relevant skills.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, installed via the open skills CLI (npx skills add) and compatible with 70+ agents including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, and Cline.
en.hot: Backed by Addy Osmani's reputation and the AI coding agent boom, it has reached 94,344 stars with 354 added today, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript) daily.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor who want consistent engineering standards
Teams looking to add quality gates and standardized workflows to AI-assisted development
Individual developers wanting a structured spec-to-ship development process
Anyone curious about designing AI agent skill packages or wanting to extend them

zh.tag: 开源自主编码代理，覆盖 IDE、终端与桌面
zh.what: Cline 是一个开源的自主编码代理，能读写文件、执行命令、浏览网页并调用工具，全程可人工审批。它以 VS Code/JetBrains 插件、CLI、桌面应用和 SDK 多种形态提供同一套代理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库按产品线组织：sdk/ 提供 Node.js 编程式代理 API，apps/cli/ 是终端 UI 与无头模式，另有 VS Code 扩展、JetBrains 插件和 macOS/Windows 桌面应用。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，基于 Node.js 生态；CLI 通过 npm 全局安装，SDK 以 @cline/sdk 包发布，支持 MCP 服务器与自定义工具。
zh.hot: 68,377 颗星、日增 112 并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 20，说明多形态统一代理引擎的定位持续吸引开发者。
uses: 想在 VS Code 或 JetBrains 里获得可审批自主编码助手的开发者
需要在 CI/CD 或脚本中使用无头编码代理的工程团队
希望基于同一引擎构建自定义 AI 代理与集成的开发者
偏好桌面应用管理模型、插件与 MCP 服务器的进阶用户

en.tag: Open-source autonomous coding agent for IDE, terminal, and desktop
en.what: Cline is an open-source autonomous coding agent that can create files, run commands, browse the web, and use tools with human-in-the-loop approval. It ships the same agent engine as VS Code/JetBrains extensions, a CLI, a desktop app, and an SDK.
en.content: The repo is organized by product line: sdk/ offers a Node.js programmatic agent API, apps/cli/ holds the terminal UI and headless mode, plus VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin, and macOS/Windows desktop app.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript on the Node.js ecosystem; the CLI installs globally via npm and the SDK ships as @cline/sdk, with support for MCP servers and custom tools.
en.hot: With 68,377 stars, +112 today, and a #20 spot on GitHub Trending daily, its multi-surface unified agent engine keeps drawing developers.
uses: Developers wanting an approval-gated autonomous coding assistant in VS Code or JetBrains
Engineering teams needing a headless coding agent for CI/CD or scripting
Developers building custom AI agents and integrations on the same engine
Power users preferring a desktop app to manage models, plugins, and MCP servers

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理打造的性能优化与安全增强系统
zh.what: ECC 是一个代理工具链（harness）优化系统，为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全与研究优先的开发能力。它通过统一的配置与插件机制，增强代理在复杂任务中的表现与可控性。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 JavaScript 库、CLI 工具、GitHub App（ecc-tools）、文档（多语言 README）以及示例配置，支持通过 npm 包（ecc-universal）集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js，依赖 npm 生态，提供 CLI 与 GitHub App 集成，支持多代理框架（Claude Code、Codex 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 24.4 万 Star 和今日新增 235 星，ECC 成为 AI 代理工具链领域的明星项目，其跨代理兼容性和性能优化特性吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：希望增强 Claude Code、Codex 等代理的记忆、安全与技能，提升开发效率。
团队与组织：需要统一管理多个 AI 代理的配置、权限与安全策略，确保合规与可控。
开发者工具链爱好者：对代理性能优化、插件机制和 GitHub App 集成感兴趣，可扩展自定义功能。

en.tag: Performance optimization and security enhancement system for AI coding agents like Claude Code
en.what: ECC is an agent harness optimization system that provides skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development capabilities for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It enhances agent performance and control through unified configuration and plugin mechanisms.
en.content: The repository includes core JavaScript libraries, CLI tools, a GitHub App (ecc-tools), multi-language documentation, and example configurations, integrable via the npm package (ecc-universal).
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, leveraging the npm ecosystem, offering CLI and GitHub App integration, compatible with multiple agent frameworks (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).
en.hot: With 244k stars and 235 new stars today, ECC has become a star project in the AI agent toolchain space, attracting developers with its cross-agent compatibility and performance optimization features.
uses: AI coding agent users: Enhance memory, security, and skills for agents like Claude Code and Codex to boost development productivity.
Teams and organizations: Need unified management of configurations, permissions, and security policies across multiple AI agents for compliance and control.
Developer toolchain enthusiasts: Interested in agent performance optimization, plugin mechanisms, and GitHub App integration for custom extensions.

zh.tag: 腾讯云开源的自托管多用户多智能体 AI 助手
zh.what: Octop 是腾讯云开源的自托管 AI 助手，主打多用户与多智能体并行协作，可为团队、家庭和个人搭建独立又协同的智能环境。它完全运行在本地，隐私不外泄，单进程启动即可用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 3.12+ 的完整实现，提供 Web 控制台、CLI 与 IM 集成，并有专家库、Connectors（OAuth + MCP）和 ACP 等扩展模块，附中英文 README 与路线图。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.12+，采用 Ruff 代码风格，通过 PyPI 分发，支持 HTTP/SSE/WebSocket 接口，并集成 MCP、OAuth 与 ACP 协议。
zh.hot: 上线即冲上 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 6，累计约 2950 star、单日新增 396，腾讯云背书加上自托管多智能体定位正好切中隐私与协作需求。
uses: 注重数据隐私、希望本地自托管 AI 助手的团队与个人
需要多用户共享、多智能体协作的家庭或小型组织
想通过飞书、钉钉、QQ、Discord、企业微信等 IM 接入 AI 的用户
希望用专家库、Connectors 与 ACP 扩展 IDE 工作流的开发者

en.tag: Tencent Cloud's self-hosted multi-user, multi-agent AI assistant
en.what: Octop is an open-source, self-hosted AI assistant from Tencent Cloud built around multi-user and multi-agent parallelism, creating an intelligent environment that is both independent and collaborative for teams, families, and individuals. It runs entirely on your own machine, so privacy is never compromised, and a single process brings up the whole stack.
en.content: The repo ships a full Python 3.12+ implementation with a web console, CLI and IM integrations, plus extension modules such as an expert library, Connectors (OAuth + MCP) and ACP, along with bilingual READMEs and a roadmap.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.12+, styled with Ruff and distributed via PyPI, it exposes HTTP/SSE/WebSocket interfaces and integrates MCP, OAuth and ACP protocols.
en.hot: It hit No.6 on GitHub Trending's Python daily list with roughly 2,950 stars and 396 gained in a single day, as Tencent Cloud's backing plus a self-hosted multi-agent angle taps straight into privacy and collaboration needs.
uses: Teams and individuals who value privacy and want a self-hosted AI assistant
Families or small organizations needing multi-user sharing and multi-agent collaboration
Users who want AI access via Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, Discord or WeCom
Developers extending IDE workflows with the expert library, Connectors and ACP

zh.tag: 美团开源 136 亿参数视频生成基础模型，支持长视频续写
zh.what: LongCat-Video 是美团 LongCat 团队推出的 136 亿参数视频生成基础模型，在文生视频、图生视频和视频续写三类任务上都有不错表现。它尤其擅长高效生成分钟级长视频，且不会出现色彩漂移或画质衰减，被视为迈向世界模型的第一步。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型推理与训练代码、技术报告（arXiv 2510.22200）、项目主页，以及 Hugging Face / ModelScope 上的模型权重，并附带 LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 数字人版本。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主，基于主流深度学习框架构建，依赖 Hugging Face 与 ModelScope 分发权重，采用 MIT 许可证。
zh.hot: 作为美团少见的开源大模型项目，8219 颗星、单日新增 120 星并登上 GitHub Python 日榜第 7，说明社区对国产开源视频生成基础模型关注度很高。
uses: 视频生成研究者与算法工程师，用于复现和二次开发文生视频、图生视频能力
内容创作者与短视频团队，用于批量生成分钟级长视频素材
数字人/虚拟主播开发者，可基于 Avatar 1.5 版本构建口播视频管线
想研究世界模型与长时序视频建模的高校与实验室团队

en.tag: Meituan's open-source 13.6B foundational video generation model with long-video continuation
en.what: LongCat-Video is a 13.6B-parameter foundational video generation model from Meituan's LongCat team, performing well on text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-continuation tasks. It especially excels at efficiently producing minutes-long videos without color drifting or quality degradation, framed as a first step toward world models.
en.content: The repo ships inference and training code, a technical report (arXiv 2510.22200), a project page, model weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope, plus a LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 avatar variant.
en.stack: Primarily Python on mainstream deep learning frameworks, distributing weights via Hugging Face and ModelScope under the MIT license.
en.hot: As a rare open-source large model from Meituan, 8,219 stars with 120 added today and a #7 spot on GitHub's Python daily trending show strong community interest in domestic open-source video generation models.
uses: Video generation researchers and ML engineers reproducing or extending text-to-video and image-to-video capabilities
Content creators and short-video teams batch-generating minutes-long video footage
Digital human and virtual anchor developers building talking-head pipelines on the Avatar 1.5 variant
Academic labs studying world models and long-horizon video modeling

zh.tag: 开源游戏大全，涵盖各类游戏与开源重制版
zh.what: 这是一个开源游戏列表，收录了各种类型的开源电子游戏以及商业游戏的开源重制版。它按游戏类型分类，方便用户查找和探索。

zh.stack: 仓库本身是纯文档，但列出的游戏使用多种语言和引擎，如 Python、C++、JavaScript 等。
zh.hot: 凭借 14,455 个 star 和今日新增 77 个 star，它成为 GitHub 日榜 Python 类别第 8 名，因为开发者们喜欢一站式发现开源游戏。
uses: 游戏开发者寻找开源项目参考或贡献
玩家寻找免费开源游戏游玩
开源爱好者探索游戏重制版和逆向工程

en.tag: A comprehensive list of open source games and open-source remakes.
en.what: This is a list of open-source video games and commercial games with open-source remakes. It categorizes games by genre for easy discovery.

en.stack: The repository itself is pure documentation, but the listed games use various languages and engines, such as Python, C++, JavaScript, etc.
en.hot: With 14,455 stars and 77 new stars today, it ranks #8 on GitHub Trending (Python), as developers love discovering open-source games in one place.

Players seeking free open-source games to play
Open-source enthusiasts exploring game remakes and reverse engineering

zh.tag: 多智能体群体智能预测引擎，在数字沙盘中推演未来
zh.what: MiroFish 是一个基于多智能体的通用预测引擎，从新闻、政策草案、金融信号等真实世界种子信息中自动构建高保真平行数字世界。在这个世界里，成千上万个拥有独立人格、长期记忆和行为逻辑的智能体自由交互并社会演化，用户可从上帝视角注入变量，推演未来走向。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 实现，包含多智能体引擎核心、数字世界构建与交互模块，以及 Docker 部署配置和静态资源（Logo、文档图）。提供中英文 README、Discord/X/Instagram 社区入口和 DeepWiki 文档。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，支持 Docker 构建部署，依赖多智能体仿真与 LLM 相关组件，并提供 DeepWiki 文档与 Discord 社区支持。
zh.hot: 上线即获 73149 颗星，今日新增 560 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5 名，说明“多智能体+预测”这一叙事正处在 AI 社区的风口。
uses: AI 研究者与多智能体仿真爱好者，用于探索群体智能与社会演化实验
政策、公关与战略决策者，在零风险数字沙盘中预演方案效果
金融与舆情分析师，用种子信号推演市场或舆论走向
对预测建模感兴趣的开发者，可基于引擎二次开发自定义场景

en.tag: A multi-agent swarm intelligence engine that simulates and predicts futures in a digital sandbox
en.what: MiroFish is a general-purpose prediction engine powered by multi-agent technology that builds a high-fidelity parallel digital world from real-world seed information such as breaking news, policy drafts, or financial signals. Inside it, thousands of agents with independent personalities, long-term memory, and behavioral logic interact and evolve socially, while users inject variables from a god's-eye view to deduce future trajectories.
en.content: The repo is implemented in Python and contains the multi-agent engine core, digital-world construction and interaction modules, plus Docker deployment configs and static assets (logos, doc images). It ships with English/Chinese READMEs, community links for Discord/X/Instagram, and DeepWiki documentation.
en.stack: Primarily Python, with Docker-based build and deployment, relying on multi-agent simulation and LLM-related components, and supported by DeepWiki docs and a Discord community.
en.hot: It has already amassed 73,149 stars, gained 560 today, and ranks 5th on GitHub Trending's daily list, showing that the multi-agent plus prediction narrative is riding a strong wave in the AI community.
uses: AI researchers and multi-agent simulation enthusiasts exploring swarm intelligence and social evolution experiments
Policy, PR, and strategy decision-makers rehearsing scenarios at zero risk in a digital sandbox
Financial and public-opinion analysts deducing market or sentiment trends from seed signals
Developers interested in predictive modeling who want to build custom scenarios on top of the engine

zh.tag: 一条 CLI 给 AI Agent 装上全网读取与搜索能力
zh.what: Agent Reach 是一个 Python 命令行工具，让 AI Agent 无需申请各家 API key 就能读取和搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台内容。它替用户选好并维护当下最稳定的接入方式，把多平台数据获取统一到一条命令里。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式提供 CLI 入口，配套 docs 目录含中英日韩多语言 README、赞助商素材与设计理念说明，并附 Trendshift、Star History 徽章。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+，MIT 许可，采用 CLI 形态封装各平台抓取与搜索逻辑，依赖较轻、开箱即用。
zh.hot: 上线即冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 6，累计 81255 star、今日新增 651，说明「零 API 费用 + 多平台统一接入」正好击中 Agent 开发者的数据获取痛点。
uses: 做 AI Agent 的开发者，需要给 Agent 补上实时互联网数据源
想低成本抓取社交平台内容做分析或舆情监控的团队
需要跨 Twitter/Reddit/YouTube/B站/小红书统一检索的研究者
不想维护各家 API key 与频繁更换接入方式的个人开发者

en.tag: One CLI that gives AI agents internet-wide reading and search
en.what: Agent Reach is a Python CLI that lets AI agents read and search content across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and XiaoHongShu without paying for each platform's API. It picks and maintains the currently most reliable access method so users don't have to keep up with changing interfaces.
en.content: The repo ships a Python package with a CLI entry point, plus a docs folder containing multilingual READMEs (EN/JA/KO), sponsor assets and design notes, along with Trendshift and Star History badges.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+ under the MIT license, it wraps per-platform scraping and search logic into a lightweight, ready-to-run CLI.
en.hot: It hit #6 on GitHub Trending with 81,255 stars and 651 added today, showing that zero-API-fee, unified multi-platform access hits a real pain point for agent builders.
uses: AI agent developers who need to feed their agents live internet data
Teams doing social content analysis or sentiment monitoring on a budget
Researchers who need unified search across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili and XiaoHongShu
Solo developers tired of managing API keys and chasing changing access methods

zh.tag: 让编码代理自我进化的 Agent OS，带面试式需求澄清与预算化演化循环
zh.what: Ouroboros 是一个面向 AI 编码工作流的 Agent OS，让代理在一次次运行与失败中自动变聪明，而人类只负责守住验收底线。它通过面试式提问澄清需求、分阶段评估结果，并在预算约束下驱动演化循环，把评分命令和预期结果排除在交给代理的成功契约之外。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式发布（PyPI 上的 ouroboros-ai），提供 ooo CLI、MCP server 与安装脚本，支持 macOS/Linux/WSL2 与 Windows 一键安装，并配有文档图片、多语言 README 与学习指南站点。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，通过 MCP server 与 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、OpenCode、Copilot、Kiro 等 14 种运行时集成；安装脚本会自动准备 Git 与 uv，MIT 许可。
zh.hot: 项目已积累约 5963 颗星，今日新增 32 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Python 第 11 名，说明“让代理自主进化”这一命题正切中提示工程疲劳的开发者痛点。
uses: 想让编码代理在多次失败中自动改进、而非反复手写提示词的开发者
需要在团队内建立可复现、可评估的 AI 编码工作流的工程团队
已在用 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 等代理并希望统一编排的重度用户
研究代理自我演化、评估门控与预算约束机制的技术爱好者

en.tag: An Agent OS that lets coding agents self-evolve via interview-gated, budgeted evolution loops
en.what: Ouroboros is an Agent OS for replayable AI coding workflows that lets agents get smarter across generations by running, failing, and iterating. It gates work through an interview, evaluates in stages, and runs a budgeted evolution loop while keeping the grading command and expected result out of the success contract handed to the agent.
en.content: Shipped as a Python package (ouroboros-ai on PyPI), it provides an ooo CLI, an MCP server, and one-command install scripts for macOS/Linux/WSL2 and Windows, alongside docs images, multilingual READMEs, and a learning guide site.
en.stack: Written in Python, it integrates with 14 runtimes including Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot, and Kiro via an MCP server; install scripts bootstrap Git and uv, under an MIT license.
en.hot: With roughly 5,963 stars and 32 added today, it ranks 11th on GitHub Trending's daily Python list, showing that 'agents that evolve themselves' resonates with developers tired of prompt engineering.
uses: Developers who want coding agents to improve from failures instead of hand-tuning prompts
Engineering teams needing reproducible, evaluable AI coding workflows
Heavy users of Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and similar agents seeking unified orchestration
Researchers curious about self-evolving agents, evaluation gating, and budgeted loops

zh.tag: 本地优先的全能语音工作室
zh.what: VoiceStudio 是一个开源的、完全本地运行的语音工具集，提供类似 ElevenLabs 的功能，包括声音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，支持 646 种语言。无需账户、API 密钥或订阅，所有处理都在用户自己的硬件上完成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的应用代码、文档、安装指南、架构说明和 API 文档，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 及 Docker。集成了 16 种 TTS 引擎和 11 种 ASR 引擎，提供图形界面和命令行工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖多种开源 TTS/ASR 引擎（如 Coqui、Whisper 等），支持跨平台桌面环境与 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 作为本地优先的 ElevenLabs 替代品，VoiceStudio 在隐私和成本敏感的用户中迅速走红，单日新增 1672 星，总星数达 16279，反映出对自主语音处理工具的高需求。
uses: 内容创作者：需要为视频配音或制作多语言音频，但不想依赖云服务。
隐私敏感用户：希望语音数据完全留在本地，避免上传到第三方。
开发者：需要集成语音克隆或转录功能的 API，且要求离线运行。
语言学习者：利用 646 种语言支持进行听力练习或生成自定义语音内容。

en.tag: Fully-local voice studio: clone, dub, transcribe & more
en.what: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully-local voice toolkit offering ElevenLabs-like features: voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages. No account, API key, or subscription required—everything runs on your own hardware.

en.stack: Built primarily with Python, leveraging various open-source TTS/ASR engines (e.g., Coqui, Whisper), with cross-platform desktop support and Docker deployment.

Privacy-conscious users who want voice data to stay entirely on-device.
Developers seeking offline APIs for voice cloning or transcription integration.
Language learners leveraging 646-language support for listening practice or custom audio.

zh.tag: AI 代理的自进化上下文数据库，统一记忆、知识与技能
zh.what: OpenViking 是一个为 AI 代理设计的开源上下文数据库，将记忆、资源和技能统一为一个虚拟文件系统（viking:// 协议），代理可以通过 ls、tree、find 等命令浏览自己的上下文，而不是查询黑盒向量存储。内容被处理为三层（L0 摘要、L1 概览、L2 细节），并按需加载，每次检索都会留下可观察和调试的轨迹。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenViking 的核心实现，包括虚拟文件系统、三层内容处理管道、检索轨迹记录，以及 OpenViking Studio 在线演示环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，可能依赖向量数据库、文件系统抽象和 AI 代理框架，具体技术栈未在摘要中详述。
zh.hot: OpenViking 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 28,893 颗星，今日新增 239 颗，位列 Python 趋势榜第 9 名。其创新的上下文管理方式（将记忆、知识和技能统一为文件系统）吸引了大量关注，解决了 AI 代理上下文管理的痛点。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要高效管理代理上下文、记忆和技能的场景。
RAG 应用构建者：希望用文件系统方式替代传统向量检索的团队。
研究与教育：用于探索代理上下文管理的新范式。

en.tag: Self-evolving context database for AI agents, unifying memory, knowledge RAG, and skills
en.what: OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents, unifying memories, resources, and skills into one virtual filesystem under the viking:// protocol, so agents can browse their context with ls, tree, and find instead of querying a black-box vector store. Content is processed into three tiers (L0 abstract, L1 overview, L2 details) and loaded on demand, with every retrieval leaving a traceable trajectory for debugging.
en.content: The repository contains the core implementation of OpenViking, including the virtual filesystem, three-tier content processing pipeline, retrieval trajectory logging, and the OpenViking Studio live demo environment.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, likely leveraging vector databases, filesystem abstractions, and AI agent frameworks, though the exact stack is not detailed in the summary.
en.hot: OpenViking has quickly gained traction on GitHub with 28,893 stars and 239 new stars today, ranking #9 on the Python trending list. Its innovative approach to context management—unifying memory, knowledge, and skills into a filesystem—has attracted significant attention, addressing a key pain point in AI agent context handling.
uses: AI agent developers: scenarios requiring efficient management of agent context, memory, and skills.
RAG application builders: teams looking to replace traditional vector retrieval with a filesystem approach.
Research and education: for exploring new paradigms in agent context management.

zh.tag: 一条 YAML 微调大模型，4GB 笔记本 GPU 跑 8B
zh.what: Soup 是一个命令行工具，让用户通过单个 YAML 文件微调和后训练大语言模型，无需 SSH 或复杂配置。它采用层流式训练技术，能在仅 4GB 显存的笔记本 GPU 上训练 8B 参数模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 源码、示例 YAML 配置、文档（命令、模型等）、Web UI 资源以及测试和 CI 配置，提供完整的微调工作流。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10-3.12，依赖 PyPI 包 soup-cli，采用 Apache-2.0 许可证，并集成 CI 测试。

en.tag: Fine-tune LLMs from one YAML; 8B model on a 4GB laptop GPU

en.content: The repo contains Python source code, example YAML configs, documentation (commands, models, etc.), Web UI assets, and tests/CI setup, offering a complete fine-tuning workflow.

en.hot: It's trending for its ultra-low hardware barrier (fine-tune 8B models on a 4GB GPU) and simple YAML config, with 6,710 stars and 104 added today, ranking #14 on GitHub Trending Python daily.

ML engineers needing to quickly experiment with different fine-tuning configs
Educational settings for teaching LLM fine-tuning without high-end GPUs
Startup teams looking to customize their own language models cost-effectively

zh.tag: 开源 LLM 应用层：RAG、深度研究与自定义 Agent 一体化平台

en.tag: Open-source LLM application layer with RAG, deep research and custom agents
en.what: Onyx is the open-source application layer for LLMs, offering a feature-rich chat interface that anyone can self-host. It augments models with agentic RAG, web search, code execution, artifact generation and deep research, plus 50+ indexing connectors and MCP support.

en.tag: Google's official Agent Skills collection that teaches AI agents Google Cloud and AI workflows

Anyone learning Google's recommended practices for multi-agent security and RAG solutions

zh.tag: 无分词器的多语言TTS，支持创意音色设计与高保真克隆
zh.what: VoxCPM2 是 OpenBMB 推出的无分词器文本转语音系统，采用端到端扩散自回归架构直接生成连续语音表示，跳过离散 token 化以获得更自然、富有表现力的合成效果。2B 参数模型基于超 200 万小时多语言语音训练，支持 30 种语言、音色设计与可控声音克隆，并输出 48kHz 录音室级音频。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型推理代码、预训练权重链接、Hugging Face 在线 Demo、ReadTheDocs 文档、示例音频页面以及 arXiv 技术报告，并提供中英文 README 与社区入口。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 开发，构建在 MiniCPM-4 骨干之上，依赖扩散自回归生成架构，模型权重托管于 Hugging Face 与 ModelScope。
zh.hot: 凭借 3.7 万+ star 和日增 99 的热度，VoxCPM2 以无分词器架构、30 语言支持和 48kHz 高保真输出，成为开源 TTS 领域备受关注的新标杆。
uses: 语音合成研究者与开发者，用于探索无分词器 TTS 与扩散自回归架构
内容创作者与播客制作者，需要多语言、高自然度的配音与音色设计
需要定制化声音克隆的产品团队，用于虚拟助手、有声书或游戏角色配音
AI 应用开发者，希望集成 48kHz 录音室级语音输出到现有工作流

en.tag: Tokenizer-free multilingual TTS with creative voice design and true-to-life cloning
en.what: VoxCPM2 is a tokenizer-free TTS system from OpenBMB that uses an end-to-end diffusion autoregressive architecture to generate continuous speech representations directly, skipping discrete tokenization for more natural, expressive synthesis. The 2B-parameter model is trained on over 2 million hours of multilingual speech, supports 30 languages, voice design and controllable voice cloning, and outputs 48kHz studio-quality audio.
en.content: The repo includes inference code, pretrained weight links, a Hugging Face live demo, ReadTheDocs documentation, an audio sample page, an arXiv technical report, plus bilingual READMEs and community links.
en.stack: Built in Python on top of the MiniCPM-4 backbone, relying on a diffusion autoregressive generation architecture, with model weights hosted on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
en.hot: With over 37k stars and 99 added today, VoxCPM2 stands out as a new open-source TTS benchmark thanks to its tokenizer-free architecture, 30-language support and 48kHz high-fidelity output.
uses: TTS researchers and developers exploring tokenizer-free synthesis and diffusion autoregressive architectures
Content creators and podcasters needing multilingual, natural-sounding dubbing and voice design
Product teams requiring custom voice cloning for virtual assistants, audiobooks or game characters
AI application developers integrating 48kHz studio-quality speech output into existing workflows

zh.tag: 离线优先的自托管知识与教育服务器，断网也能用

en.tag: An offline-first, self-hosted knowledge and education server that works without internet
en.what: Project NOMAD is a self-contained, offline-first knowledge and education server that bundles Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and optional local AI onto hardware you own. It is accessed through a browser and works without any internet connection.
en.content: The repo contains a Docker-based management UI called Command Center plus an API that orchestrates containerized tools and resources, along with install scripts, a Docker Compose template, and a WSL2 install guide.

Regions with unstable or no internet, plus fieldwork and emergency scenarios
Schools and libraries needing low-cost local educational resources
Tech enthusiasts wanting local AI Q&A over their own documents

zh.tag: 可视化搭建 AI 代理与工作流的开源自动化平台
zh.what: n8n 是一个 fair-code 的工作流自动化平台，把可视化画布与自定义代码结合，用来构建和部署 AI 代理及多步骤自动化流程。它支持自托管或云端运行，可连接 1500+ 集成，并灵活切换 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 或开源模型。

Enterprise scenarios needing self-hosted, data-controlled automation
Engineers connecting AI to existing systems via 1500+ integrations
Beginners learning workflow and AI orchestration through a visual canvas

zh.tag: 为 LLM 与 AI Agent 打造的自进化记忆操作系统

en.tag: A self-evolving memory OS for LLMs and AI agents

zh.tag: Vercel 出品的文件系统优先 AI 代理框架

zh.tag: Vercel 出品的 TypeScript AI 工具包，统一接入各家模型并构建 AI 应用与代理
zh.what: AI SDK 是一个与模型供应商无关的 TypeScript 工具包，让开发者用统一 API 调用 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等主流模型。它同时提供文本生成、结构化数据输出和代理（Agent）构建能力，可搭配 Next.js、React、Svelte、Vue、Angular 等框架使用。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 源码为主，包含核心 ai 包、各家供应商适配包（如 @ai-sdk/openai、@ai-sdk/anthropic、@ai-sdk/google）、文档与示例，并提供面向编码代理的 skill 安装命令。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 与 Node.js 22+，通过 npm 安装，默认走 Vercel AI Gateway，也可直接接入各供应商官方 SDK，并集成 Zod 做结构化输出校验。
zh.hot: 背靠 Next.js 团队、定位清晰且生态成熟，已积累 26841 颗星，今日再涨 33 星并登上 TypeScript 日榜第 19 名，是前端开发者做 AI 应用的首选库之一。
uses: 前端与全栈开发者：用 Next.js/React 等框架快速搭建 AI 聊天、生成类应用
需要多模型切换的团队：用统一 API 屏蔽 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等差异
构建 AI Agent 的工程师：借助 ToolLoopAgent 和工具调用能力实现自动化代理
使用 Claude Code、Cursor 的开发者：通过 npx skills add 为编码代理补充 AI SDK 知识

en.tag: Vercel's provider-agnostic TypeScript toolkit for building AI apps and agents
en.what: AI SDK is a provider-agnostic TypeScript toolkit that lets developers call OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and other major models through one unified API. It also covers text generation, structured data output and agent building, and works with frameworks like Next.js, React, Svelte, Vue and Angular.
en.content: The repo is mostly TypeScript source, containing the core ai package, per-provider adapter packages (@ai-sdk/openai, @ai-sdk/anthropic, @ai-sdk/google), docs and examples, plus a skill install command for coding agents.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript and Node.js 22+, installed via npm, defaulting to the Vercel AI Gateway while also supporting direct provider SDKs, with Zod integration for structured output validation.
en.hot: Backed by the Next.js team with a clear scope and mature ecosystem, it has reached 26,841 stars, gaining 33 more today and ranking 19th on the TypeScript daily trending list, making it a go-to library for front-end AI apps.
uses: Front-end and full-stack developers building AI chat or generation apps with Next.js/React and similar frameworks
Teams needing multi-model switching, using one unified API to abstract over OpenAI, Anthropic and Google differences
Engineers building AI agents who want ToolLoopAgent and tool-calling to create autonomous workflows
Developers using Claude Code or Cursor who can run npx skills add to give coding agents AI SDK knowledge

zh.tag: 面向网络安全分析师的图化OSINT调查平台
zh.what: Flowsint 是一个开源的 OSINT 图探索工具，专为合乎伦理的调查、透明度和验证而设计。它让网络安全分析师和调查人员能够以可视化、灵活且可扩展的方式，对实体及其关系进行图谱化调查。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端应用、核心逻辑和 API 服务等模块，采用 Docker 化部署，提供完整的本地或团队调查环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Docker 和 Make 进行构建与部署，支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。
zh.hot: 凭借 8341 颗星和今日新增 280 星，Flowsint 登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 18 名，反映出网络安全与 OSINT 工具在开源社区的高关注度。
uses: 网络安全分析师 —— 用于可视化调查网络威胁和实体关系
OSINT 调查人员 —— 进行开源情报收集与图谱分析
安全团队 —— 在内部网络中部署协作调查平台
隐私关注者 —— 所有数据存储在本地，保障调查隐私

en.tag: A graph-based OSINT investigation platform for cybersecurity analysts
en.what: Flowsint is an open-source OSINT graph exploration tool designed for ethical investigation, transparency, and verification. It enables cybersecurity analysts and investigators to visually, flexibly, and extensibly investigate entities and their relationships as graphs.
en.content: The repository contains frontend app, core logic, and API service modules, with Docker-based deployment for a complete local or team investigation environment.
en.stack: Primarily built with TypeScript, relying on Docker and Make for building and deployment, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows.
en.hot: With 8,341 stars and 280 new stars today, Flowsint ranks 18th on GitHub Trending daily, reflecting strong community interest in cybersecurity and OSINT tools.
uses: Cybersecurity analysts — for visual investigation of cyber threats and entity relationships
OSINT investigators — for open-source intelligence gathering and graph analysis
Security teams — deploy a collaborative investigation platform on internal networks
Privacy-conscious users — all data is stored locally, ensuring investigation privacy

zh.tag: 模块化物流与供应链操作系统
zh.what: Fleetbase 是一个模块化的物流与供应链操作系统，覆盖运输管理、调度派单、路径优化与实时追踪等环节。它面向电商、餐饮、快递、现场服务等需要自建物流能力的组织，提供可扩展的开源平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心后端服务、控制台界面与模块化扩展体系，配套完整的 API 文档、云版本入口和 Discord 社区，整体以可插拔模块组织物流功能。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript 为主，采用模块化架构，提供 REST API 与可扩展的插件机制，依赖现代 Node.js 生态与前端控制台框架。
zh.hot: 今日新增 530 star，登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 6 名，说明开发者对可自托管的开源物流系统需求旺盛。
uses: 电商与零售团队：管理配送、追踪订单并优化最后一公里物流
餐饮与快递企业：调度司机、规划路线并提供客户实时追踪
现场服务与运维团队：安排技师、管理服务区域并跟踪工单完成
开发者与企业：基于模块化架构和完整 API 构建定制供应链方案

en.tag: Modular logistics and supply chain operating system
en.what: Fleetbase is a modular logistics and supply chain operating system covering transportation management, dispatching, route optimization, and real-time tracking. It targets e-commerce, food and beverage, courier, and field service organizations that need to build their own logistics capabilities on an extensible open-source platform.
en.content: The repo contains the core backend services, a console UI, and a modular extension system, along with full API docs, a cloud version entry point, and a Discord community, organizing logistics features as pluggable modules.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript with a modular architecture, exposing REST APIs and an extensible plugin mechanism, built on the modern Node.js ecosystem and a frontend console framework.
en.hot: It gained 530 stars today and ranked 6th on the GitHub Trending JavaScript daily list, showing strong developer demand for self-hostable open-source logistics systems.
uses: E-commerce and retail teams: manage deliveries, track orders, and optimize last-mile logistics
Food, beverage, and courier businesses: dispatch drivers, plan routes, and offer real-time customer tracking
Field service and operations teams: schedule technicians, manage service areas, and track job completion
Developers and enterprises: build custom supply chain solutions with a modular architecture and full API access

zh.tag: AI 代理全自动管理 YouTube 频道，免费 Gemini 可用
zh.what: 这是一个利用 AI 代理实现 YouTube 频道全自动管理的工具。它能够自动创建、优化并发布视频，全天候运行，无需人工干预。支持使用免费的 Gemini API 或 OpenAI，且无需编写代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的自动化流程：视频脚本生成、图像生成、语音合成、视频渲染（利用 FFmpeg）、以及 YouTube 发布队列。提供命令行工具（如 npm run setup、npm run walkthrough）进行配置和引导，支持多种 AI 提供商（OpenAI、Gemini、OpenRouter 等）。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Node.js（JavaScript），依赖 FFmpeg（通过 ffmpeg-static 捆绑）、dotenv 管理环境变量，并集成多个 AI 提供商的 API（OpenAI、Gemini、OpenRouter、Kimi、MiMo、GLM）。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 164 星，总星数达 2010，位列 JavaScript 趋势榜第 4。其吸引力在于提供完全免费（使用 Gemini）的自动化 YouTube 频道管理，大幅降低内容创作门槛，且持续更新修复问题，社区反响热烈。
uses: 内容创作者：希望自动化视频生成和发布，节省时间。
营销人员：需要批量生成视频内容以扩大品牌影响力。
开发者：对 AI 代理工作流和自动化管道感兴趣，可二次开发。
初学者：无需编程经验，通过引导式设置即可上手。

en.tag: Fully automated YouTube channel management with AI agents, works with free Gemini or OpenAI
en.what: This is a tool that uses AI agents to fully automate YouTube channel management. It can automatically create, optimize, and publish videos, running 24/7 without manual intervention. It works with the free Gemini API or OpenAI, and requires no coding.
en.content: The repository contains a complete automation pipeline: video script generation, image generation, voice narration, video rendering (using FFmpeg), and a YouTube publishing queue. It provides CLI tools (e.g., npm run setup, npm run walkthrough) for configuration and guided setup, supporting multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily built on Node.js (JavaScript), with dependencies on FFmpeg (bundled via ffmpeg-static), dotenv for environment variables, and integrations with multiple AI provider APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Kimi, MiMo, GLM).
en.hot: The project is rapidly gaining traction on GitHub, with 164 stars today and 2010 total, ranking #4 on the JavaScript trending list. Its appeal lies in offering fully automated YouTube channel management for free (using Gemini), significantly lowering the barrier to content creation, and its continuous updates and issue fixes have garnered strong community response.
uses: Content creators: who want to automate video generation and publishing to save time.
Marketers: needing to produce video content at scale for brand reach.
Developers: interested in AI agent workflows and automation pipelines, can customize.
Beginners: no coding experience needed, guided setup makes it easy to start.

zh.tag: 让 AI 生成的 HTML 产物可被人类直接标注与反馈的本地编辑器
zh.what: Lavish 是一个面向 AI 代理产出的 HTML 产物的本地编辑器。它把代理生成的 HTML 文件在本地浏览器打开，让你精确标注元素与选中文本、编辑 Mermaid 白板图，并把反馈发回给代理，从而补上人机协作闭环。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 CLI 工具与配套的 Agent Skill（agentskills 格式），以及营销演示素材（如 lavish-editor-marketing 下的 GIF）。核心是本地运行的编辑器与代理交互协议。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，以 npm 包形式发布，支持 macOS、Linux、Windows，核心反馈回路本地优先、无云依赖。
zh.hot: 它切中了代理产出 HTML 后人类难以高效反馈的痛点，提出“HTML 是新 Markdown”的主张，今日新增 138 star、总 star 达 3708，登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 7。
uses: 使用 AI 代理生成 HTML 原型或可视化产物的开发者
需要与代理反复迭代产品/技术方案、设计探索的团队
希望用本地工具审阅并标注 HTML 产物的设计师与产品经理
想为代理补充人机协作反馈闭环的 AI 工具链构建者

en.tag: A local editor that lets humans annotate and give feedback on agent-generated HTML artifacts
en.what: Lavish is a local editor for HTML artifacts produced by AI agents. It opens agent-generated HTML files in your local browser so you can pinpoint elements and selected text, edit Mermaid whiteboard diagrams, and send feedback back to the agent, closing the human-agent collaboration loop.
en.content: The repo contains a CLI tool plus a companion Agent Skill in the agentskills format, along with marketing demo assets (e.g. GIFs under lavish-editor-marketing). At its core is a locally running editor and the protocol for interacting with agents.
en.stack: Written primarily in JavaScript and published as an npm package, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows, with a local-first core feedback loop and no cloud dependency.
en.hot: It targets the pain point that humans struggle to give efficient feedback on agent-produced HTML, championing 'HTML is the new markdown', and gained 138 stars today for a total of 3,708, ranking 7th on GitHub Trending's daily JavaScript list.
uses: Developers using AI agents to generate HTML prototypes or visual artifacts
Teams iterating on product/technical plans and design explorations with agents
Designers and PMs who want to review and annotate HTML artifacts with a local tool
AI toolchain builders adding a human-agent feedback loop for agents

zh.tag: JavaScript 与 TypeScript 的基础数值计算标准库
zh.what: stdlib 是一个面向数值与科学计算的标准库，用 JavaScript（及 C）编写，可在浏览器和 Node.js 中运行。它提供数学、统计、数据处理、流处理等大量经过严格测试的高性能模块。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源码与文档，按功能拆分为大量独立可组合的包（如数学、统计、数组、流等），并配有开发指南、测试与基准测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 与 C 编写，支持 Node.js 和浏览器环境，采用模块化、可分解的架构，依赖 npm 生态进行分发。
zh.hot: 作为 JavaScript 生态中稀缺的严肃数值计算库，stdlib 已积累 6075 颗星，今日再增 5 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 JavaScript 第 7 名，反映出社区对 Web 端科学计算基础设施的持续关注。
uses: 需要在浏览器或 Node.js 中进行数值计算、统计分析和数据处理的开发者
希望用 JavaScript/TypeScript 替代 Python 完成科学计算任务的前端或全栈工程师
构建数据可视化、机器学习预处理或流式数据分析管道的团队
对高性能、可组合、经过严格测试的数学库有需求的研究与工程人员

en.tag: The fundamental numerical library for JavaScript and TypeScript
en.what: stdlib is a standard library focused on numerical and scientific computation, written in JavaScript (and C) for both browsers and Node.js. It offers a large collection of rigorously tested, high-performance modules for mathematics, statistics, data processing, streams, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code and documentation, split into many independently composable packages (math, statistics, arrays, streams, etc.), along with development guides, tests, and benchmarks.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript and C, it runs in Node.js and browsers, follows a modular, decomposable architecture, and is distributed via the npm ecosystem.
en.hot: As a rare serious numerical computing library in the JavaScript ecosystem, stdlib has gathered 6,075 stars, adding 5 more today and ranking 7th on GitHub Trending's daily JavaScript list, reflecting sustained community interest in web-based scientific computing infrastructure.
uses: Developers who need numerical computation, statistical analysis, and data processing in browsers or Node.js
Frontend or full-stack engineers looking to replace Python with JavaScript/TypeScript for scientific computing tasks
Teams building data visualization, machine learning preprocessing, or streaming data analysis pipelines
Researchers and engineers who need a high-performance, composable, rigorously tested math library

zh.tag: 免费无广告追剧资源导航，每日自动检测可用性
zh.what: 这是一个免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选并每日检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox/影视仓配置、IPTV直播源、会员拼团及影视相关开源项目。

zh.hot: 已获 8760 星，今日新增 60，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 JavaScript 第 8 名；免费无广告加每日自动检测的实用定位，精准击中追剧人群的刚需。

en.tag: A curated, ad-free guide to streaming resources with daily availability checks
en.what: This is a free, ad-free guide to streaming resources, hand-picked and checked daily for availability. It covers online streaming sites, apps, cloud-drive search, magnet/BT, subtitles, TVBox/FilmStore configs, IPTV sources, membership group buys, and related open-source projects.
en.content: The repo is mainly a Markdown list plus structured data in resources/resources.json, backed by GitHub Actions workflows for availability checks and data validation, with the zhuiju.me site as an entry point.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, relying on GitHub Actions for scheduled availability checks, with data stored as JSON under a CC BY 4.0 license.
en.hot: It has 8,760 stars with 60 added today, ranking 8th on GitHub Trending's daily JavaScript list; its free, ad-free, auto-checked utility hits a real need for binge-watchers.

TVBox/FilmStore users looking for shell apps and config addresses
Advanced users needing IPTV sources, magnet/BT, or subtitle resources
Open-source contributors who want to submit or validate resources with the community

zh.tag: 从 TradingView 抓取实时行情与指标值的 Node.js 库
zh.what: 这是一个非官方的 TradingView API 客户端，通过 WebSocket 连接 TradingView 获取实时行情价格、技术指标数值和图表数据。它支持回测策略、读取用户图表上的绘图，甚至能使用仅限邀请的指标。

zh.stack: 基于 Node.js 与 WebSocket 通信，无重型框架依赖，通过 npm 安装，要求较新的 Node 版本。
zh.hot: 量化交易与行情抓取需求旺盛，该库能免费拿到 TradingView 的实时数据与指标，今日新增 199 star，总量达 4817，冲上 JavaScript 日榜第 7。
uses: 量化交易者：用实时行情和指标搭建自动交易机器人
开发者：为 Discord/Telegram 群组推送价格与信号提醒
策略研究者：批量回测多种指标与参数组合
数据爱好者：抓取历史区间数据用于机器学习建模

en.tag: Node.js library to pull realtime quotes and indicator values from TradingView
en.what: This is an unofficial TradingView API client that connects over WebSocket to fetch realtime market prices, technical indicator values, and chart data. It supports strategy backtesting, reading drawings from your charts, and even invite-only indicators.
en.content: The repo ships as a JavaScript library on npm (@mathieuc/tradingview), with core connection and data-parsing modules plus a rich examples folder of runnable snippets.
en.stack: Built on Node.js and WebSocket communication with no heavy framework dependencies, installed via npm and requiring a recent Node version.
en.hot: Quant trading and market-data scraping demand is strong, and this library offers free access to TradingView realtime data and indicators, gaining 199 stars today for a total of 4,817 and ranking 7th on the JavaScript daily chart.
uses: Quant traders: build trading bots with realtime quotes and indicators
Developers: push price and signal alerts to Discord/Telegram groups
Strategy researchers: batch-backtest many indicators and parameter sets
Data enthusiasts: pull date-range data for machine-learning modeling

zh.tag: 本地优先的全能 AI 应用，聊天、文档问答与智能体一体
zh.what: AnythingLLM 是一个本地优先的一体化 AI 应用，让你把文档、网页等资料变成可对话的知识库，并驱动 AI Agent 完成任务。它强调数据自持、无需复杂配置，支持多用户与高度自定义。

zh.stack: 以 JavaScript/Node.js 为主，前端配合 React，支持多种 LLM 与向量数据库，可通过 Docker 或桌面端运行。
zh.hot: 凭借 66,187 颗星与今日新增 45 星登上 JavaScript 日榜第 10，本地优先与智能体能力契合当下自托管 AI 热潮。

需要多用户、可定制 AI 助手的团队与企业
希望用 AI Agent 自动化处理资料与任务的开发者

en.tag: The all-in-one local-first AI app for chat, doc Q&A and agents
en.what: AnythingLLM is a local-first, all-in-one AI app that turns your documents and web content into a conversational knowledge base and powers AI agents. It emphasizes data ownership, zero-fuss setup, multi-user support and deep configurability.

Developers automating document and task workflows with AI agents

zh.tag: Claude Code 实时状态栏插件，显示上下文、工具与代理活动

en.tag: A Claude Code plugin that shows context usage, active tools, running agents, and todo progress in real-time.
en.what: Claude HUD is a Claude Code plugin that displays real-time session status below your input, including context window usage, active tools, running subagents, and todo progress. zh.tag: Mozilla 出品的纯 JavaScript PDF 解析与渲染引擎

zh.tag: 用普通 WiFi 信号实现穿墙感知、姿态估计与生命体征监测
zh.what: RuView 把普通 WiFi 路由器发出的无线电波变成空间感知系统：通过 CSI 信号捕捉人体对电磁波的扰动，实现穿墙人员检测、人数统计、动作追踪，以及呼吸和心率等生命体征测量。全程不需要摄像头或可穿戴设备，只靠物理信号。

zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，依赖低成本 ESP32 传感器采集 CSI 数据；通过 MQTT、HAP-1.1、Matter 等协议对接 Home Assistant、Apple Home、Google Home、Alexa 等生态。
zh.hot: 以 93841 颗星、今日新增 383 星冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 12 名，凭借“用 WiFi 穿墙感知、无需摄像头”的隐私友好卖点，加上对主流智能家居生态的原生支持，迅速引发关注。

en.tag: Turn commodity WiFi signals into through-wall sensing, pose estimation and vital-sign monitoring
en.what: RuView turns ordinary WiFi radio waves into a spatial sensing system: it captures human-induced disturbances in Channel State Information (CSI) to detect people through walls, count them, track movement, and measure breathing and heart rate. en.content: The repo centers on a Rust implementation with a CSI acquisition and processing pipeline, pose/vital-sign inference models, and smart-home integration layers: an MQTT publisher for Home Assistant, a HAP-1.1 bridge for Apple Home, and a Matter endpoint. It ships 21 entities per node (11 raw signals + 10 semantic states) plus 3 starter HA Blueprints.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it relies on low-cost ESP32 sensors for CSI data collection and integrates with Home Assistant, Apple Home, Google Home and Alexa via MQTT, HAP-1.1 and Matter.
en.hot: With 93,841 stars and 383 added today, it ranks 12th on GitHub Trending's daily list. Its privacy-friendly pitch — through-wall sensing with WiFi and no cameras — plus native support for major smart-home ecosystems has driven rapid attention.

Privacy-sensitive spaces like bathrooms or bedrooms needing vital-sign and fall-risk monitoring

zh.tag: 用软件工程实践做数据转换的 Rust 重写版 dbt v2.0
zh.what: dbt 让数据分析师和工程师用软件工程的方式（版本控制、测试、文档、依赖管理）来转换数据仓库中的数据。用户只需编写 SELECT 语句作为「模型」，dbt 负责将其编译成表或视图并管理模型间的依赖关系。

zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，编译为按操作系统和架构分发的单一自包含二进制，无需 Python 运行时或依赖管理；产物为 Parquet 格式，同时保留 JSON artifacts 以兼容旧版。

uses: 数据分析师：用 SQL 模型完成数据转换，无需深入工程细节
数据工程师：构建可测试、可文档化、可版本控制的数据管道

en.tag: dbt v2.0: a ground-up Rust rewrite of the data transformation framework
en.what: dbt lets data analysts and engineers transform warehouse data using software engineering practices like version control, testing, docs and dependency management. en.content: The main branch holds the full Apache 2.0 source of dbt v2.0, a from-scratch Rust rewrite; the v1 Python implementation now lives on the 1.latest branch.
en.stack: Written in Rust and shipped as a single self-contained binary per OS/architecture, with no Python runtime or dependency management; it emits Parquet artifacts while still producing JSON artifacts for backwards compatibility.
en.hot: As the most popular transformation tool in data, dbt's Rust rewrite for v2.0 draws wide attention; the repo has ~13.9k stars, gaining 11 today and ranking 7th on the Rust daily trending list.

Data engineers building tested, documented and version-controlled data pipelines

Teams wanting to drop the Python runtime and simplify deployment
