en.what: Hyperswitch is an open-source, composable payments platform that enables connectivity to multiple payment, payout, fraud, vault, and tokenization providers. It uplifts authorization with intelligent routing and revenue recovery, reduces payment processing costs with cost observability, and simplifies payment ops with reconciliation.
en.content: The repository contains the complete payments infrastructure code, including the core payment processing engine, intelligent routing module, cost observability tools, reconciliation module, and connectors for multiple payment providers. It also provides local quickstart guides, cloud deployment options, and a hosted sandbox environment.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, emphasizing high performance and safety. Dependencies include common web frameworks, database drivers, and payment provider SDKs, with PCI compliance support.
en.hot: The project has earned 43,699 stars, with 7 added today, ranking 9th on GitHub Trending's daily Rust list. Its open-source, composable payments infrastructure addresses pain points in enterprise payment integration, attracting widespread attention.
uses: Payment engineers and architects — building or optimizing payment systems with flexible multi-provider connectivity.
E-commerce and SaaS businesses — looking to reduce payment costs, improve authorization rates, and simplify reconciliation.
Fintech startups — seeking rapid payment integration without vendor lock-in.
Cost-sensitive enterprises — needing cost observability tools to audit and optimize payment fees.

zh.tag: 键盘驱动的 SSH 连接管理 TUI，集成仪表盘、终端与 SFTP
zh.what: OmnySSH 是一个用 Rust 编写的快速、键盘驱动的 TUI 工具，用于集中管理所有 SSH 连接。它提供实时仪表盘、完整 PTY 终端、双面板 SFTP 文件传输和命令片段，让你在一个窗口内完成服务器运维。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Rust 源码，分为桌面版和 TUI 版，提供安装脚本、CI 配置、资源文件（如图标）以及详细的 README 文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，使用 ratatui 等 TUI 库，依赖 SSH 和 SFTP 协议实现，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。
zh.hot: 凭借 774 颗星（今日新增 24 星）登上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 10 名，因其一体化、键盘驱动的设计解决了多服务器管理的痛点而受到关注。
uses: 运维工程师和系统管理员需要同时管理多台服务器时，可快速切换和监控。
开发人员频繁通过 SSH 连接远程环境，希望有更直观的终端和文件传输体验。
喜欢键盘操作、追求效率的命令行用户，希望减少重复输入 scp 等命令。

en.tag: A keyboard-driven TUI for managing SSH connections with dashboard, terminal, and SFTP
en.what: OmnySSH is a fast, keyboard-driven TUI written in Rust for managing all your SSH connections in one place. It offers a live dashboard, full PTY terminals, two-panel SFTP, and command snippets, letting you handle server operations from a single window.
en.content: The repository contains full Rust source code for both desktop and TUI versions, along with install scripts, CI configuration, asset files (e.g., icons), and detailed README documentation.
en.stack: Built with Rust, using TUI libraries like ratatui, and relies on SSH and SFTP protocols; supports macOS, Linux, and Windows.
en.hot: With 774 stars (24 added today), it ranks #10 on GitHub Trending (Rust daily), gaining attention for its all-in-one, keyboard-driven design that solves multi-server management pain points.
uses: DevOps engineers and sysadmins managing multiple servers who need quick switching and monitoring.
Developers frequently connecting to remote environments via SSH, wanting a more intuitive terminal and file transfer experience.
Command-line users who prefer keyboard-driven workflows and want to avoid repetitive scp commands.

zh.tag: 人类与 AI 代理共建的自托管协作工作区
zh.what: Buzz 是一个可自托管的协作工作区，让人类和 AI 代理共享同一个房间与事件日志。它基于 Nostr 中继，每条消息、反应、工作流步骤、评审和 git 事件都是同一日志中的签名事件，人和代理拥有相同的身份模型与审计轨迹。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的中继与客户端、VISION 系列愿景文档、ARCHITECTURE.md 架构说明、RELEASING.md 发布流程，以及 docs/assets/screenshots 下的界面截图。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，采用 Nostr 中继协议与签名事件日志，依赖大量 Rust crate，遵循 Apache 2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 33,443 颗星、今日新增 498，并登上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 11 名，说明「人类+代理同房间协作」这一自托管叙事正切中开发者对 AI 代理可控性与审计的需求。
uses: 希望让 AI 代理参与代码评审与工作流、又要求完整审计轨迹的工程团队
需要自托管、数据主权可控的协作平台的组织或社区运营者
研究人类与 AI 代理混合协作模式、基于 Nostr 事件日志做二次开发的开发者
想用代理自动搜索历史对话、分诊 bug 并生成带出处的回答的项目维护者

en.tag: A self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents build together
en.what: Buzz is a self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents share the same rooms and event log. Built on a Nostr relay, every message, reaction, workflow step, review, and git event is a signed event in one log, giving people and agents the same identity model and audit trail.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust-based relay and client, a series of VISION documents, ARCHITECTURE.md, RELEASING.md, and UI screenshots under docs/assets/screenshots.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it uses the Nostr relay protocol and signed event logs, depends on a large number of Rust crates, and is Apache 2.0 licensed.
en.hot: With 33,443 stars and 498 added today, ranking 11th on GitHub Trending (Rust), its self-hosted 'humans and agents in the same room' narrative hits developers' need for agent controllability and auditability.
uses: Engineering teams that want AI agents in code review and workflows with a full audit trail
Organizations or community operators needing a self-hosted, data-sovereign collaboration platform
Developers studying human-agent hybrid collaboration or building on Nostr event logs
Maintainers who want agents to search history, triage bugs, and answer with receipts

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写 GNU coreutils 的跨平台实现
zh.what: uutils/coreutils 是 GNU coreutils 的 Rust 重写版，目标是成为可直接替换的 drop-in replacement，行为差异被视为 bug。它支持 Linux、macOS、BSD、Windows、WASI 等多平台，让脚本能跨系统迁移。
zh.content: 仓库包含全部核心工具的 Rust 实现、预编译二进制、man 手册、shell 补全，以及用户与开发者文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 libc、libcrypto 等 crate，通过 Cargo 构建，并支持 musl/gnu 等多种目标。
zh.hot: 24k+ stars 且今日仍在增长，加上 Ubuntu 25.10 默认搭载，使其成为 Rust 重写系统工具的标志性项目。
uses: 希望用 Rust 替代 GNU 工具链的开发者与发行版维护者
需要在 Windows/macOS 上运行类 Unix 脚本的跨平台用户
关注系统基础工具性能与国际化支持的工程师
想学习 Rust 大型项目工程实践的开源贡献者

en.tag: Cross-platform Rust rewrite of GNU coreutils
en.what: uutils/coreutils is a Rust reimplementation of GNU coreutils, aiming to be a drop-in replacement where behavioral differences are treated as bugs. It targets Linux, macOS, BSD, Windows, WASI and more, so scripts can move across platforms easily.
en.content: The repo contains Rust implementations of all core utilities, prebuilt binaries, manpages, shell completions, and both user and developer documentation.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, depending on crates like libc and libcrypto, built with Cargo, and supporting musl/gnu and other targets.
en.hot: With 24k+ stars and still growing today, plus shipping by default in Ubuntu 25.10, it has become a flagship project for Rust rewrites of system tools.
uses: Developers and distro maintainers wanting Rust-based replacements for GNU tools
Cross-platform users who need Unix-like scripts on Windows/macOS
Engineers focused on performance and i18n of core system utilities
Open-source contributors learning large-scale Rust engineering practices

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的轻量级 Bitwarden 兼容密码服务器
zh.what: Vaultwarden 是 Bitwarden 客户端 API 的非官方服务端实现，用 Rust 编写，兼容官方 Bitwarden 客户端。它专为自托管场景设计，在资源占用上远低于官方服务，适合在低配服务器或家庭 NAS 上运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Rust 服务端源码、Docker 部署文件、数据库迁移脚本以及 Web 管理界面等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Rocket 框架、Diesel ORM 和 SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL 数据库，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 67,526 颗星和今日新增 115 星登上 GitHub 日榜第 10 名，其轻量、自托管友好的特性深受隐私意识强的用户欢迎。
uses: 希望自托管密码管理服务的个人或家庭用户
在低配服务器或 NAS 上部署密码库的运维人员
注重数据隐私、不愿依赖官方云服务的团队
需要 Bitwarden 兼容 API 的开发者或集成商

en.tag: A lightweight Bitwarden-compatible password server rewritten in Rust
en.what: Vaultwarden is an unofficial server implementation of the Bitwarden Client API, written in Rust and compatible with official Bitwarden clients. It is designed for self-hosted deployments where running the official resource-heavy service may not be ideal, offering a much lighter footprint.
en.content: The repository contains the full Rust server source code, Docker deployment files, database migration scripts, and a web admin interface.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, using the Rocket framework, Diesel ORM, and SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL databases, with Docker deployment support.
en.hot: With 67,526 stars and 115 new stars today, it ranks 10th on GitHub Trending daily, popular among privacy-conscious users for its lightweight, self-hosting-friendly nature.
uses: Individuals or families wanting to self-host a password manager
Sysadmins deploying a password vault on low-spec servers or NAS
Teams prioritizing data privacy over official cloud services
Developers or integrators needing a Bitwarden-compatible API

zh.tag: 用 Rust 打造的低延迟机器人数据流中间件
zh.what: DORA 是面向 AI 机器人应用的数据流中间件，把应用建模为有向图（pipeline），节点间以低延迟、可组合、分布式的方式传递数据。它用 100% Rust 实现，支持 Python 与 Rust API，目标是简化实时机器人系统的搭建。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心与 CLI（dora-cli）、节点 API（dora-node-api）、Python 绑定（dora-rs）、YAML 数据流配置规范、示例、文档与中文用户指南，并附有 1.0 发布博客。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 Rust 为主，使用 Apache Arrow 列式内存格式、Zenoh 共享内存数据面与零拷贝 IPC，并提供 Python 绑定；通过 crates.io 和 PyPI 分发。
zh.hot: 项目刚发布 1.0，宣称比 ROS2 Python 快 10-17 倍，并采用 AI 代理参与开发的“agentic engineering”模式，吸引了 4000+ star，今日登上 Rust 日榜第 14 名。
uses: 机器人工程师：用数据流图快速搭建低延迟的感知-决策-控制管线
AI 应用开发者：把 Python 模型节点接入 Rust 高性能运行时
ROS2 用户：寻找更轻量、更低延迟的替代中间件
研究者与学生：学习 Rust 与 Arrow/Zenoh 构建实时机器人系统

en.tag: A low-latency, Rust-based dataflow middleware for robotics
en.what: DORA is a dataflow middleware for AI-based robotic applications that models apps as directed graphs (pipelines) with low-latency, composable, distributed dataflow. Implemented 100% in Rust with Python and Rust APIs, it aims to simplify building real-time robotics systems.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core and CLI (dora-cli), node APIs (dora-node-api), Python bindings (dora-rs), a YAML dataflow spec, examples, docs with a Chinese user guide, and a 1.0 release blog post.
en.stack: Built primarily in Rust with Apache Arrow columnar memory, Zenoh shared-memory data plane and zero-copy IPC, plus Python bindings; distributed via crates.io and PyPI.
en.hot: Fresh off its 1.0 release, it claims 10-17x speedups over ROS2 Python and uses an 'agentic engineering' model with AI agents contributing code, drawing 4,000+ stars and ranking #14 on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: Robotics engineers: build low-latency perception-decision-control pipelines as dataflow graphs
AI app developers: plug Python model nodes into a high-performance Rust runtime
ROS2 users: seeking a lighter, lower-latency alternative middleware
Researchers and students: learn real-time robotics with Rust, Arrow and Zenoh

zh.tag: 用 git worktree 与 tmux 窗口实现零摩擦并行开发
zh.what: workmux 是一个高度主张化的命令行工具，把 git worktree 和 tmux 窗口绑定成彼此隔离的开发环境。它让每个任务拥有独立的分支、终端状态、编辑器会话和 AI 代理，从而并行推进多个功能而不互相冲突。
zh.content: 仓库以 Rust 源码为主体，包含 add/merge 等命令实现、仪表盘与侧边栏、代理状态显示，以及文档站点和演示截图。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 git worktree 与 tmux，并可选支持 kitty、WezTerm、Zellij 作为窗口后端。
zh.hot: 它切中了多 AI 代理并行开发的痛点，用终端原生方式替代易过时的 GUI，已获 2736 星并登上 Rust 日榜第 15 名。
uses: 同时推进多个功能分支、需要隔离环境的开发者
想并行运行多个 AI 编码代理而避免冲突的用户
习惯 tmux 或终端工作流、追求零摩擦切换的工程师
需要自动化 worktree 初始化与清理的团队

en.tag: Zero-friction parallel dev with git worktrees and tmux windows
en.what: workmux is an opinionated CLI that pairs git worktrees with tmux windows to form isolated development environments. Each task gets its own branch, terminal state, editor session, and AI agent, so multiple features can progress in parallel without conflicts.
en.content: The repo is primarily Rust source code, covering the add/merge commands, a dashboard and sidebar, agent status display, plus docs and demo screenshots.
en.stack: Written in Rust, it builds on git worktrees and tmux, with optional backends for kitty, WezTerm, and Zellij.
en.hot: It targets the pain of running multiple AI agents in parallel, favoring a terminal-native approach over short-lived GUIs, earning 2,736 stars and the #15 spot on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: Developers juggling multiple feature branches who need isolated environments
Users running several AI coding agents in parallel without conflicts
Engineers who prefer tmux or terminal-native workflows with zero friction
Teams wanting automated worktree setup and cleanup

zh.tag: 为 AI Agent 打造的毫秒级硬件隔离安全沙箱服务
zh.what: CubeSandbox 是腾讯云开源的高性能安全沙箱服务，基于 RustVMM 与 KVM 构建，可在 60ms 内创建硬件级隔离的沙箱环境，内存开销低于 5MB。它兼容 E2B SDK，支持单机部署并平滑扩展为多节点集群，为 AI Agent 提供安全、并发、轻量的代码执行环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心服务代码、RustVMM/KVM 虚拟化集成、E2B 兼容 API 层、快速开始与部署文档（docs/guide、docs/index.md）、中文文档及变更日志，并提供 PyPI 上的 cubesandbox 客户端包。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，底层依赖 RustVMM 与 KVM 实现硬件级虚拟化隔离，对外提供兼容 E2B SDK 的 API，并发布 PyPI 客户端包，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 上线即获 12512 星、今日新增 259 星，位列 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 2。AI Agent 爆发式增长让安全代码执行沙箱成为刚需，而 CubeSandbox 以 60ms 启动、5MB 开销和 E2B 兼容切中痛点，加上腾讯云背书与 CNCF Landscape 收录，迅速吸引开发者关注。
uses: AI Agent 开发者：为代码解释器、自动化任务提供安全隔离的执行环境
平台工程与基础设施团队：需要高并发、高密度的沙箱调度能力
已使用 E2B 的团队：希望平滑迁移到自托管、硬件级隔离方案
安全敏感场景：运行不可信代码时要求硬件级隔离与轻量开销

en.tag: Instant, hardware-isolated secure sandbox service for AI agents
en.what: CubeSandbox is a high-performance secure sandbox service open-sourced by Tencent Cloud, built on RustVMM and KVM. It creates hardware-isolated sandboxes in under 60ms with less than 5MB memory overhead, is E2B SDK compatible, and scales from single-node to multi-node clusters for safe AI agent code execution.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core service, RustVMM/KVM virtualization integration, an E2B-compatible API layer, quickstart and deployment docs (docs/guide, docs/index.md), Chinese documentation, a changelog, and a cubesandbox client package on PyPI.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, it relies on RustVMM and KVM for hardware-level virtualization isolation, exposes an E2B SDK-compatible API, ships a PyPI client package, and is licensed under Apache 2.0.
en.hot: It quickly reached 12,512 stars with 259 added today, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending (Go). The AI agent boom makes secure code-execution sandboxes essential, and CubeSandbox's 60ms startup, 5MB overhead, and E2B compatibility hit the sweet spot—boosted by Tencent Cloud backing and CNCF Landscape listing.
uses: AI agent developers: provide isolated execution for code interpreters and automated tasks
Platform and infra teams: need high-concurrency, high-density sandbox scheduling
Teams already on E2B: want to migrate to a self-hosted, hardware-isolated solution
Security-sensitive workloads: run untrusted code with hardware-level isolation and low overhead

zh.tag: 支撑 E2B 云与自托管的 Firecracker 微虚拟机运行时
zh.what: E2B Runtime 是 E2B 云背后的完整后端，包含控制面 API、节点编排器、VM 内代理、边缘路由和模板构建器。它为每个 AI 代理会话提供独立的 Linux 微虚拟机，可从快照秒级恢复、运行不可信代码，并在代理停止时暂停。
zh.content: 仓库包含控制面 API、节点编排器、VM 内代理、边缘路由、模板构建器，以及可在单机运行的 Embed 包。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 1.26 编写，基于 Firecracker microVM、userfaultfd 懒加载和写时复制根文件系统，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 作为 E2B 云的开源核心，它解决了 AI 代理安全执行不可信代码的痛点，今日新增 33 星，登上 Go 日榜第 12 名。
uses: AI 代理平台开发者 —— 需要为代理提供安全隔离的执行环境
基础设施工程师 —— 希望自托管或嵌入 Firecracker 微虚拟机运行时
企业团队 —— 需要专用部署和快照恢复能力
开源贡献者 —— 对 Go 和虚拟化技术感兴趣

en.tag: The Firecracker microVM runtime powering E2B Cloud and self-hosted deployments
en.what: E2B Runtime is the complete backend behind E2B Cloud, including the control-plane API, per-node orchestrator, in-VM agent, edge router, and template builder. It gives every AI agent session its own isolated Linux microVM that resumes from a snapshot, runs untrusted code, and can pause when the agent stops.
en.content: The repo contains the control-plane API, per-node orchestrator, in-VM agent, edge router, template builder, and an Embed package for single-machine use.
en.stack: Written in Go 1.26, built on Firecracker microVMs, userfaultfd lazy paging, and copy-on-write root filesystems, licensed under Apache-2.0.
en.hot: As the open-source core of E2B Cloud, it solves the pain of safely executing untrusted agent code, gaining 33 stars today and ranking #12 on the Go daily trending list.
uses: AI agent platform developers — need secure isolated execution environments for agents
Infrastructure engineers — want to self-host or embed a Firecracker microVM runtime
Enterprise teams — require dedicated deployments and snapshot resume capabilities
Open-source contributors — interested in Go and virtualization

zh.tag: 把本地文件系统一键变成 S3 对象存储网关
zh.what: VersityGW 是一个用 Go 编写的高性能 S3 翻译服务，可以把本地文件系统直接暴露为兼容 S3 协议的对象存储。它支持将 S3 请求代理到其他 S3 存储，也提供 posix 协议兼容，让同一份文件既能通过本地路径访问，也能通过 S3 API 访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 源码、跨平台二进制发布构建（Linux/macOS/BSD/Windows），以及可选的 WebGUI 管理/浏览界面。还提供 S3 over RDMA 支持（含 vgwrdma 服务）和静态网站托管功能，文档以 Wiki 形式组织。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖标准库及 S3 协议相关库，支持 Apache V2 许可证。提供跨平台二进制，并可选集成 NVIDIA cuObject（GPUDirect Storage for Objects）协议用于 RDMA 加速。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 23 颗星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）第 5 名，总星数达 2936。其“一条命令将文件系统变成 S3 服务器”的极简部署方式，加上 RDMA 和静态网站等高级特性，吸引了大量开发者和运维人员。
uses: 需要快速搭建本地 S3 兼容存储进行开发和测试的开发者
希望将现有文件系统通过 S3 协议共享给应用程序或用户的运维人员
在 HPC 或数据密集型场景中需要低延迟、高吞吐对象传输的科研人员
想要为 S3 存储添加静态网站托管功能的个人或团队

en.tag: Turn your local filesystem into an S3 object storage gateway with one command
en.what: VersityGW is a high-performance S3 translation service written in Go that exposes your local filesystem as an S3-compatible object storage server. It can also proxy S3 requests to other S3 storage and offers posix protocol compatibility, allowing the same files to be accessed via local paths or the S3 API.
en.content: The repository contains full Go source code, cross-platform binary release builds (Linux/macOS/BSD/Windows), and an optional WebGUI for management/exploration. It also includes S3 over RDMA support (with the vgwrdma service) and static website hosting, with documentation organized in a Wiki.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on the standard library and S3 protocol-related packages, under the Apache V2 license. It provides cross-platform binaries and optionally integrates NVIDIA's cuObject (GPUDirect Storage for Objects) protocol for RDMA acceleration.
en.hot: The project gained 23 stars today, ranking 5th on GitHub Trending (Go) with a total of 2,936 stars. Its minimal deployment approach—turning a filesystem into an S3 server with a single command—plus advanced features like RDMA and static website hosting, has attracted many developers and operators.
uses: Developers who need to quickly set up local S3-compatible storage for development and testing
Operators who want to share existing filesystems with applications or users via the S3 protocol
Researchers in HPC or data-intensive scenarios requiring low-latency, high-throughput object transfers
Individuals or teams looking to add static website hosting to S3 storage

zh.tag: 一键本地运行开源大模型的跨平台工具
zh.what: Ollama 是一个让用户轻松在本地运行和管理开源大模型的工具，支持 Kimi、GLM、DeepSeek、Qwen、Gemma 等众多模型。它提供命令行界面、REST API 和多种编程语言库，方便集成到现有应用或作为 AI 助手使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Ollama 的完整源代码，包括安装脚本、命令行工具、REST API 服务器、模型管理功能，以及 Python 和 JavaScript 客户端库的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 llama.cpp 等推理后端，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 Docker。
zh.hot: Ollama 已获得 18 万星标，本月新增近 3000，因其让本地运行大模型变得极其简单，成为开发者和 AI 爱好者的首选工具。
uses: 开发者希望在本地快速测试或运行开源模型，无需复杂配置
需要将大模型集成到自己的应用或代理中的团队
关注隐私，希望数据不出本机的个人用户

en.tag: Run open-source LLMs locally with one command
en.what: Ollama is a tool that lets users easily run and manage open-source LLMs locally, supporting models like Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemma, and more. It provides a CLI, REST API, and libraries for multiple languages, making it easy to integrate into existing apps or use as an AI assistant.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Ollama, including installation scripts, CLI tools, REST API server, model management features, and documentation/examples for Python and JavaScript client libraries.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging inference backends like llama.cpp, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, and Docker.
en.hot: With 180k stars and nearly 3k added this month, Ollama is the go-to tool for developers and AI enthusiasts due to its simplicity in running LLMs locally.
uses: Developers who want to quickly test or run open-source models locally without complex setup
Teams needing to integrate LLMs into their applications or agents
Privacy-conscious users who prefer to keep data on their own machines

zh.tag: Tailscale 数据平面版 netcat，无需控制平面与账号
zh.what: Tailcat 把 Tailscale 开源组件重新组合成一个类似 netcat 的工具：一端启动监听并生成简短地址，另一端用该地址连接，流量经 WireGuard 端到端加密。它只借用 Tailscale 的数据平面（magicsock + DERP），连接元数据完全由用户自行带外交换，不需要 Tailscale 账号或管理员权限。
zh.content: 仓库包含可导入的 Go 库（github.com/tailscale/tailcat）、cmd/tailcat 命令行工具，以及编译到 WebAssembly 的浏览器演示，另有 INSTALL.md 列出各平台安装方式。
zh.stack: 主语言 Go，核心依赖 Tailscale 的 magicsock 数据平面与 WireGuard 加密，DERP 作为打洞信令与中继，可自建 derper 或使用默认 DERP 地图。
zh.hot: 凭借「Tailscale without Tailscale, by Tailscale」的巧妙定位，项目已获 7420 星，今日新增 149 星，登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 7 名。
uses: 需要点对点加密传输文件或文本、又不想注册账号或改路由表的开发者
希望把 WireGuard 打洞能力嵌入自己 Go 程序的工程师，可直接导入库
在受限网络下用 DERP 中继做临时安全通道的运维与安全人员
想体验浏览器与 CLI 互传文件的用户，可试用 WebAssembly 演示

en.tag: netcat over Tailscale's data plane, no control plane or account required
en.what: Tailcat remixes Tailscale's open source pieces into a netcat-like tool: one side runs a listener and returns a short address, the other connects with it, and all traffic is end-to-end encrypted with WireGuard. It uses only Tailscale's data plane (magicsock + DERP) while connection metadata is exchanged out of band, requiring no Tailscale account or admin rights.
en.content: It ships an importable Go library (github.com/tailscale/tailcat), the cmd/tailcat CLI, and a WebAssembly browser demo, plus INSTALL.md covering install methods per platform.
en.stack: Written in Go, it builds on Tailscale's magicsock data plane and WireGuard encryption, using DERP for hole-punching signaling and relay, with either the default DERP map or a self-hosted derper.
en.hot: With its clever "Tailscale without Tailscale, by Tailscale" pitch, it has reached 7,420 stars, gaining 149 today and ranking 7th on GitHub Trending's daily Go list.
uses: Developers who want encrypted peer-to-peer file or text transfer without accounts or routing changes
Engineers embedding WireGuard hole-punching into their own Go programs via the importable library
Ops and security folks needing a temporary secure channel over DERP in restricted networks
Users curious about browser-to-CLI file transfer via the WebAssembly demo

zh.tag: 云原生分布式 SQL 数据库，高可用、弹性扩展、可控数据放置
zh.what: CockroachDB 是构建在强一致事务型键值存储之上的分布式 SQL 数据库，可水平扩展，能在磁盘、机器、机架乃至数据中心故障时以极小延迟中断自动恢复。它支持强一致 ACID 事务，并提供熟悉的 SQL 接口来组织、操作和查询数据。
zh.content: 仓库包含数据库核心源码（Go 编写）、docs 文档与媒体资源、构建脚本和部署配置，并提供 CockroachCloud 托管服务与本地集群两种上手路径。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，兼容 PostgreSQL 线协议，可直接使用现有 PostgreSQL 驱动和 ORM；依赖分布式共识、事务与存储引擎等自研组件。
zh.hot: 作为老牌分布式数据库代表，累计 32528 星，今日再登 Go 日榜第 8，说明云原生与高可用数据库仍是开发者长期关注的基础设施热点。
uses: 需要跨地域高可用与弹性扩展的在线业务后端团队
希望从单机 PostgreSQL 平滑迁移到分布式 SQL 的开发者
构建金融、电商等强一致事务场景的数据平台工程师
学习分布式数据库架构与共识算法的学生和研究者

en.tag: Cloud-native distributed SQL database for high availability, effortless scale, and data placement control
en.what: CockroachDB is a distributed SQL database built on a transactional, strongly-consistent key-value store that scales horizontally and survives disk, machine, rack, and even datacenter failures with minimal latency disruption and no manual intervention. It supports strongly-consistent ACID transactions and offers a familiar SQL API for structuring, manipulating, and querying data.
en.content: The repo contains the core database source in Go, docs and media assets, build scripts and deployment configs, plus paths for both CockroachCloud managed service and local cluster setup.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it speaks the PostgreSQL wire protocol so existing PostgreSQL drivers and ORMs work out of the box; it relies on in-house distributed consensus, transaction, and storage engine components.
en.hot: As a veteran distributed database, it has 32,528 stars and still ranks No.8 on the Go daily trending list, showing cloud-native, high-availability databases remain a lasting infrastructure hotspot.
uses: Backend teams needing cross-region high availability and elastic scaling
Developers migrating from single-node PostgreSQL to distributed SQL
Data platform engineers building strongly-consistent transactional systems for finance or e-commerce
Students and researchers studying distributed database architecture and consensus algorithms

zh.tag: 基于 YAML 模板的高性能漏洞扫描器，由全球安全社区驱动
zh.what: Nuclei 是一款高性能漏洞扫描器，使用简单的 YAML DSL 编写检测模板，可覆盖应用、API、网络、DNS 与云配置等目标。它依靠社区贡献的模板库快速跟进最新漏洞，并宣称实现零误报的检测场景。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Go 编写的扫描引擎与 CLI，配套文档、多语言 README 和静态资源；实际检测规则存放在独立的 nuclei-templates 模板库中。
zh.stack: 核心使用 Go 语言开发，基于 YAML 模板 DSL 与模板引擎，支持通过 go install 或二进制方式安装，并可与 ProjectDiscovery 生态工具联动。
zh.hot: 已积累约 3.1 万 star，今日新增 33 星并登上 GitHub Go 日榜第 9，说明安全社区对可协作、可扩展的漏洞检测工具需求持续旺盛。
uses: 安全工程师与渗透测试人员，用于快速验证目标资产是否存在已知漏洞
企业安全团队，将 Nuclei 集成到 CI/CD 或定期扫描流程中做持续安全检测
漏洞赏金猎人与红队成员，借助社区模板库跟进最新披露的漏洞
安全研究者与模板作者，通过编写 YAML 模板贡献检测规则并共享给社区

en.tag: A fast, YAML-template-driven vulnerability scanner powered by the global security community
en.what: Nuclei is a high-performance vulnerability scanner that uses a simple YAML-based DSL to define detection templates for applications, APIs, networks, DNS, and cloud configurations. It relies on a community-contributed template library to keep pace with trending vulnerabilities while aiming for zero false positives.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based scanning engine and CLI, along with documentation, multi-language READMEs, and static assets; the actual detection rules live in the separate nuclei-templates library.
en.stack: Built in Go with a YAML-based template DSL and template engine, installable via go install or prebuilt binaries, and designed to integrate with the wider ProjectDiscovery tool ecosystem.
en.hot: With roughly 31.3k stars, +33 today, and a #9 spot on the GitHub Go daily trending list, it shows sustained demand for collaborative, extensible vulnerability detection tooling.
uses: Security engineers and pentesters who need to quickly verify known vulnerabilities across target assets
Enterprise security teams integrating Nuclei into CI/CD or scheduled scanning for continuous security checks
Bug bounty hunters and red teamers who follow newly disclosed vulnerabilities via the community template library
Security researchers and template authors who write YAML templates and share detection rules with the community

zh.tag: 云与边缘原生的高性能消息系统服务端
zh.what: NATS 是一个简单、安全、高性能的通信系统，用于连接数字系统、服务和设备。nats-server 是它的核心服务端，可部署在本地、云端、边缘甚至树莓派上。它隶属于 CNCF，支持超过 40 种客户端语言实现。
zh.content: 仓库包含 NATS 服务端完整源码，涵盖核心消息路由、JetStream 持久化、集群与网关、账户与安全认证等模块，并提供 Docker 镜像与多平台发布产物。
zh.stack: 以 Go 语言编写，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，依赖标准 Go 工具链与 CI 测试流程，官方提供 Docker 镜像及多平台二进制发布。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，NATS 是云原生消息中间件的主流选择，已积累 20777 颗星，今日再登 Go 日榜第 10，社区活跃度持续稳定。
uses: 微服务架构师，用于服务间低延迟异步通信与解耦
云原生与边缘计算团队，构建跨云、跨边缘的统一消息总线
IoT 与设备接入开发者，在树莓派等轻量设备上运行消息服务
需要 JetStream 持久化与流式处理的实时数据平台团队

en.tag: High-performance messaging server for cloud and edge native systems
en.what: NATS is a simple, secure and performant communications system for digital systems, services and devices. nats-server is its core server, deployable on-premise, in the cloud, at the edge, or even on a Raspberry Pi. It is a CNCF project with over 40 client language implementations.
en.content: The repo holds the full NATS server source, covering core message routing, JetStream persistence, clustering and gateways, accounts and security, plus Docker images and multi-platform release artifacts.
en.stack: Written in Go under Apache 2.0, built with the standard Go toolchain and CI test workflows, shipping official Docker images and multi-platform binaries.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, NATS is a mainstream choice for cloud-native messaging, with 20,777 stars and another Go daily trending spot at #10, showing steady community activity.
uses: Microservice architects needing low-latency async communication and decoupling between services
Cloud-native and edge teams building a unified message bus across cloud and edge
IoT and device developers running messaging on lightweight hardware like Raspberry Pi
Real-time data platform teams needing JetStream persistence and stream processing

zh.tag: 让编码代理像原始人一样说话，省下 65% token 的代理技能与代理层
zh.what: Caveman 是一个面向 AI 编码代理的技能（skill）与代理（proxy），通过强制代理用极简的“原始人式”语言输出，把 token 消耗削减约 65%。它不改模型本身，而是在代理与模型之间做一层输出压缩，从而直接降低按 token 计费的账单。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Go 编写的代理/CLI 核心、可一键安装的 skill 包（npx skills add）、10 个原生代理包装配置以及 30+ 代理的兼容说明文档，另附 logo、演示视频与安装指南。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，提供 npm 包 @caveman-ai/cli 与 skills.sh 技能分发，支持 30+ 编码代理、10 个原生包装配置，采用 MIT + BSL 双许可。
zh.hot: 凭借“少 token 多干活”的反差梗和 ThePrimeagen 反应视频迅速走红，登上 GitHub Trending 与 Hacker News 第一，已积累 10.6 万 star，今日仍新增 229 星。
uses: 按 token 计费、想压低 AI 编码代理账单的个人开发者与团队
使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 30+ 代理、希望零改造接入省 token 的用户
关注代理输出压缩与成本优化的 AI 工程与平台工程师
想研究提示词/输出风格对成本与质量影响的 AI 研究者

en.tag: A viral skill + proxy that makes coding agents talk like cavemen to cut 65% of tokens
en.what: Caveman is a skill and proxy for AI coding agents that cuts token usage by roughly 65% by forcing agents to speak in terse, caveman-style language. It doesn't change the model itself; it compresses agent output at the layer between agent and model, directly lowering token-based bills.
en.content: The repo ships a Go-based proxy/CLI core, a one-command installable skill package (npx skills add), 10 native agent wrap profiles, and compatibility docs for 30+ agents, plus logos, a demo video, and install guides.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, distributed via the npm package @caveman-ai/cli and skills.sh, supporting 30+ coding agents and 10 native wrap profiles under an MIT + BSL dual license.
en.hot: It went viral on the back of the 'few token do trick' meme and a ThePrimeagen reaction video, topping GitHub Trending and Hacker News, and now sits at 106k stars with 229 added today.
uses: Individual devs and teams billed by tokens who want to shrink their AI coding agent bills
Users of Claude Code, Cursor and 30+ other agents who want zero-effort token savings
AI and platform engineers interested in agent output compression and cost optimization
AI researchers studying how prompt/output style affects cost and quality

zh.tag: gRPC 的 Go 语言官方实现，基于 HTTP/2 的高性能 RPC 框架
zh.what: gRPC-Go 是 gRPC 的 Go 语言实现，一个高性能、开源的通用 RPC 框架，以移动端和 HTTP/2 优先为设计理念。它让 Go 服务之间可以通过 Protocol Buffers 定义接口，进行高效的双向流式通信。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 gRPC 运行时库、底层技术文档（Documentation 目录）、性能基准测试、示例代码（examples）以及贡献指南等。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言编写，依赖 Protocol Buffers 和 HTTP/2 协议，通过 Go modules 管理依赖，导入路径为 google.golang.org/grpc。
zh.hot: 作为云原生微服务通信的事实标准之一，gRPC-Go 拥有 23102 颗星，今日新增 3 星并登上 Go 日榜第 12 名，持续受到服务端开发者的关注。
uses: 构建微服务架构的后端 Go 开发者，需要高性能服务间通信
需要跨语言 RPC 调用的团队，利用 Protocol Buffers 定义接口
学习 HTTP/2 和现代 RPC 框架原理的学生或工程师

en.tag: The official Go implementation of gRPC, a high-performance HTTP/2-based RPC framework
en.what: gRPC-Go is the Go implementation of gRPC, a high-performance, open-source, general-purpose RPC framework that puts mobile and HTTP/2 first. It lets Go services communicate efficiently via Protocol Buffers-defined interfaces, including bidirectional streaming.
en.content: The repo contains the core gRPC runtime library, low-level technical docs (Documentation), performance benchmarks, examples, and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Written in Go, it relies on Protocol Buffers and HTTP/2, managed via Go modules, and imported as google.golang.org/grpc.
en.hot: As a de facto standard for cloud-native microservice communication, gRPC-Go has 23,102 stars, gained 3 today, and ranks 12th on the Go daily trending list, drawing steady attention from backend developers.
uses: Backend Go developers building microservices who need high-performance inter-service communication
Teams needing cross-language RPC calls defined via Protocol Buffers
Students or engineers learning HTTP/2 and modern RPC framework internals

zh.tag: 持久化执行平台，让分布式应用自动容错重试
zh.what: Temporal 是一个持久化执行平台，让开发者构建可扩展的应用时无需牺牲生产力与可靠性。服务端以弹性方式执行称为 Workflow 的应用逻辑单元，自动处理间歇性故障并重试失败操作。它源自 Uber 的 Cadence 分支，由原班人马创立的 Temporal Technologies 维护。
zh.content: 仓库是 Temporal 服务端核心实现，包含 Workflow 引擎、历史/匹配/前端等服务组件，并配套 CLI、Web UI 与 Go/Java 示例。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，依赖 gRPC、Protobuf、Cassandra/MySQL/PostgreSQL 等持久化存储，提供多语言 SDK。
zh.hot: 23k+ star 的成熟基础设施项目，今日再登 Go 日榜第 13，说明持久化执行正成为微服务与 AI 工作流编排的刚需。
uses: 需要构建长流程、多步骤且要求高可靠性的后端工程师
希望用代码而非复杂状态机编排分布式事务的团队
为 AI Agent 或数据处理管道提供可靠执行引擎的开发者
想学习工业级 Go 分布式系统架构的进阶读者

en.tag: Durable execution platform that makes distributed apps fault-tolerant and retryable
en.what: Temporal is a durable execution platform that lets developers build scalable applications without sacrificing productivity or reliability. The server executes units of application logic called Workflows resiliently, automatically handling intermittent failures and retrying failed operations. It originated as a fork of Uber's Cadence and is maintained by Temporal Technologies, founded by Cadence's creators.
en.content: The repo is the core Temporal server implementation, containing the Workflow engine and history/matching/frontend service components, plus CLI, Web UI, and Go/Java samples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, it relies on gRPC, Protobuf, and persistence stores like Cassandra/MySQL/PostgreSQL, with multi-language SDKs.
en.hot: A mature 23k+ star infrastructure project, it re-enters the Go daily trending list at #13, showing durable execution is becoming essential for microservices and AI workflow orchestration.
uses: Backend engineers building long-running, multi-step, highly reliable processes
Teams wanting to orchestrate distributed transactions in code instead of complex state machines
Developers needing a reliable execution engine for AI agents or data pipelines
Advanced readers studying industrial-grade Go distributed system architecture

zh.tag: 生产级容器编排与集群管理系统
zh.what: Kubernetes（K8s）是一个开源系统，用于跨多台主机管理容器化应用，提供服务部署、维护与扩缩容的基础机制。它源于 Google 十五年大规模生产经验（Borg 系统），现由 CNCF 托管。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kubernetes 核心源码（Go 编写），涵盖 API Server、调度器、控制器、kubelet、kubectl 等组件，以及构建脚本、测试套件和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 etcd、容器运行时（containerd/CRI-O）、CNI 网络插件等云原生生态组件。
zh.hot: 作为云原生领域的基石项目，Kubernetes 拥有 127,814 颗星，今日新增 29 星，稳居 GitHub Go 语言日榜第 14 名，持续吸引全球开发者关注。
uses: 运维工程师与平台团队：用于大规模容器化应用的部署、扩缩容与故障自愈
开发者：通过 kubectl 和 API 管理微服务架构，实现持续交付
企业架构师：构建混合云/多云环境下的统一调度与资源管理平台
云原生学习者：通过源码和文档深入理解容器编排原理

en.tag: Production-grade container scheduling and cluster management
en.what: Kubernetes (K8s) is an open source system for managing containerized applications across multiple hosts, providing basic mechanisms for deployment, maintenance, and scaling. It builds on Google's 15 years of production experience with Borg and is hosted by the CNCF.
en.content: The repo contains Kubernetes core source code in Go, including the API server, scheduler, controllers, kubelet, kubectl, plus build scripts, test suites, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it depends on etcd, container runtimes (containerd/CRI-O), CNI network plugins, and other cloud-native ecosystem components.
en.hot: As the cornerstone of cloud-native computing, Kubernetes has 127,814 stars with 29 added today, ranking 14th on GitHub's daily Go trending list, continuously drawing global developer attention.
uses: DevOps engineers and platform teams: deploy, scale, and self-heal containerized applications at scale
Developers: manage microservices architecture via kubectl and API for continuous delivery
Enterprise architects: build unified scheduling and resource management across hybrid/multi-cloud
Cloud-native learners: study source code and docs to understand container orchestration principles

zh.tag: Kubernetes 上的有状态单例沙箱编排器，为 AI 代理运行时与强化学习提供隔离环境
zh.what: agent-sandbox 是 Kubernetes SIG Apps 下的项目，提供 Sandbox CRD 与控制器，用于声明式管理隔离、有状态、单例的工作负载。它把底层容器隔离交给 gVisor、Kata Containers 等安全运行时，自身专注于沙箱编排，适合 AI 代理运行时和强化学习等场景。
zh.content: 仓库核心是 Sandbox CRD 与控制器，另有 extensions 模块提供 SandboxTemplate、SandboxClaim、SandboxWarmPool 等扩展 CRD，并附有 examples、docs 站点与 roadmap。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 编写，基于 Kubernetes controller 模式与 CRD/Operator 机制，依赖 RuntimeClass 对接 gVisor、Kata Containers 等安全沙箱运行时。
zh.hot: AI 代理与强化学习需要大量隔离、有状态且可快速分配的运行环境，而 Kubernetes 原生 Deployment/StatefulSet 并不贴合这一模型；项目本周新增 114 star、总计 3893 star，登上 Go 周榜第 7。
uses: AI 代理平台团队：为每个代理会话提供隔离、有状态且可持久化的运行沙箱
强化学习工程团队：批量创建和回收训练/推理环境，缩短环境准备时间
Kubernetes 平台工程师：需要单容器 VM 式体验而非无状态副本或编号 StatefulSet 的场景
安全敏感场景：借助 gVisor/Kata 等运行时隔离不可信代码或第三方代理插件

en.tag: A Kubernetes sandbox orchestrator for isolated, stateful singleton workloads like AI agent runtimes and RL
en.what: agent-sandbox is a Kubernetes SIG Apps project that provides a Sandbox CRD and controller for declaratively managing isolated, stateful, singleton workloads. It delegates low-level container isolation to secure runtimes like gVisor or Kata Containers, focusing on sandbox orchestration for AI agent runtimes and reinforcement learning.
en.content: At its core are the Sandbox CRD and controller, plus an extensions module with SandboxTemplate, SandboxClaim, and SandboxWarmPool CRDs, along with examples, a docs site, and a roadmap.
en.stack: Written in Go, it follows the Kubernetes controller pattern with CRDs/operators, and relies on RuntimeClass to integrate secure sandbox runtimes such as gVisor and Kata Containers.
en.hot: AI agents and RL need many isolated, stateful, quickly allocatable runtimes, which native Deployments/StatefulSets don't fit well; the project gained 114 stars this week for 3,893 total, ranking 7th on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: AI agent platform teams: give each agent session an isolated, stateful, persistent runtime sandbox
RL engineering teams: batch-create and recycle training/inference environments to cut setup time
Kubernetes platform engineers: scenarios needing a single-container VM-like experience instead of stateless replicas or numbered StatefulSets
Security-sensitive workloads: isolate untrusted code or third-party agent plugins via gVisor/Kata runtimes

zh.tag: 自托管的云端开发环境与 AI 编码代理平台
zh.what: Coder 是一个可自托管的平台，用 Terraform 定义云端开发环境（工作区），通过安全的 WireGuard 隧道连接，闲置时自动关闭以节省成本。它还内置 AI 编码代理，代理循环运行在你自己的控制平面中，工作区内无需存放任何 API 密钥。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的服务端与 CLI、Terraform 模板与 provider、Web 管理界面、文档和安装脚本，可部署到 EC2、Kubernetes、Docker 等多种基础设施。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 开发，依赖 Terraform 定义基础设施，采用 WireGuard 隧道保障连接安全，并支持接入 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、Bedrock 或自托管模型。
zh.hot: 凭借 14612 颗星和今日新增 83 星登上 Go 日榜第 16 名，反映出开发者对自托管、安全且带 AI 代理的云端开发环境需求旺盛。
uses: 需要为团队统一管理云端开发环境并控制成本的平台工程团队
希望让 AI 编码代理在自己基础设施上运行、避免密钥外泄的企业
使用 Terraform 管理基础设施、追求可审计与合规的开发组织
想快速为新人开通开发环境、缩短入职时间的工程团队

en.tag: Self-hosted cloud development environments and AI coding agents
en.what: Coder is a self-hosted platform for cloud development environments and AI coding agents. Workspaces are defined with Terraform, connected through a secure WireGuard tunnel, and automatically shut down when idle; its native AI agent runs in your control plane with no API keys inside workspaces.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based server and CLI, Terraform templates and providers, a web admin UI, docs, and install scripts, deployable across EC2, Kubernetes, Docker, and more.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it relies on Terraform for infrastructure definitions, uses WireGuard tunnels for secure connectivity, and supports Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Bedrock, or self-hosted models.
en.hot: With 14,612 stars and 83 added today, ranking 16th on the Go daily trending list, it reflects strong demand for self-hosted, secure cloud dev environments with AI agents.
uses: Platform engineering teams needing unified, cost-controlled cloud dev environments
Enterprises wanting AI coding agents on their own infra without leaking API keys
Organizations using Terraform that require auditable, compliant infrastructure
Engineering teams aiming to onboard developers in seconds instead of days

zh.tag: 谷歌开源的数据库 MCP 服务器，让 AI 代理直连企业数据库
zh.what: MCP Toolbox for Databases 是一个开源的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，让 AI 代理、IDE 和应用直接连接企业数据库。它兼具双重用途：既可作为开箱即用的 MCP 服务器，用预置通用工具让 Gemini CLI、Claude Code 等客户端即时查询数据、探索 schema；也可作为自定义工具框架，为生产级代理构建安全的结构化查询、语义搜索与 NL2SQL 能力。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 实现核心服务器，包含 docs 文档、架构图与示例，并提供 Python、JS/TS、Go、Java 多语言 SDK 及预置工具集。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，采用 Apache 2.0 许可；依赖 MCP 协议，并提供 toolbox-core（PyPI）、@toolbox-sdk/core（npm）、mcp-toolbox-sdk-go 与 Java SDK 等客户端库。
zh.hot: 作为谷歌官方出品的数据库 MCP 方案，它踩中 AI 代理连接企业数据的热点，已积累 16417 stars，今日再登 Go 日榜第 10。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等 MCP 客户端的开发者，想直接对话数据库
需要为生产级 AI 代理构建安全数据库工具的后端与数据工程师
希望用 NL2SQL、语义搜索快速接入企业数据的团队
评估 MCP 生态与数据库集成方案的技术决策者

en.tag: Google's open-source MCP server connecting AI agents directly to enterprise databases
en.what: MCP Toolbox for Databases is an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that connects AI agents, IDEs, and applications directly to enterprise databases. It serves a dual purpose: a ready-to-use MCP server with prebuilt generic tools for clients like Gemini CLI and Claude Code, and a custom tools framework for building secure structured queries, semantic search, and NL2SQL capabilities for production agents.
en.content: The repo implements the core server in Go, with docs, architecture diagrams, and examples, plus multi-language SDKs for Python, JS/TS, Go, and Java alongside prebuilt tools.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go under Apache 2.0, it relies on the MCP protocol and ships client SDKs including toolbox-core (PyPI), @toolbox-sdk/core (npm), mcp-toolbox-sdk-go, and a Java SDK.
en.hot: As Google's official database MCP solution, it rides the wave of AI agents connecting to enterprise data, with 16,417 stars and a #10 spot on today's Go trending list.
uses: Developers using MCP clients like Claude Code or Gemini CLI who want to talk to databases directly
Backend and data engineers building secure database tools for production AI agents
Teams wanting fast enterprise data access via NL2SQL and semantic search
Technical decision-makers evaluating MCP ecosystem and database integration options

zh.tag: 企业级密钥管理与特权访问控制平台
zh.what: Vault 是 HashiCorp 推出的密钥管理工具，用于安全存储 API Key、密码、证书等敏感信息，并提供统一的访问控制与审计日志。它还支持动态密钥生成、加密即服务（Encryption as a Service）以及特权访问管理，解决现代分布式系统中密钥散落、难以追踪的问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Vault 核心服务端与 CLI 的 Go 源码，涵盖 secrets engine、auth method、storage backend、审计设备等模块，并配有完整的文档、教程链接与安全披露流程。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 HashiCorp 自研的 Raft、Consul 等存储与集群组件，支持插件化扩展，可对接 AWS、SQL 数据库、Kubernetes 等多种后端。
zh.hot: 作为基础设施安全领域的标杆项目，Vault 已积累 36,309 颗 Star，今日新增 13 颗并登上 Go 日榜第 18 名，说明在云原生与零信任趋势下，密钥管理仍是开发者持续关注的核心议题。
uses: 需要集中管理数据库凭证、API Key 和证书的运维与安全团队
构建微服务或云原生架构、希望实现动态密钥与最小权限的开发者
需要满足合规审计要求、记录敏感数据访问日志的企业
希望将加密能力以服务形式集成到应用中的后端工程师

en.tag: Enterprise-grade secrets management and privileged access platform
en.what: Vault is HashiCorp's tool for securely storing and accessing secrets such as API keys, passwords, and certificates, with unified access control and detailed audit logging. It also offers dynamic secret generation, encryption as a service, and privileged access management, solving the problem of scattered, hard-to-track credentials in modern distributed systems.
en.content: The repo contains the Go source for Vault's core server and CLI, covering secrets engines, auth methods, storage backends, and audit devices, along with full documentation, tutorial links, and a security disclosure process.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it relies on HashiCorp's own Raft and Consul for storage and clustering, supports pluggable extensions, and integrates with backends like AWS, SQL databases, and Kubernetes.
en.hot: As a benchmark project in infrastructure security, Vault has accumulated 36,309 stars, gaining 13 today and ranking 18th on the Go daily trending list, showing that secrets management remains a core concern for developers amid cloud-native and zero-trust trends.
uses: Ops and security teams needing centralized management of database credentials, API keys, and certificates
Developers building microservices or cloud-native architectures who want dynamic secrets and least privilege
Enterprises needing compliance audits and detailed logs of sensitive data access
Backend engineers looking to integrate encryption-as-a-service into their applications

zh.tag: Kubernetes 上最流行的 PostgreSQL Operator
zh.what: CloudNativePG 是一个开源平台，用于在 Kubernetes 环境中无缝管理 PostgreSQL 数据库。它通过核心的 Operator 组件覆盖从部署到日常维护的整个运维生命周期，让 PostgreSQL 成为 GitOps 驱动 CI/CD 流程中的原生一环。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CloudNativePG Operator 的 Go 源码、CRD 定义、文档与快速入门指南，以及贡献、治理、采用者等社区文件。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，基于 Kubernetes Operator 模式与 API 直接集成，不依赖 Patroni、repmgr 或 Stolon 等外部高可用工具。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF Landscape 项目，它已积累 9364 颗星，今日新增 9 星并登上 Go 日榜第 19 名，是 K8s 上 PostgreSQL 运维的事实标准之一。
uses: 在 Kubernetes 上运行生产级 PostgreSQL 集群的运维与平台工程师
需要 GitOps 与 CI/CD 自动化数据库生命周期的团队
希望用 Operator 替代 Patroni/repmgr 等外部高可用方案的架构师
评估云原生数据库基础设施的 DevOps 与 SRE 人员

en.tag: The most popular Kubernetes Operator for PostgreSQL
en.what: CloudNativePG is an open-source platform designed to seamlessly manage PostgreSQL databases in Kubernetes environments. Through its core operator component, it covers the entire operational lifecycle from deployment to ongoing maintenance, making PostgreSQL a native part of GitOps-driven CI/CD automation.
en.content: The repo contains the Go source of the CloudNativePG Operator, CRD definitions, documentation and quickstart guides, plus community files for contributing, governance and adopters.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, it follows the Kubernetes Operator pattern and integrates directly with the Kubernetes API, without relying on external HA tools like Patroni, repmgr or Stolon.
en.hot: As a CNCF Landscape project, it has gathered 9,364 stars, added 9 today and ranked 19th on the Go daily trending list, making it a de facto standard for running PostgreSQL on K8s.
uses: Ops and platform engineers running production PostgreSQL clusters on Kubernetes
Teams needing GitOps and CI/CD automation for database lifecycle
Architects replacing external HA tools like Patroni/repmgr with an Operator
DevOps and SRE staff evaluating cloud-native database infrastructure

zh.tag: 基于eBPF的云原生网络、安全与可观测性平台
zh.what: Cilium 是一个基于 eBPF 数据平面的网络、可观测性和安全解决方案。它提供简单的扁平三层网络，支持多集群原生路由或覆盖模式，并具备 L7 协议感知能力，可基于身份模型实施 L3-L7 网络策略。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cilium 核心组件（如 agent、operator、CNI 插件）、eBPF 数据平面代码、文档、测试和部署清单。主要目录有 daemon、pkg、bpf、Documentation、operator 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Linux 内核 eBPF 技术，需要较新内核版本（通常 4.19+）。项目使用 Kubernetes 作为主要编排平台，并集成 Prometheus、Envoy 等生态组件。
zh.hot: Cilium 是 CNCF 毕业项目，拥有 25k+ stars，今日新增 20 stars，位列 Go 趋势榜第 20 名。作为 Kubernetes 网络、安全和可观测性的领先方案，它持续受到云原生社区的高度关注。
uses: Kubernetes 集群管理员：需要高性能、可扩展的网络方案来替代 kube-proxy。
云原生安全工程师：希望实施基于身份的网络策略和 L7 层安全控制。
平台运维团队：需要深度网络可观测性和故障排查能力。
服务网格架构师：寻求集成 ingress/egress 网关和带宽管理的一体化方案。

en.tag: eBPF-based networking, security, and observability for cloud native
en.what: Cilium is a networking, observability, and security solution with an eBPF-based dataplane. It provides a simple flat Layer 3 network that can span multiple clusters in native routing or overlay mode, and is L7-protocol aware, enforcing network policies on L3-L7 using an identity-based security model.
en.content: The repository contains Cilium core components (such as agent, operator, CNI plugin), eBPF dataplane code, documentation, tests, and deployment manifests. Main directories include daemon, pkg, bpf, Documentation, operator, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on Linux kernel eBPF technology and requiring a relatively new kernel (typically 4.19+). The project uses Kubernetes as the main orchestration platform and integrates with ecosystem components like Prometheus and Envoy.
en.hot: Cilium is a CNCF graduated project with 25k+ stars, gaining 20 stars today and ranking 20th on the Go trending list. As a leading solution for Kubernetes networking, security, and observability, it continues to attract significant attention from the cloud native community.
uses: Kubernetes cluster administrators: need a high-performance, scalable networking solution to replace kube-proxy.
Cloud native security engineers: want to implement identity-based network policies and L7 security controls.
Platform operations teams: require deep network observability and troubleshooting capabilities.
Service mesh architects: seek an integrated solution with ingress/egress gateways and bandwidth management.

zh.tag: 默认启用 HTTPS 的可扩展多平台 Web 服务器
zh.what: Caddy 是一个用 Go 编写的开源 Web 服务器，支持 HTTP/1.1、HTTP/2 和 HTTP/3，并默认自动为站点申请和续期 TLS 证书。它同时是一个可扩展的服务器平台，通过模块化架构可承载反向代理、负载均衡、静态文件服务等能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Caddy 核心源码（cmd、modules、caddyconfig 等目录）、Caddyfile 配置解析器、内置模块（HTTP 处理、TLS、反向代理等）以及完整的文档与测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 CertMagic 实现自动 HTTPS，通过 Go modules 管理依赖，可编译为无外部依赖的静态二进制文件。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 上最受欢迎的 Go Web 服务器之一，累计约 7.58 万 star，今日再登 Go 日榜第 21 名，说明其自动 HTTPS 与易用性持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 运维与后端工程师：快速部署带自动 HTTPS 的 Web 服务与反向代理
个人开发者与小型团队：用简单 Caddyfile 替代 Nginx 配置，降低运维成本
需要 HTTP/3 或自动证书管理的生产环境项目
学习 Go 与服务器架构的开发者：研究模块化设计与 TLS 自动化实现

en.tag: Extensible multi-platform web server with automatic HTTPS by default
en.what: Caddy is an open-source web server written in Go that supports HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3, and automatically obtains and renews TLS certificates by default. It is also an extensible server platform whose modular architecture handles reverse proxying, load balancing and static file serving.
en.content: The repo contains Caddy's core source (cmd, modules, caddyconfig, etc.), the Caddyfile config parser, built-in modules (HTTP handlers, TLS, reverse proxy and more), plus full docs and tests.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it relies on CertMagic for automatic HTTPS, manages dependencies via Go modules, and compiles into a static binary with no external dependencies.
en.hot: As one of the most popular Go web servers on GitHub with roughly 75.8k stars, it re-entered the Go daily trending list at #21 today, showing its automatic HTTPS and ease of use keep drawing developer attention.
uses: DevOps and backend engineers: quickly deploy web services and reverse proxies with automatic HTTPS
Individual developers and small teams: replace Nginx configs with a simple Caddyfile to cut ops overhead
Production projects needing HTTP/3 or automatic certificate management
Developers learning Go and server architecture: study its modular design and TLS automation

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的安全零配置覆盖网络，支持 SSO 与细粒度访问控制
zh.what: NetBird 把设备自动连接成基于 WireGuard 的加密覆盖网络，无需开放端口或配置复杂防火墙。它同时提供集中式访问控制系统，通过 SSO、MFA 和细粒度策略管理远程访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的客户端与管理服务端、agent-network/ 代理网络模块、文档与部署脚本，配套独立的 Web 管理面板仓库。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，基于 WireGuard 协议，依赖 SSO/MFA 身份认证组件，提供公共 API 与多平台客户端。
zh.hot: 近 3 万 star 且今日新增 44，说明零信任组网与自托管 VPN 替代方案持续受关注，Go 生态热度高。
uses: 需要为团队或家庭搭建安全私有网络的运维与开发人员
希望用 SSO/MFA 统一管理远程访问权限的企业 IT 管理员
想自托管替代传统 VPN 网关、简化防火墙配置的技术团队
关注 AI 代理安全访问 LLM API 与私有资源的平台工程师

en.tag: Secure zero-config WireGuard overlay network with SSO and granular access control
en.what: NetBird connects devices into a WireGuard-based encrypted overlay network without opening ports or configuring firewalls. It also provides centralized access control with SSO, MFA, and granular policies for secure remote access.
en.content: The repo contains the Go client and management server, an agent-network/ module, docs and deployment scripts, plus a companion web dashboard repository.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on the WireGuard protocol, with SSO/MFA identity components, a public API, and multi-platform clients.
en.hot: With nearly 29.3k stars and 44 added today, it reflects sustained interest in zero-trust networking and self-hosted VPN alternatives within the Go ecosystem.
uses: Ops and developers needing a secure private network for teams or homes
IT admins wanting SSO/MFA-based centralized remote access control
Teams seeking a self-hosted alternative to traditional VPN gateways
Platform engineers securing AI agent access to LLM APIs and private resources

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 的 C++ 测试框架，用于编写和运行单元测试。它支持自动测试发现、丰富的断言、死亡测试、参数化测试等，并集成了 GoogleMock 用于模拟对象。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GoogleTest 和 GoogleMock 的源码、文档、示例以及构建配置。文档托管在 GitHub Pages 上，提供用户指南和入门教程。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，要求 C++17 或更高版本（1.18.x 分支）。计划依赖 Abseil 库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方测试框架，拥有近 3.9 万 Star，是 C++ 社区的事实标准，持续维护并发布新版本。
uses: C++ 开发者编写单元测试，确保代码质量
需要模拟对象进行依赖隔离的测试场景
在 CI/CD 流程中集成自动化测试
学习 xUnit 测试框架设计的最佳实践

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework for writing and running unit tests. It supports automatic test discovery, rich assertions, death tests, parameterized tests, and integrates GoogleMock for mocking.
en.content: The repository contains source code, documentation, examples, and build configuration for GoogleTest and GoogleMock. Docs are hosted on GitHub Pages with user guide and primer.
en.stack: Built on C++, requires C++17 or later (1.18.x branch). Plans to depend on Abseil.
en.hot: As Google's official testing framework, it has nearly 39k stars, is the de facto standard in C++ community, and is actively maintained with new releases.
uses: C++ developers writing unit tests to ensure code quality
Scenarios requiring mocking objects for dependency isolation
Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Learning best practices of xUnit test framework design

zh.tag: 进程内分析型 SQL 数据库，极速查询 CSV/Parquet
zh.what: DuckDB 是一个高性能的分析型数据库系统，设计为快速、可靠、可移植且易于使用。它支持丰富的 SQL 方言，包括复杂子查询、窗口函数、复杂类型等，并可直接查询 CSV 和 Parquet 文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DuckDB 的完整源代码、文档、扩展机制以及多种客户端（Python、R、Java、Wasm 等）的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++17 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，支持 Python 3 等开发环境。
zh.hot: 作为进程内分析数据库的标杆，DuckDB 凭借其极简部署和高性能查询，在数据科学领域迅速走红，star 数已突破 4 万，今日新增 69 个。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师，希望在 Python 或 R 环境中快速分析大型数据集，无需单独部署数据库服务器。
数据工程师，需要将 CSV/Parquet 文件直接作为 SQL 查询源，简化数据管道。
应用开发者，希望嵌入分析能力到现有应用中，提供轻量级 OLAP 功能。

en.tag: In-process analytical SQL database, blazing fast queries on CSV/Parquet
en.what: DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. It supports a rich SQL dialect including complex subqueries, window functions, complex types, and can directly query CSV and Parquet files.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, extension mechanisms, and integrations for multiple clients (Python, R, Java, Wasm, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++17, built with CMake, and supports Python 3 for development.
en.hot: As a benchmark for in-process analytical databases, DuckDB has gained rapid popularity in data science due to its minimal deployment and high-performance queries, with over 40k stars and 69 new today.
uses: Data scientists and analysts who want to quickly analyze large datasets in Python or R without deploying a separate database server.
Data engineers who need to query CSV/Parquet files directly as SQL sources to simplify data pipelines.
Application developers who want to embed analytical capabilities into existing applications for lightweight OLAP functionality.

zh.tag: 专为 RTX 5090 打造的单卡 C++/CUDA 推理引擎
zh.what: NInfer 是一个从零编写的 C++/CUDA 推理引擎，专门针对单张 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 上的特定 Qwen 检查点进行极致优化。它支持文本、图像和视频输入，可通过本地 CLI 或兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic 的 HTTP API 调用。运行时高度特化：单 GPU、单常驻模型、启动时固定 1 到 8 个并发请求容量。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++/CUDA 源码、CMake 构建系统，以及五个预注册的模型工件（Qwen3.6-27B、Qwen3.8-27B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 groupwise-int 与 nvfp4 版本）。每个工件内嵌 tokenizer、聊天模板和媒体前端资源，需从 Hugging Face 单独下载。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 C++20、CUDA 13.1+（仅支持 sm_120a 架构）、CMake 3.28+、Ninja，并依赖 FFmpeg 开发库（libavformat/libavcodec/libavutil/libswscale）和 libcurl。要求 64 位 Linux 系统。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1306 颗星，总星数达 1600，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 第 10 名。它精准切中了 RTX 5090 用户对本地高性能单卡推理的需求，且以极致特化换取性能，在 AI 推理社区引发关注。
uses: 拥有 RTX 5090 并希望在本地运行 Qwen 大模型的开发者
需要低延迟、高吞吐单卡推理服务的 AI 应用部署者
对 C++/CUDA 推理引擎实现感兴趣的系统级工程师
想通过 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API 接入本地模型的研究人员

en.tag: A from-scratch C++/CUDA inference engine tuned for single-GPU RTX 5090
en.what: NInfer is a from-scratch C++/CUDA inference engine purpose-built for explicitly registered Qwen checkpoints on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090. It handles text, image, and video prompts via a local CLI or OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible HTTP APIs. The runtime is deliberately specialized: one GPU, one resident model, and a startup-fixed capacity of one to eight active requests.
en.content: The repo contains C++/CUDA source code, a CMake build system, and five pre-registered model artifacts (groupwise-int and nvfp4 variants of Qwen3.6-27B, Qwen3.8-27B, and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B). Each artifact embeds its tokenizer, chat template, and media frontend resources, and must be downloaded separately from Hugging Face.
en.stack: Tech stack: C++20, CUDA 13.1+ (sm_120a only), CMake 3.28+, Ninja, plus FFmpeg dev libraries (libavformat/libavcodec/libavutil/libswscale) and libcurl. Requires a 64-bit Linux system.
en.hot: It gained 1,306 stars this month (1,600 total), ranking #10 on GitHub Trending's monthly C++ list. It hits a sweet spot for RTX 5090 owners seeking high-performance local single-GPU inference, and its extreme specialization for speed has caught the AI inference community's attention.
uses: Developers with an RTX 5090 who want to run Qwen models locally
AI application deployers needing low-latency, high-throughput single-GPU inference
Systems engineers interested in C++/CUDA inference engine implementation
Researchers wanting to access local models via OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs

zh.tag: 微软官方 1-bit LLM 推理框架，让三值模型在 CPU 上高效运行
zh.what: bitnet.cpp 是微软推出的官方 1-bit（三值权重）大模型推理框架，专注让 BitNet 系列模型在普通 CPU 上高效运行。它提供从模型转换到推理的完整工具链，并已扩展到 GPU 内核与嵌入模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 推理核心（src/）、GPU 内核（gpu/）、模型转换脚本与文档，以及 Hugging Face 上的 BitNet 模型集合链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，针对 x86（AVX2）与 ARM（NEON）平台优化，依赖 Hugging Face 模型与 I2_S 量化格式。
zh.hot: 凭借 4 万余 star 和微软官方背书，它踩中了「低成本本地推理」的痛点，今日仍登上 C++ 日榜第 4 名。
uses: 想在普通 CPU 上本地部署大模型的开发者
研究 1-bit/三值量化与高效推理的研究人员
需要在边缘设备上运行 LLM 的工程团队
关注低成本 AI 推理方案的技术爱好者

en.tag: Microsoft's official 1-bit LLM inference framework for efficient CPU execution
en.what: bitnet.cpp is Microsoft's official inference framework for 1-bit (ternary-weight) LLMs, designed to run BitNet models efficiently on commodity CPUs. It offers a full pipeline from model conversion to inference, and has expanded to GPU kernels and embedding models.
en.content: The repo contains the C++ inference core (src/), GPU kernels (gpu/), model conversion scripts and docs, plus links to the BitNet model collection on Hugging Face.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, optimized for x86 (AVX2) and ARM (NEON) platforms, relying on Hugging Face models and the I2_S quantization format.
en.hot: With over 40k stars and Microsoft's official backing, it hits the pain point of low-cost local inference, still ranking #4 on the C++ daily trending list today.
uses: Developers wanting to run LLMs locally on ordinary CPUs
Researchers studying 1-bit/ternary quantization and efficient inference
Engineering teams deploying LLMs on edge devices
Tech enthusiasts interested in low-cost AI inference solutions

zh.tag: 免费开源的跨平台 2D/3D 游戏引擎
zh.what: Godot 是一个功能丰富、跨平台的游戏引擎，让开发者通过统一界面制作 2D 和 3D 游戏。它内置大量常用工具，并支持一键导出到桌面、移动端、Web 及主机平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎完整 C++ 源码、编辑器、模块与平台导出模板，以及构建脚本、文档和官方演示项目。

教育机构用于游戏开发与编程教学

想参与开源引擎贡献的 C++ 开发者

en.tag: Free and open-source cross-platform 2D and 3D game engine
en.what: Godot is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine for creating 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It ships with a comprehensive set of common tools and supports one-click export to desktop, mobile, web, and console platforms.

zh.tag: 开源次世代3D打印切片软件，兼容多品牌打印机

en.what: OrcaSlicer is an open-source 3D printing slicer that converts 3D models into printer-ready G-code. It supports Bambu, Prusa, Voron, VzBot, RatRig, Creality and many other printers, offering ultra-fast slicing, intelligent support generation and advanced calibration tools.

en.tag: AMD ROCm systems super-repo consolidating core GPU runtime components

zh.tag: 开源 XDR 与 SIEM 安全平台，统一防护端点与云工作负载
zh.what: Wazuh 是一个免费开源的安全平台，用于威胁预防、检测与响应，覆盖本地、虚拟化、容器和云环境。它由部署在被监控系统上的端点安全 Agent 和负责收集分析数据的中央管理服务器组成。
zh.content: 仓库包含端点 Agent、管理服务器以及配套的规则引擎、解码器和集成组件，并与 Wazuh Indexer 配合提供搜索与告警可视化。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为核心实现，配合规则/解码器配置与 Python 等脚本，依赖 Wazuh Indexer（基于 OpenSearch）做数据存储与可视化。
zh.hot: 作为成熟的免费 SIEM/XDR 替代方案，Wazuh 已积累 16892 颗星，今日新增 20 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 9，持续吸引关注安全合规与自建安全运营的开发者。

运维与 DevSecOps 工程师做日志分析、文件完整性监控与漏洞检测
需要满足 PCI DSS 等合规要求的中小团队寻找开源替代方案

en.tag: Open source XDR and SIEM platform for unified endpoint and cloud workload protection
en.what: Wazuh is a free and open source platform for threat prevention, detection, and response across on-premises, virtualized, containerized, and cloud environments. It consists of an endpoint security agent deployed on monitored systems and a management server that collects and analyzes the data gathered by agents.
en.content: The repo contains the endpoint agent, management server, plus rule engine, decoders, and integration components, working with the Wazuh Indexer for search and alert visualization.
en.stack: Core implementation in C++, with rule/decoder configs and Python tooling, relying on the Wazuh Indexer (OpenSearch-based) for storage and visualization.
en.hot: As a mature free SIEM/XDR alternative, Wazuh has reached 16,892 stars, adding 20 today and ranking 9th on the C++ daily trending list, drawing developers focused on security compliance and self-hosted security operations.

Ops and DevSecOps engineers doing log analysis, file integrity monitoring, and vulnerability detection
Small-to-mid teams seeking an open source alternative for PCI DSS and other compliance needs

zh.tag: 任天堂 Switch 定制固件，实现自定义系统与虚拟 NAND
zh.what: Atmosphère 是一个针对任天堂 Switch 的开源定制固件项目，通过替换和修改系统各个组件（如引导加载器、TrustZone、系统模块等）来实现自定义功能。它允许用户运行自制软件、备份和虚拟化 NAND 等。

zh.hot: 作为 Switch 破解社区的核心项目，Atmosphère 拥有近 2 万星标，今日新增 13 星，位列 C++ 日榜第二，持续受到关注。

en.tag: Custom firmware for Nintendo Switch enabling custom OS and emuNAND
en.what: Atmosphère is an open-source custom firmware for the Nintendo Switch that replaces and modifies various system components (such as bootloader, TrustZone, sysmodules) to enable custom features. It allows users to run homebrew, backup and virtualize NAND, and more.
en.content: The repository contains multiple components: Fusée (first-stage loader), Exosphère (custom TrustZone), Thermosphère (emuNAND support), Stratosphère (custom sysmodules), Troposphère (application-level patches), along with documentation and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on libnx, devkitA64 toolchain, FatFs, hekate, and other open-source projects.
en.hot: As a core project in the Switch hacking community, Atmosphère has nearly 20k stars, with 13 added today, ranking second on the C++ daily trending list, showing sustained interest.

Security researchers: to study Switch system security and vulnerabilities
Homebrew developers: to build custom modules based on Atmosphère

zh.tag: 用 React 构建原生应用的跨平台框架

en.what: React Native lets you write React and JavaScript code that renders to native UI components on Android, iOS, and more. It offers native gestures, text scaling, accessibility, and extensibility via native modules.

zh.tag: 为 APatch 与 KernelSU 提供 Zygisk API 的 Zygote 注入模块

en.tag: A Zygote injection module bringing Zygisk API support to APatch and KernelSU
en.what: NeoZygisk is a Zygote injection module implemented via ptrace that provides Zygisk API support for APatch and KernelSU, and also serves as a replacement for Magisk's built-in Zygisk. It focuses on API compatibility, minimalist design, trace cleaning, and advanced stealth.

zh.tag: GTA 5 增强版的开源作弊菜单 DLL
zh.what: 《GTA 5: Enhanced》的实验性修改菜单（mod menu）：编译成 DLL 后用 Xenos 等注入器在游戏主菜单注入，按 INSERT 或 Ctrl+\ 呼出菜单。建议配合 FSL 把存档数据重定向到本地磁盘以保号，且需要关闭 BattlEye 反作弊（目前没有 BE 绕过，公共战局会被心跳检测踢出）。

en.tag: The open-source mod menu DLL for GTA 5: Enhanced
en.what: An experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced: compile to a DLL, inject at the main menu with an injector like Xenos, then press INSERT or Ctrl+\ to open.
