zh.tag: 通用列式内存格式与多语言工具箱，加速数据交换与分析
zh.what: Apache Arrow 定义了一种高效的列式内存格式，并提供了多语言库，用于在不同系统间快速交换数据和在内存中进行分析。它包含 IPC 格式、Flight RPC 协议、ADBC 数据库连接等组件，旨在消除数据序列化开销。
zh.content: 仓库包含列式格式规范、IPC 格式、Flight RPC 协议定义，以及 C++、Python、Java、Go、JavaScript 等多语言实现，还有 Gandiva 表达式编译器和 ADBC 驱动。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，提供 C GLib、.NET、Go、Java、JavaScript、Julia、Python 等语言绑定，依赖 LLVM（用于 Gandiva）和 CMake 构建系统。
zh.hot: 作为大数据和 AI 领域的关键基础设施，Arrow 被众多知名项目（如 Pandas、Spark、DuckDB）集成，拥有 17k+ stars，今日新增 7 星，持续受到关注。
uses: 数据工程师和分析师 —— 用于构建高效的数据管道和内存分析应用
数据库和查询引擎开发者 —— 集成 Arrow 格式以加速数据交换
AI/ML 工程师 —— 在特征工程和模型训练中利用列式内存格式
跨语言系统架构师 —— 使用 Arrow 实现多语言环境下的零拷贝数据共享

en.tag: Universal columnar format and multi-language toolbox for fast data interchange and in-memory analytics
en.what: Apache Arrow defines an efficient columnar in-memory format and provides multi-language libraries for fast data interchange and in-memory analytics across systems. It includes the IPC format, Flight RPC protocol, ADBC database connectivity, and more, aiming to eliminate data serialization overhead.
en.content: The repository contains the columnar format specification, IPC format, Flight RPC protocol definitions, and multi-language implementations in C++, Python, Java, Go, JavaScript, etc., plus the Gandiva expression compiler and ADBC drivers.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, with bindings for C GLib, .NET, Go, Java, JavaScript, Julia, Python, etc., depending on LLVM (for Gandiva) and the CMake build system.
en.hot: As critical infrastructure in big data and AI, Arrow is integrated by many well-known projects (e.g., Pandas, Spark, DuckDB), with 17k+ stars and 7 new stars today, maintaining steady attention.
uses: Data engineers and analysts — for building efficient data pipelines and in-memory analytics applications
Database and query engine developers — integrating Arrow format to accelerate data exchange
AI/ML engineers — leveraging columnar memory format in feature engineering and model training
Cross-language system architects — using Arrow for zero-copy data sharing in multi-language environments

zh.tag: 微软研究院出品的工业级定理证明器与 SMT 求解器
zh.what: Z3 是微软研究院开发的高性能定理证明器，核心是 SMT（可满足性模理论）求解器。它能判定一阶逻辑公式的可满足性，广泛用于程序验证、符号执行、约束求解与形式化方法。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心求解器源码、CMake/Makefile/Visual Studio/Bazel 等多种构建脚本，以及 Python、OCaml、Java、.NET 等多语言绑定和在线 Z3 Guide 教程。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 实现，依赖 CMake、vcpkg、Bazel 等构建工具，并提供 Python、OCaml、Java、.NET、WASM 等多语言绑定与 CI 工作流。
zh.hot: 作为形式化验证与程序分析领域的基石工具，Z3 长期被学术界和工业界广泛采用，12.6k stars 体现其持久影响力，今日小幅新增 12 star 并登上 C++ 日榜第 14 名。
uses: 程序验证与静态分析研究者，用于证明代码正确性或发现漏洞
符号执行与模糊测试工具开发者，需要高效约束求解后端
学习形式化方法与 SMT 理论的学生和工程师
需要求解调度、配置等复杂约束问题的工业应用开发者

en.tag: Microsoft Research's industrial-strength theorem prover and SMT solver
en.what: Z3 is a high-performance theorem prover from Microsoft Research, built around an SMT (Satisfiability Modulo Theories) solver. It decides the satisfiability of first-order logic formulas and is widely used for program verification, symbolic execution, constraint solving, and formal methods.
en.content: The repo contains the C++ core solver source, multiple build systems (CMake, Makefile, Visual Studio, Bazel), bindings for many languages such as Python, OCaml, Java, and .NET, plus an online Z3 Guide.
en.stack: Implemented in C++ with CMake, vcpkg, and Bazel build support, offering bindings for Python, OCaml, Java, .NET, and WASM alongside extensive CI workflows.
en.hot: As a cornerstone of formal verification and program analysis, Z3 has long been adopted across academia and industry; its 12.6k stars reflect lasting impact, with 12 new stars today landing it at #14 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Program verification and static analysis researchers proving correctness or finding bugs
Symbolic execution and fuzzing tool developers needing an efficient constraint-solving backend
Students and engineers learning formal methods and SMT theory
Industrial developers solving complex constraint problems like scheduling or configuration

zh.tag: 开源无人机与无人车自动驾驶固件，覆盖多类载具
zh.what: ArduPilot 是一套成熟的开源自动驾驶系统，为多旋翼、固定翼、无人车、水下机器人等提供统一的飞控固件。它支持从手动遥控到全自主飞行的完整模式，并可与地面站、任务规划软件配合使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ArduPlane、ArduCopter、ArduRover、ArduSub 等载具固件源码，以及共享库、传感器驱动、SITL 仿真与大量自动化测试工作流。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，基于 ChibiOS 等实时操作系统，支持 Pixhawk 等硬件平台，并配有 Python 工具链与 SITL 仿真环境。
zh.hot: 作为无人机与机器人领域的老牌开源项目，它已积累约 1.59 万 star，今日仍登上 C++ 日榜，说明其长期活跃的社区与持续更新的固件生态。
uses: 无人机与机器人开发者，用于二次开发飞控固件
科研与教育机构，用于自主飞行算法验证与教学
创客和 FPV 爱好者，搭建多旋翼、固定翼或无人车平台
行业用户，用于测绘、巡检等自动化任务部署

en.tag: Open-source autopilot firmware for drones, rovers, subs and planes
en.what: ArduPilot is a mature open-source autopilot system providing unified flight-control firmware for multicopters, fixed-wing planes, rovers and underwater vehicles. It supports everything from manual RC control to fully autonomous missions, working alongside ground stations and mission-planning tools.
en.content: The repo contains vehicle firmware sources such as ArduPlane, ArduCopter, ArduRover and ArduSub, plus shared libraries, sensor drivers, SITL simulation and extensive automated test workflows.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ on real-time OSes like ChibiOS, targeting hardware such as Pixhawk, with a Python toolchain and SITL simulation environment.
en.hot: As a veteran open-source project in drones and robotics, it has accumulated about 15.9k stars and still charts on the daily C++ trending list, reflecting its long-active community and continuously updated firmware ecosystem.
uses: Drone and robotics developers doing secondary development on flight-control firmware
Research and education institutions validating autonomous flight algorithms and teaching
Makers and FPV hobbyists building multicopters, fixed-wing planes or rovers
Industry users deploying automated missions such as surveying and inspection

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 的 JSON 解析与序列化标准库
zh.what: nlohmann/json 是一个单头文件的 C++ JSON 库，提供直观的现代 C++ 语法来解析、生成和操作 JSON 数据。它让 JSON 在 C++ 中像使用 STL 容器一样自然，支持序列化、反序列化及与自定义类型互转。
zh.content: 仓库核心是单头文件 include/nlohmann/json.hpp，另含完整文档（mkdocs）、测试套件、CMake 构建脚本及大量示例。
zh.stack: 纯 C++11 实现，无外部依赖，支持 CMake、包管理器（vcpkg/conan 等）集成，并可在 Wandbox 在线试用。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 生态中最受欢迎的 JSON 库，已获 50615 颗星，今日新增 13 星，稳居 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 8 名，是开发者长期信赖的基础设施。
uses: C++ 开发者需要解析或生成 JSON 配置文件、API 响应时
嵌入式或跨平台项目希望零依赖、单头文件集成 JSON 功能
教学场景中演示现代 C++ 与数据序列化结合的最佳实践

en.tag: The JSON library for modern C++
en.what: nlohmann/json is a single-header C++ library that provides intuitive, modern C++ syntax for parsing, generating, and manipulating JSON. It makes JSON feel as natural as STL containers, supporting serialization, deserialization, and conversion to/from custom types.
en.content: The core is a single header include/nlohmann/json.hpp, accompanied by full documentation (mkdocs), a test suite, CMake build scripts, and numerous examples.
en.stack: Pure C++11 implementation with no external dependencies, supports CMake and package managers (vcpkg/conan), and can be tried online via Wandbox.
en.hot: As the most popular JSON library in the C++ ecosystem, it has 50,615 stars with 13 added today, ranking 8th on GitHub Trending (C++ daily), a long-trusted infrastructure for developers.
uses: C++ developers parsing or generating JSON configs, API responses, etc.
Embedded or cross-platform projects wanting zero-dependency, single-header JSON integration
Educational settings demonstrating modern C++ with data serialization best practices

zh.tag: 微软官方 WSL 仓库，在 Windows 上原生运行 Linux 环境
zh.what: WSL 让开发者无需传统虚拟机或双系统，就能在 Windows 上直接运行未经修改的 Linux 命令行工具、实用程序和应用程序。只需在 Windows 命令行执行 wsl --install 即可完成安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WSL 的源码、开发者文档（doc/docs/dev-loop.md）、贡献指南与行为准则，并链接到 WSL2-Linux-Kernel、WSLg 图形支持和官方文档等相关仓库。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主要语言，深度集成 Windows 内核与虚拟化技术，并配套 Linux 内核（WSL2-Linux-Kernel）与图形支持组件 WSLg。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方项目，WSL 已积累约 3.37 万 star，是 Windows 开发者跨平台工作流的核心工具，长期保持稳定关注度。
uses: 需要在 Windows 上使用 Linux 工具链的开发者
想避免双系统或虚拟机开销的跨平台工程师
希望统一 Windows 与 Linux 开发环境的技术团队
学习 Linux 命令但不想离开 Windows 的初学者

en.tag: Microsoft's official WSL repo for running Linux natively on Windows
en.what: WSL lets developers run unmodified Linux command-line tools, utilities and apps directly on Windows without the overhead of a traditional VM or dual boot. Installing is as simple as running wsl --install in a Windows command line.
en.content: The repo holds WSL source code, developer docs (doc/docs/dev-loop.md), contribution guidelines and a code of conduct, plus links to related repos like WSL2-Linux-Kernel, WSLg and the docs site.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, deeply integrated with the Windows kernel and virtualization, paired with the Linux kernel (WSL2-Linux-Kernel) and the WSLg graphics component.
en.hot: As an official Microsoft project, WSL has gathered about 33.7k stars and remains a core tool for Windows developers' cross-platform workflows, sustaining steady attention.
uses: Developers who need a Linux toolchain on Windows
Cross-platform engineers avoiding dual boot or VM overhead
Teams wanting a unified Windows and Linux dev environment
Beginners learning Linux commands without leaving Windows

zh.tag: 让 vLLM 在昇腾 NPU 上跑起来的社区硬件插件
zh.what: 这是 vLLM 官方生态下的昇腾（Ascend）硬件后端插件，把 vLLM 的高吞吐推理能力对接到华为昇腾 NPU。它负责算子适配、显存管理与分布式推理支持，让原本面向 GPU 的 vLLM 能在昇腾设备上直接部署大模型服务。
zh.content: 仓库以 C++/Python 混合实现为主，包含昇腾算子与图适配层、vLLM 平台接口实现、安装脚本、测试用例以及完整的官方文档站（含支持矩阵、用户指南与中英文 README）。
zh.stack: 基于 vLLM 插件机制与 PyTorch，依赖 CANN、torch_npu 及昇腾驱动/固件，主语言为 C++ 并辅以 Python 绑定。
zh.hot: 作为 vLLM 官方生态中唯一的昇腾后端，它填补了国产 NPU 跑主流推理框架的空白；2830 star 且今日仍在上榜，说明国产算力适配需求持续旺盛。
uses: 使用华为昇腾 NPU 部署大模型推理服务的工程师
需要在国产算力上跑 vLLM 高吞吐推理的团队
为昇腾平台做算子适配与性能调优的开发者
评估国产 AI 芯片推理可行性的技术决策者

en.tag: Community hardware plugin that runs vLLM on Ascend NPUs
en.what: This is the Ascend hardware backend plugin under the vLLM project, connecting vLLM's high-throughput inference engine to Huawei Ascend NPUs. It handles operator adaptation, memory management and distributed inference so that GPU-oriented vLLM can serve large models directly on Ascend devices.
en.content: The repo is a C++/Python hybrid containing the Ascend operator and graph adaptation layer, vLLM platform interface implementations, install scripts, tests, and a full documentation site with a support matrix, user guide and bilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Built on vLLM's plugin mechanism and PyTorch, depending on CANN, torch_npu and Ascend drivers/firmware, primarily in C++ with Python bindings.
en.hot: As the only Ascend backend in the vLLM ecosystem, it fills the gap for running mainstream inference frameworks on domestic NPUs; with 2,830 stars and still trending today, demand for domestic accelerator support remains strong.
uses: Engineers deploying LLM inference on Huawei Ascend NPUs
Teams needing high-throughput vLLM inference on domestic accelerators
Developers adapting operators and tuning performance for Ascend
Technical decision-makers evaluating domestic AI chip inference

zh.tag: 一站式 3D 高斯泼溅训练、编辑与自动化工作站
zh.what: LichtFeld Studio 是一个原生桌面应用，用于训练、检查、编辑、自动化并导出 3D 高斯泼溅场景。它支持从 COLMAP 数据集训练新场景、恢复检查点、实时查看重建结果，并可通过 Python 插件和 MCP 扩展功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源码，涵盖训练引擎、实时可视化 GUI、插件系统、MCP 集成以及构建和分发文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 COLMAP 进行数据预处理，支持 Python 插件和 MCP 协议，提供 Windows 安装包和源码构建方式。
zh.hot: 凭借 3700 颗星和今日新增 3 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 分类第 19 名，因其将 3D 高斯泼溅的完整工作流集成到单一应用中而备受关注。
uses: 3D 重建与计算机视觉研究人员 —— 快速训练和编辑高斯泼溅场景
图形学与游戏开发者 —— 导出高质量 3D 资产用于实时渲染
技术爱好者与创作者 —— 通过 Python 插件和 MCP 自动化工作流

en.tag: A modular workstation for training, editing, and automating 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes
en.what: LichtFeld Studio is a native desktop application for training, inspecting, editing, automating, and exporting 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes. It supports training new scenes from COLMAP datasets, resuming checkpoints, real-time reconstruction viewing, and extending functionality via Python plugins and MCP.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, including the training engine, real-time visualization GUI, plugin system, MCP integration, and build/distribution documentation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relies on COLMAP for data preprocessing, supports Python plugins and MCP protocol, and offers Windows installer and source build options.
en.hot: With 3,700 stars and 3 new stars today, it ranks 19th on GitHub Trending daily list for C++, gaining attention for integrating the complete 3D Gaussian Splatting workflow into a single application.
uses: 3D reconstruction and computer vision researchers — quickly train and edit Gaussian Splatting scenes
Graphics and game developers — export high-quality 3D assets for real-time rendering
Tech enthusiasts and creators — automate workflows via Python plugins and MCP

zh.tag: 专为 Antigravity 打造的免 TUN 强制代理注入工具
zh.what: 这是一个针对 Antigravity 编辑器的透明代理注入工具，通过 DLL 注入和进程流量劫持，强制其网络流量走 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理，无需开启 TUN 模式。它主要解决在中国等地区使用 Antigravity 时因网络限制导致的连接问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 源码、构建脚本、DLL 注入模块、代理配置界面以及详细的文档（包括中文、英文、俄文 README）。核心是 version.dll 和注入器，用于劫持 Antigravity 相关进程（如 language_server_windows_x64.exe 和 node.exe）的流量。
zh.stack: 使用 C++17 开发，依赖 MinHook 进行 API 钩子，支持 Windows x86/x64 平台。构建通过 GitHub Actions 自动化，采用 BSD-2-Clause 许可证。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上已获得 4124 颗星，今日新增 22 星，登上 C++ 日榜第 20 名。它解决了 Antigravity 用户在中国等地区的代理痛点，提供了免 TUN 的便捷方案，因此受到广泛关注。
uses: 在中国等网络受限地区使用 Antigravity 编辑器的开发者，需要稳定代理连接。
希望避免 TUN 模式复杂配置，寻求轻量级代理注入方案的用户。
需要调试 Antigravity 网络问题或进行流量分析的技术人员。

en.tag: Transparent proxy injector for Antigravity, forcing SOCKS5/HTTP without TUN mode
en.what: This is a transparent proxy injector for the Antigravity editor that forces its network traffic through SOCKS5/HTTP proxies via DLL injection and process traffic hijacking, without requiring TUN mode. It primarily solves connectivity issues when using Antigravity in regions with network restrictions, such as China.
en.content: The repository contains C++ source code, build scripts, DLL injection modules, a proxy configuration interface, and detailed documentation (including Chinese, English, and Russian READMEs). The core is version.dll and an injector that hijacks traffic from Antigravity-related processes (such as language_server_windows_x64.exe and node.exe).
en.stack: Built with C++17, it relies on MinHook for API hooking and supports Windows x86/x64 platforms. Builds are automated via GitHub Actions, and it is licensed under BSD-2-Clause.
en.hot: The project has gained 4,124 stars on GitHub, with 22 new stars today, ranking 20th on the C++ daily trending list. It addresses the proxy pain points for Antigravity users in regions like China by offering a convenient TUN-free solution, attracting widespread attention.
uses: Developers using the Antigravity editor in network-restricted regions like China who need stable proxy connections.
Users seeking a lightweight proxy injection solution without the complexity of TUN mode configuration.
Technicians who need to debug Antigravity network issues or perform traffic analysis.

zh.tag: NVIDIA 混合量子-经典计算编程平台，支持 C++ 与 Python
zh.what: CUDA-Q 是 NVIDIA 推出的混合量子-经典计算平台，让开发者能在同一系统中编程和集成量子处理器（QPU）、GPU 与 CPU。它提供统一的编程模型，用于构建和运行量子-经典混合工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CUDA-Q 工具链的全部 C++ 与 Python 源码，核心是 nvq++ 编译器、CUDA-Q 运行时，以及一批集成的 CPU/GPU 后端；另含研究预览版 pulse 脉冲级编程包。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主，提供 Python 绑定；依赖 LLVM/Clang 编译器基础设施、CUDA 与 GPU 加速后端，构建流程见 Building.md。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA 官方量子计算栈，它把量子模拟与 GPU 加速结合，是量子-经典混合编程的少数成熟开源方案，已积累约 1.1k star 并登上 C++ 日榜。
uses: 量子计算研究者与开发者，用于编写和测试量子-经典混合算法
高性能计算与 GPU 工程师，希望用量子模拟加速实验
高校与实验室教学，借助 C++/Python 接口快速上手量子编程
企业研发团队，评估 QPU 与 GPU 协同的工程化方案

en.tag: NVIDIA's hybrid quantum-classical programming platform with C++ and Python support
en.what: CUDA-Q is NVIDIA's platform for hybrid quantum-classical computing, letting developers program and integrate quantum processing units (QPUs), GPUs, and CPUs within a single system. It offers a unified programming model for building and running hybrid quantum-classical workflows.
en.content: The repo holds the full C++ and Python source for the CUDA-Q toolkit, centered on the nvq++ compiler, the CUDA-Q runtime, and a set of integrated CPU/GPU backends; it also includes a research-preview pulse-level programming package.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Python bindings; it relies on LLVM/Clang compiler infrastructure, CUDA, and GPU-accelerated backends, with build steps documented in Building.md.
en.hot: As NVIDIA's official quantum computing stack, it combines quantum simulation with GPU acceleration, making it one of the few mature open-source options for hybrid quantum-classical programming; it has gathered ~1.1k stars and hit the C++ trending list.
uses: Quantum computing researchers and developers writing and testing hybrid quantum-classical algorithms
HPC and GPU engineers looking to accelerate quantum simulation experiments
University and lab courses teaching quantum programming via C++/Python interfaces
Enterprise R&D teams evaluating engineering solutions that combine QPUs and GPUs

zh.tag: 基于 C++11 的运营级跨平台流媒体服务框架
zh.what: ZLMediaKit 是一个高性能流媒体服务框架，支持 RTSP、RTMP、HLS、HTTP-FLV、WebSocket-FLV、WebRTC、GB28181、SRT 等十余种协议并可在协议间互转。它既能作为商用级流媒体服务器直接部署，也能以标准 C API 形式当作 SDK 嵌入其他语言与业务系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、完整的 MediaServer 服务器实现、标准 C API 头文件、Docker 镜像配置以及 RESTful API 与 Web Hook 文档，附带多平台 CI 工作流。
zh.stack: 基于 C++11 开发，采用多路复用、多线程与异步网络 IO 模型，支持 Linux/macOS/iOS/Android/Windows 及 x86、ARM、RISC-V、MIPS、龙芯、申威等指令集。
zh.hot: 凭借 17544 颗星和成熟的商用验证，它成为 C++ 流媒体领域最受信赖的开源方案之一，今日再登 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 22 名。
uses: 视频监控与安防平台开发者，需要 GB28181 与 RTSP 协议栈打通
直播与点播业务团队，希望低延时、高并发地分发多协议流
嵌入式与移动端开发者，寻找跨平台流媒体 SDK 进行二次开发
运维与架构师，需要免开发直接部署商用级流媒体服务器

en.tag: A C++11-based carrier-grade cross-platform streaming media server framework
en.what: ZLMediaKit is a high-performance streaming media framework supporting over a dozen protocols including RTSP, RTMP, HLS, HTTP-FLV, WebSocket-FLV, WebRTC, GB28181 and SRT, with cross-protocol conversion. It can be deployed directly as a commercial-grade media server or embedded as an SDK via its standard C API.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, a full MediaServer implementation, standard C API headers, Docker image configs, plus RESTful API and Web Hook documentation, along with multi-platform CI workflows.

zh.what: No AI Slop 是一个可安装到 ChatGPT、Claude Code、Codex 等编码代理中的写作技能，用于识别并删除「It's not X. It's Y.」这类典型 AI 腔调。它在去套路的同时尽量保留作者原有的用词、节奏与个人语气。
zh.content: 核心是 skills/no-ai-slop/SKILL.md（编辑规则与流程）和 eval.md（自检清单），另有 .codex-plugin/plugin.json 插件元数据与 build_plugin.py 打包校验脚本。
zh.stack: 以 Python 编写构建与校验脚本，技能本身以 Markdown 规则文件形式分发，通过 npx skills 或直接粘贴提示词安装，依赖宿主代理运行。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1056 star、总数达 7851 并登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 20 名，说明「去 AI 味」正切中大量创作者对千篇一律 AI 文风的厌倦。
uses: 内容创作者与自媒体作者，用来润色稿件、去掉明显的 AI 腔调
经常用 ChatGPT 或编码代理改稿、希望保留个人语气的写作者
编辑与审校人员，需要快速检测一段文字是否带有 AI 套路
想拿 AI 套路做讽刺模仿、生成「最尬 AI 文」的玩梗用户

en.tag: A writing skill that strips 20+ patterns of AI slop
en.what: No AI Slop is a skill you install into ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, or other coding agents to detect and remove telltale AI writing patterns like "It's not X. It's Y." It cleans up the slop while trying to preserve your own vocabulary, cadence, and voice.
en.content: The core is skills/no-ai-slop/SKILL.md (editing rules and workflow) plus eval.md (self-check list), alongside .codex-plugin/plugin.json plugin metadata and build_plugin.py for packaging and validation.
en.stack: Python powers the build and validation scripts, while the skill itself ships as Markdown rule files installed via npx skills or a pasted prompt, running inside a host agent.
en.hot: It gained 1,056 stars this week for 7,851 total and hit #20 on GitHub Trending, showing how many writers are fed up with same-sounding AI prose.
uses: Content creators and bloggers polishing drafts to remove obvious AI tone
Writers who edit with ChatGPT or coding agents but want to keep their own voice
Editors and reviewers who need to quickly flag AI-slop patterns in a text
Users who want to satirically generate the cringiest possible AI slop

zh.tag: 微软出品的文件转 Markdown 工具，为 LLM 喂料而生
zh.what: MarkItDown 是一个轻量级 Python 工具，能把 PDF、Office 文档、图片、音频、HTML、ZIP、YouTube 链接等多种格式统一转换成 Markdown。它重点保留标题、列表、表格、链接等文档结构，输出主要面向 LLM 与文本分析管线，而非高保真的人用排版。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式组织，核心是 markitdown 包及其各类格式转换器，另含 CLI 入口、可选依赖分组（如 [all]）与安全注意事项文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+，通过 pip 安装，支持 uv/venv/conda 环境，按需引入 PDF、OCR、语音转写等可选依赖。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方项目，它精准踩中 LLM 数据预处理刚需，已积累约 18.2 万 star，本周再增 4579 并登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 16 名。
uses: 需要把大量异构文档转成 Markdown 再喂给 LLM 的 RAG 与数据工程开发者
想快速把 PDF、Word、PPT 转成纯文本做检索或摘要的研究与内容团队
在命令行或脚本里批量处理 Office 文档、图片 OCR、音频转写的自动化用户

en.tag: Microsoft's file-to-Markdown converter built to feed LLMs
en.what: MarkItDown is a lightweight Python utility that converts PDFs, Office documents, images, audio, HTML, ZIP files, YouTube URLs and more into Markdown. It focuses on preserving document structure like headings, lists, tables and links, targeting LLM and text-analysis pipelines rather than high-fidelity human-facing output.
en.content: The repo is organized as a Python package, with the core markitdown package and per-format converters, plus a CLI entry point, optional dependency groups (e.g. [all]) and security documentation.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+, installed via pip, compatible with uv/venv/conda, and pulls in optional dependencies for PDF, OCR and speech transcription as needed.
en.hot: As an official Microsoft project, it hits the sweet spot of LLM data preprocessing, racking up about 182k stars, adding 4,579 this week and ranking 16th on GitHub Trending's weekly chart.
uses: RAG and data engineers who need to turn heterogeneous documents into Markdown for LLMs
Research and content teams wanting to convert PDFs, Word and PPT into plain text for search or summarization
Automation users batch-processing Office docs, image OCR and audio transcription from CLI or scripts

zh.tag: 本地优先的开源智能家居自动化平台
zh.what: Home Assistant 是一个开源家庭自动化平台，把本地控制和隐私放在首位，让用户在自己的服务器或树莓派上统一接入并联动各类智能设备。它由全球 DIY 爱好者社区驱动，通过模块化集成支持成千上万种设备与动作。
zh.content: 仓库是 Home Assistant 的核心代码库，包含平台内核、集成组件（integrations）、自动化引擎与前端资源等模块化目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，采用模块化架构以便轻松扩展新设备或动作，可运行在树莓派或本地服务器上。
zh.hot: 作为智能家居领域最知名的开源项目之一，它已积累超过 9 万 star，本周新增 228 星并登上 Python 周榜第 18 名，社区活跃度持续走高。
uses: 智能家居爱好者：想用本地服务器统一控制家中各类设备
隐私敏感用户：不愿把家庭数据交给云端厂商
DIY 与开发者：希望编写自定义集成或自动化组件
树莓派/家庭服务器玩家：寻找可长期自托管的自动化中枢

en.tag: Open-source, local-first home automation platform
en.what: Home Assistant is an open-source home automation platform that puts local control and privacy first, letting users unify and automate smart devices on their own server or Raspberry Pi. Driven by a worldwide DIY community, it supports thousands of devices and actions through modular integrations.
en.content: The repo is the core codebase of Home Assistant, containing the platform core, integration components, the automation engine, and frontend assets in a modular layout.
en.stack: Built mainly in Python with a modular architecture that makes adding new devices or actions easy, and it runs on a Raspberry Pi or local server.
en.hot: As one of the best-known open-source smart home projects, it has over 90k stars, gained 228 this week, and ranked 18th on the Python weekly trending list, showing sustained community momentum.
uses: Smart home enthusiasts who want to unify devices on a local server
Privacy-conscious users who avoid handing home data to cloud vendors
DIYers and developers building custom integrations or automation components
Raspberry Pi / home server owners seeking a long-term self-hosted hub

zh.tag: 一键开启沉浸式多智能体课堂
zh.what: OpenMAIC 是一个开源的多智能体交互式课堂平台，让用户通过点击即可获得沉浸式的多智能体学习体验。它模拟真实课堂环境，由多个 AI 智能体扮演不同角色（如教师、学生），进行互动教学。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端界面（Next.js/React）、后端逻辑（LangGraph 编排）、智能体配置、部署模板（Vercel）、文档和社区资源。支持 OpenClaw 集成和 Lemonade 本地 AI。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Next.js 16、React 19、LangGraph 1.1 构建，支持多种 LLM 提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic）的 API 密钥配置。
zh.hot: 凭借创新的多智能体教学理念和极简的一键部署体验，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，24 小时内新增 907 星，总星数突破 2.2 万，位列 Trending 日榜第 5。
uses: 教育工作者：快速搭建 AI 驱动的互动课堂，探索新型教学模式。
AI 开发者：研究多智能体协作与交互，参考其架构和实现。
学习者：通过沉浸式多智能体对话，获得个性化学习体验。
开源爱好者：部署和定制自己的智能体课堂，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: One-click immersive multi-agent learning classroom
en.what: OpenMAIC is an open-source multi-agent interactive classroom platform that provides an immersive learning experience with one click. It simulates a real classroom where multiple AI agents play different roles (e.g., teacher, students) to conduct interactive teaching.
en.content: The repo includes frontend UI (Next.js/React), backend logic (LangGraph orchestration), agent configurations, deployment templates (Vercel), documentation, and community resources. Supports OpenClaw integration and Lemonade local AI.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using Next.js 16, React 19, LangGraph 1.1, and supports multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) via API keys.
en.hot: Its innovative multi-agent teaching concept and one-click deployment experience have made it viral on GitHub, gaining 907 stars in 24 hours, surpassing 22k total stars, and ranking #5 on the daily trending list.
uses: Educators: Quickly set up AI-driven interactive classrooms to explore new teaching models.
AI developers: Study multi-agent collaboration and interaction, referencing its architecture and implementation.
Learners: Gain personalized learning experiences through immersive multi-agent dialogues.
Open-source enthusiasts: Deploy and customize their own agent classroom, contributing to the community.

zh.tag: Codex 技能目录，已弃用，迁移至 OpenAI Plugins
zh.what: 这是一个为 Codex 等 AI 代理提供技能（Skills）的目录仓库，技能是包含指令、脚本和资源的文件夹，代理可发现并使用它们来执行特定任务。该仓库已弃用，当前推荐使用 OpenAI Plugins 仓库。
zh.content: 仓库包含 .system、.curated 和 .experimental 三个技能分类目录，每个技能目录内包含指令文件和可选的 LICENSE.txt。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，但技能本身是跨语言的指令和脚本集合，依赖 Codex 环境。
zh.hot: 尽管已弃用，但作为 OpenAI 官方仓库仍获得 25621 星，说明开发者对 Agent Skills 标准和高星仓库的关注度极高。
uses: Codex 用户：安装和使用官方策划的技能，如 gh-address-comments。
技能开发者：参考技能目录结构，学习如何创建自定义技能。
研究 Agent 技能标准：了解 Agent Skills 开放标准及其应用。

en.tag: Deprecated skills catalog for Codex; moved to OpenAI Plugins
en.what: This is a catalog repository of skills for AI agents like Codex. Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that agents can discover and use to perform specific tasks. The repository is deprecated; users are directed to the OpenAI Plugins repository.
en.content: The repository contains three skill categories: .system, .curated, and .experimental. Each skill folder includes instruction files and an optional LICENSE.txt.
en.stack: Primarily Python, but skills are cross-language instruction and script collections, depending on the Codex environment.
en.hot: Despite being deprecated, it has 25,621 stars, showing high developer interest in Agent Skills standards and official OpenAI repositories.

Researchers of agent skill standards: learn about the Agent Skills open standard.

zh.tag: GitHub 官方的规格驱动开发工具包，让任意 AI 编码代理先写规格再写代码
zh.what: Spec Kit 是 GitHub 开源的一套规格驱动开发（Spec-Driven Development）工具包，主张在动手写代码之前先把「要构建什么」定义清楚。它提供一套开箱即用的流程，也可以接入你自己的流程，并支持与各类 AI 编码代理配合使用。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 编写的 Specify CLI 为核心，配套文档站点、扩展与预设（Extensions & Presets）、面向角色的 Bundles 方案，以及各 AI 编码代理的集成说明。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，通过 Specify CLI 分发；依赖 GitHub Releases 与 GitHub Pages 文档，并适配多家 AI 编码代理的集成接口。
zh.hot: 背靠 GitHub 官方、主打与 AI 编码代理协作的规范流程，发布一年即达 1.0.0，累计约 13.6 万 star，今日再涨 1015 并登上日榜第 15 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Copilot 等 AI 编码代理的开发者，希望先定规格再生成代码
团队负责人想统一需求、设计与实现之间的协作流程
想用扩展和预设把 Spec Kit 改造成自家研发规范的组织
需要评估新想法或修复缺陷时，用规格流程做结构化拆解的工程师

en.tag: GitHub's spec-driven development toolkit that makes any AI coding agent define specs before writing code
en.what: Spec Kit is GitHub's open source toolkit for Spec-Driven Development, which puts defining what to build before building it. It ships a ready-to-use process (or lets you bring your own) and works with any AI coding agent.
en.content: The repo centers on a Python-based Specify CLI, plus a docs site, extensions and presets, role-based bundles, and integration guides for various AI coding agents.
en.stack: Primarily Python, distributed via the Specify CLI; it relies on GitHub Releases and GitHub Pages docs, and adapts to multiple AI coding agent integrations.
en.hot: Backed by GitHub and pitched as a spec-first workflow for AI coding agents, it hit 1.0.0 in its first year and now sits at ~135.8k stars, gaining 1,015 today for #15 on the daily trending list.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Copilot who want specs before code
Team leads aiming to unify requirements, design, and implementation workflows
Organizations wanting to customize Spec Kit via extensions and presets for their own standards
Engineers who want a structured spec process for assessing ideas or fixing bugs

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的 HTML 转视频渲染框架
zh.what: HyperFrames 是一个开源框架，可将 HTML、CSS、媒体和可定位动画转换为确定性的 MP4 视频。它支持本地 CLI 使用，也可作为 AI 编码代理的技能，或作为托管创作流程的渲染核心。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、CLI 工具、技能包（SKILL.md）、文档、示例和展示页面。核心是让代理通过编写 HTML 来生成视频，并支持可定位动画。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，要求 Node.js >= 22，通过 npm 分发，并集成了 AI 代理技能系统（如 Claude 和 Agents skills）。
zh.hot: 凭借 4.4 万+ Star 和每日新增 220 的热度，它精准切中 AI 代理自动生成视频的需求，将 HTML 编写与视频渲染无缝结合，成为 GitHub Trending 上的明星项目。
uses: AI 代理开发者：希望让代理自动生成视频内容，如产品介绍、教程等。
视频创作者：通过编写 HTML 快速生成可定制、确定性的视频，无需传统编辑软件。
自动化工作流：在 CI/CD 或内容管道中集成视频渲染，实现批量生成。
前端开发者：利用熟悉的 HTML/CSS 技能创建动画和视频效果。

en.tag: Open-source framework turning HTML/CSS into deterministic MP4 videos, built for AI agents
en.what: HyperFrames is an open-source framework that converts HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. It can be used locally via CLI, as skills for AI coding agents, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, CLI tools, skill packages (SKILL.md), documentation, examples, and showcase pages. The core enables agents to generate videos by writing HTML, with support for seekable animations.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, requires Node.js >= 22, distributed via npm, and integrates AI agent skill systems (e.g., Claude and Agents skills).
en.hot: With over 44k stars and 220 daily additions, it precisely meets the demand for AI-agent-driven video generation, seamlessly combining HTML authoring with video rendering, making it a star on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI agent developers: enable agents to automatically generate video content like product intros or tutorials.
Video creators: quickly produce customizable, deterministic videos by writing HTML, without traditional editing software.
Automation workflows: integrate video rendering into CI/CD or content pipelines for batch generation.
Frontend developers: leverage familiar HTML/CSS skills to create animations and video effects.

zh.tag: 多智能体 LLM 金融交易框架，模拟投研团队协作决策
zh.what: TradingAgents 用多个 LLM 智能体分别扮演基本面分析师、情绪分析师、交易员与风控等角色，围绕同一标的展开辩论与协作，最终输出可执行的交易决策信号。它把真实投研团队的流程结构化为可复现的智能体图，并配套数据接入、回测与决策日志记忆。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式提供智能体图与 CLI，包含分析师/研究员/交易员/风控等角色模块、数据供应商注册表（FRED、Polymarket、Alpha Vantage 等）、模型目录、检查点续跑与 CHANGELOG 版本记录。
zh.stack: 主语言 Python，基于 LLM 编排（支持 OpenAI 兼容端点、GPT-5.x、Claude、Qwen、GLM、Bedrock 等），依赖金融数据 API 与 arXiv 论文 2412.20138 所述方法。
zh.hot: 10.6 万 star、日增 745 并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 11，说明「LLM 智能体 + 量化交易」这一交叉题材正被大量开发者当作可落地的多智能体范本。
uses: 量化研究者与金融工程师，用于验证多智能体投研流程与信号生成
AI 智能体开发者，借鉴角色分工、辩论与记忆机制的设计范式
高校师生与论文复现者，对照 arXiv 2412.20138 做实验与教学
对 LLM 金融应用感兴趣的独立开发者，搭建自己的交易助手原型

en.tag: Multi-agent LLM framework that simulates a trading firm's research and decision pipeline
en.what: TradingAgents assigns LLM agents to roles such as fundamental analyst, sentiment analyst, trader and risk manager, letting them debate and collaborate on a single instrument to produce an actionable trading signal. It encodes a real trading firm's research workflow as a reproducible agent graph, with data connectors, backtesting and decision-log memory.
en.content: The repo ships a Python package with the agent graph and a CLI, role modules for analysts, researchers, traders and risk control, a data-provider registry (FRED, Polymarket, Alpha Vantage and more), a model catalog, checkpoint resume, and a detailed CHANGELOG.
en.stack: Python-first, built on LLM orchestration (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, GPT-5.x, Claude, Qwen, GLM, Bedrock, etc.), financial data APIs, and the method from arXiv paper 2412.20138.
en.hot: With 106k stars, +745 today and #11 on GitHub Trending, it shows how strongly developers are embracing the 'LLM agents + quant trading' crossover as a practical multi-agent reference.
uses: Quant researchers and financial engineers validating multi-agent research pipelines and signal generation
AI agent developers studying role division, debate and memory design patterns
Students and academics reproducing the arXiv 2412.20138 paper for experiments and teaching
Indie developers curious about LLM finance building their own trading-assistant prototypes

zh.tag: 最主流的开源模型定义与训练推理框架
zh.what: Transformers 是 Hugging Face 推出的模型定义框架，统一了文本、视觉、音频和多模态的 SOTA 模型接口。它同时支持推理与训练，让用户用几行代码即可加载、微调和部署各类预训练模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库 src/transformers（模型、分词器、pipeline、Trainer 等），以及 examples、tests、docs 和 i18n 多语言 README。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 与 PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX 等深度学习后端，依赖 tokenizers、safetensors、huggingface_hub 等组件。
zh.hot: 作为 AI 领域事实标准库，它已积累 16.5 万+ star，今日再增 152 并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 19 名，热度长期稳定。
uses: AI 研究者与工程师：快速加载、微调和评测各类预训练模型
应用开发者：用 pipeline 在几行代码内集成 NLP、视觉与语音能力
企业团队：基于统一接口构建和部署生产级模型服务
学习者：通过丰富示例与文档入门深度学习与大模型实践

en.tag: The leading open-source model-definition framework for training and inference
en.what: Transformers is Hugging Face's model-definition framework that unifies state-of-the-art models across text, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks. It supports both inference and training, letting users load, fine-tune, and deploy pretrained models with just a few lines of code.
en.content: The repo contains the core library under src/transformers (models, tokenizers, pipelines, Trainer, etc.), plus examples, tests, docs, and i18n multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Built in Python on top of deep learning backends like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX, depending on tokenizers, safetensors, and huggingface_hub.
en.hot: As the de facto standard library in AI, it has amassed over 165k stars, gaining another 152 today and ranking 19th on GitHub Trending, showing sustained popularity.
uses: AI researchers and engineers: quickly load, fine-tune, and evaluate pretrained models
App developers: integrate NLP, vision, and speech with pipelines in a few lines
Enterprise teams: build and deploy production-grade model services on a unified API
Learners: get started with deep learning and large models via rich examples and docs

zh.tag: 面向 CAD/CAE/CAM 的 AI 代理技能库，用自然语言生成工程模型
zh.what: text-to-cad 提供一组可被 AI 代理调用的技能，让代理从本地项目文件出发，生成、检查、检索、切片并交付 CAD 与机器人描述文件。它把自然语言指令转成可用的工程几何与仿真产物，覆盖设计到制造的完整链路。

zh.hot: 本周新增 1071 星、总数达 15369，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 Python 第 20 名，反映出 AI 代理与工程制造结合的热度。
uses: 机械/硬件工程师用自然语言快速生成和迭代 CAD 模型
机器人开发者生成 URDF/SDF/SRDF 描述并做仿真与运动规划
AI 代理开发者把 CAD/CAE/CAM 能力集成进自动化工作流
创客与 3D 打印用户从文本直接得到可切片模型

en.tag: A library of agent skills for CAD, CAE and CAM that turns natural language into engineering models
en.what: text-to-cad offers a set of agent skills that let AI agents generate, inspect, source, slice and hand off CAD and robot-description artifacts from local project files. zh.tag: 自动构建个人知识库的跨平台桌面应用
zh.what: LLM Wiki 是一款跨平台桌面应用，能自动将你的文档转化为结构化、互链的知识库。它不采用传统 RAG 每次从零检索的方式，而是让 LLM 增量构建并维护一个持久的 Wiki。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，涵盖多格式文档解析、多模态图像处理、知识图谱构建、向量语义搜索、持久化摄入队列以及 Rust 后端聊天代理等模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，结合 Rust 后端，依赖 LanceDB 进行向量搜索，支持 OpenAI 兼容的模型端点，并集成 Tavily、SerpApi、SearXNG 等搜索服务。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 142 颗星，总星数达 18105，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 14 名，因其创新的自动知识库构建方式和强大的多模态处理能力受到关注。
uses: 研究人员和学生——需要从大量文档中自动构建可检索知识库
知识工作者——希望将分散的文档、网页和媒体整合成结构化 Wiki
开发者——想要一个可本地部署、支持自定义模型的 AI 知识管理工具
团队——需要跨设备迁移和共享项目档案的协作场景

en.tag: Cross-platform desktop app that auto-builds a personal knowledge base
en.what: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that automatically turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base. Instead of traditional RAG, the LLM incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources.
en.content: The repository contains the full desktop app source code, covering multi-format document parsing, multimodal image processing, knowledge graph construction, vector semantic search, persistent ingest queue, and a Rust backend chat agent.
en.stack: Primarily built with TypeScript and a Rust backend, using LanceDB for vector search, supporting OpenAI-compatible model endpoints, and integrating search services like Tavily, SerpApi, and SearXNG.
en.hot: With 142 stars added today and a total of 18,105 stars, it ranks 14th on GitHub Trending daily, gaining attention for its innovative auto-knowledge-base approach and powerful multimodal capabilities.
uses: Researchers and students — need to automatically build a searchable knowledge base from large document sets
Knowledge workers — want to integrate scattered documents, web clips, and media into a structured wiki
Developers — seek a locally deployable AI knowledge management tool with custom model support
Teams — require cross-device migration and sharing of project archives for collaboration

zh.tag: 开源自托管 AI 销售 CRM，原生 AI 代理接管 WhatsApp 聊天
zh.what: DeskcommCRM 是一个开源的 AI 销售操作系统，把能接待、筛选并促成成交的 AI 代理直接嵌进 CRM，通过 WhatsApp（WAHA）与客户对话。它是 Kommo、Octadesk、Intercom 的开源替代品，数据自持、无月费、无功能锁。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Next.js 应用主体、WAHA 的 WhatsApp 集成、Supabase 数据库与认证、多租户与 LGPD 合规逻辑，以及 hostgator-setup-kit 一键部署脚本和架构/路线图文档。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 TypeScript（strict）+ Next.js 16，后端依赖 Supabase（Postgres、Auth、Storage），WhatsApp 通道使用 WAHA，支持 MCP、多租户与自托管部署。
zh.hot: 上线不久即冲到 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4，今日新增 152 star、总数 1347，说明拉美市场对「开源 + WhatsApp 原生 AI 销售」的需求被长期压抑。
uses: 通过 WhatsApp 成交的中小企业与销售团队，想摆脱 Kommo/Octadesk 的月费与功能锁定
需要数据主权与 LGPD 合规、希望把 CRM 跑在自己 VPS 上的巴西及拉美公司
想给现有销售流程加 AI 代理、并接入 MCP 生态的开发者与集成商
寻找 Intercom 开源替代、重视自托管与多租户能力的 SaaS 团队

en.tag: Open-source self-hosted AI sales CRM with native AI agents on WhatsApp
en.what: DeskcommCRM is an open-source AI sales OS that embeds AI agents capable of greeting, qualifying and closing deals directly inside a CRM, conversing with customers over WhatsApp (WAHA). It positions itself as the open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk and Intercom, with self-owned data, no monthly fees and no locked features.
en.content: The repo contains the Next.js app, WhatsApp integration via WAHA, Supabase database and auth, multi-tenant and LGPD compliance logic, plus a hostgator-setup-kit one-command deploy script and architecture/roadmap docs.
en.stack: Built with strict TypeScript and Next.js 16, backed by Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage), using WAHA for the WhatsApp channel, with MCP support, multi-tenancy and self-hosted deployment.
en.hot: It hit #4 on GitHub Trending with 152 stars added today and 1,347 total, showing pent-up demand in LATAM for an open-source, WhatsApp-native AI sales tool.
uses: SMBs and sales teams closing deals on WhatsApp who want to escape Kommo/Octadesk monthly fees and locked features
Brazilian and LATAM companies needing data sovereignty and LGPD compliance by running the CRM on their own VPS
Developers and integrators adding AI agents to existing sales flows and plugging into the MCP ecosystem
SaaS teams seeking an open-source Intercom alternative with self-hosting and multi-tenancy

zh.tag: 让 AI 编程助手直接操控 Chrome 的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: chrome-devtools-mcp 是一个模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，允许 AI 编程助手（如 Claude、Cursor、Copilot）实时控制并检查 Chrome 浏览器。它提供性能洞察、高级调试和可靠自动化能力，并附带 CLI 供非 MCP 场景使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器实现、CLI 工具、文档（工具参考、故障排除、设计原则等）以及贡献指南。核心功能包括性能追踪、网络请求分析、截图和 console 消息检查。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 puppeteer 实现浏览器自动化，依赖 Chrome DevTools 前端进行性能追踪，并集成 Google CrUX API 获取真实用户体验数据。
zh.hot: 凭借 5 万+ star 成为 AI 代理工具链的明星项目，本周新增 738 star 登上 TypeScript 周榜。它让 AI 编程助手获得浏览器级调试能力，极大提升自动化与排错效率。
uses: AI 编程助手（如 Claude、Cursor）需要自动化浏览器操作或调试前端代码的开发者
需要分析网页性能、网络请求和 console 错误的 QA 或性能工程师
希望为自定义 AI 工作流集成浏览器控制能力的 MCP 用户
对 Chrome DevTools 自动化感兴趣，想扩展其能力的开发者

en.tag: MCP server that lets coding agents control and inspect Chrome
en.what: chrome-devtools-mcp is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets coding agents (like Claude, Cursor, Copilot) control and inspect a live Chrome browser. It provides performance insights, advanced debugging, and reliable automation, with a CLI for non-MCP use.
en.content: The repo contains the MCP server implementation, a CLI, docs (tool reference, troubleshooting, design principles), and contributing guidelines. Key features include performance tracing, network analysis, screenshots, and console message inspection.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses puppeteer for browser automation, leverages Chrome DevTools frontend for performance tracing, and integrates Google CrUX API for real-user experience data.
en.hot: With 50k+ stars, it's a star in the AI agent toolchain, gaining 738 stars this week and ranking #18 on TypeScript weekly. It gives coding agents browser-level debugging, boosting automation and troubleshooting efficiency.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to automate browser tasks or debug frontend code
QA or performance engineers needing to analyze page performance, network requests, and console errors
MCP users who want to integrate browser control into custom AI workflows
Developers interested in extending Chrome DevTools automation capabilities

zh.tag: 腾讯开源的团队级 AI 代理配置与知识同步 CLI
zh.what: TeamAI 是一个命令行工具，用于在 Claude Code、Codex、CodeBuddy、Cursor 等多种 AI 代理之间统一管理团队的技能、规则、MCP 配置与知识库。团队管理员把共享经验仓库托管在 Git 上，成员执行 init 后每次 AI 会话都会自动拉取最新的技能与规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的 CLI 源码、多语言 README（中/英/日/韩/泰）、使用指南文档，以及 assets 中的 logo 等资源，配套 teamai-hub 模板组织提供预制技能与审查代理。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，通过 npm 全局安装（npm install -g teamai-cli），依赖 Node.js 生态，并集成 Git 托管服务（GitHub、GitLab、GitCode、CNB、TGit 等）作为团队配置仓库。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1846 star、总数达 4662，冲上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 周榜第 13 名；腾讯出品加上多代理统一治理的刚需，让它在 AI 编码工具爆发期迅速走红。
uses: 团队技术负责人：统一为成员分发技能、规则与 MCP 配置
使用多种 AI 编码代理的开发者：一处配置，跨 Claude Code、Cursor 等生效
希望沉淀团队知识库与代码库上下文的工程组织
想快速体验预制技能与审查代理的个人开发者

en.tag: Tencent's CLI to sync team skills, rules and MCP across AI agents
en.what: TeamAI is a CLI that manages a team's skills, rules, MCP configs and knowledge across AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, CodeBuddy, Cursor and more. Admins host a shared-experience repo on Git, and after members run init every AI session auto-pulls the latest skills and rules.
en.content: The repo contains the TypeScript CLI source, multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/JA/KO/TH), usage-guide docs, and assets like the logo, plus a companion teamai-hub org with prebuilt skills and review agents.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript and installed globally via npm (npm install -g teamai-cli), it relies on the Node.js ecosystem and integrates Git hosts (GitHub, GitLab, GitCode, CNB, TGit, etc.) as the team config repo.
en.hot: It gained 1,846 stars this week for a total of 4,662, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending's weekly TypeScript list; Tencent's backing plus the real need to govern multiple AI coding agents made it take off fast.
uses: Team tech leads: distribute skills, rules and MCP configs to members uniformly
Developers using multiple AI coding agents: configure once, apply across Claude Code, Cursor and more
Engineering orgs wanting to accumulate team knowledge and codebase context
Solo developers wanting prebuilt skills and review agents out of the box

zh.tag: 跨平台 iOS 侧载工具，一键安装 SideStore 并导入配对文件
zh.what: iloader 是一款面向普通用户的 iOS 侧载工具，帮助你在电脑上给 iPhone/iPad 安装 SideStore 等应用。它会自动导入证书和 rppairing/lockdown 配对文件，并支持导入任意 IPA、管理配对文件与吊销开发证书。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 TypeScript 编写的桌面应用源码（含本地化文件 src/loc*）、构建工作流与发布配置，官网 iloader.app 是唯一官方下载渠道。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，桌面端应用，依赖 usbmuxd（Windows 需 iTunes，macOS 自带，Linux 视发行版而定），并提供 NixOS flake 与社区维护的 Homebrew/AUR/COPR 包。
zh.hot: iOS 侧载长期缺少好用的跨平台图形工具，iloader 把繁琐的配对与证书流程自动化，今日新增 50 star、总数 2908，冲上 GitHub 日榜第 3。
uses: 想给 iPhone/iPad 安装 SideStore 或任意 IPA 的普通 iOS 用户
需要在 Windows/macOS/Linux 上管理配对文件与开发证书的进阶玩家
希望本地化 iloader 到更多语言的翻译贡献者

en.tag: Cross-platform iOS sideloader that installs SideStore and imports pairing files with ease
en.what: iloader is a user-friendly iOS sideloading tool that helps you install SideStore and other apps onto your iPhone/iPad from a computer. It automatically imports certificates and rppairing/lockdown pairing files, and supports importing any IPA, managing pairing files, and revoking development certificates.
en.content: The repo contains the TypeScript desktop app source (including localization files under src/loc*), build workflows, and release configuration; iloader.app is the only official download channel.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript as a desktop app, it depends on usbmuxd (iTunes on Windows, built-in on macOS, distro-dependent on Linux), and ships a NixOS flake plus community-maintained Homebrew/AUR/COPR packages.
en.hot: iOS sideloading has long lacked a good cross-platform GUI tool; iloader automates the tedious pairing and certificate flow, gaining 50 stars today for a total of 2,908 and hitting #3 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Everyday iOS users who want to install SideStore or any IPA on their iPhone/iPad
Advanced users managing pairing files and development certificates on Windows/macOS/Linux
Translation contributors who want to localize iloader into more languages

zh.tag: 自托管的编码代理控制中心，支持多后端与自动化
zh.what: OpenHands Agent Canvas 是一个自托管的开发者控制中心，用于启动与编码代理的对话并自动化日常任务，例如生成报告发布到 Slack、把 GitHub issue 自动拆解成任务。它默认在本地运行，也能连接 Docker、VM、公司内网或 OpenHands Cloud 等多种代理后端。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 为主，包含 Agent Canvas 前端/控制台代码、文档（docs/README.md、SELF_HOSTING.md）、CI 工作流，以及发布到 npm 的 @openhands/agent-canvas 包。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 TypeScript 为核心，通过 npm 包 @openhands/agent-canvas 分发，支持 ACP 兼容代理，并依赖 Docker/VM/云等后端运行环境。
zh.hot: 项目已积累 87112 颗星，今日新增 186 星，登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 日榜第 6 名，反映出开发者对自托管、多代理编排控制台的强烈需求。
uses: 希望自托管编码代理并统一管理多个代理后端的开发者
需要把 GitHub issue、报告生成等日常任务自动化的工程团队
在本地、Docker、VM 或公司内网中运行代理的运维与平台人员
想同时使用 OpenHands、Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等代理的用户

en.tag: Self-hosted developer control center for coding agents and automations
en.what: OpenHands Agent Canvas is a self-hosted developer control center for starting conversations with coding agents and automating everyday tasks, such as publishing reports to Slack or decomposing GitHub issues into tasks. It runs locally by default but can connect to multiple agent backends, including Docker containers, VMs, corporate infrastructure, or OpenHands Cloud.
en.content: The repo is primarily TypeScript and contains the Agent Canvas frontend/control-center code, docs (docs/README.md, SELF_HOSTING.md), CI workflows, and the @openhands/agent-canvas package published to npm.
en.stack: The stack centers on TypeScript, distributed as the @openhands/agent-canvas npm package, supports ACP-compatible agents, and relies on Docker/VM/cloud backends for execution.
en.hot: With 87,112 stars and 186 added today, it ranks 6th on GitHub Trending (TypeScript), reflecting strong demand for self-hosted, multi-agent orchestration control centers.
uses: Developers who want to self-host coding agents and manage multiple agent backends in one place
Engineering teams automating daily tasks like GitHub issue decomposition and report generation
Ops and platform staff running agents locally, in Docker, on VMs, or inside corporate infrastructure
Users who want to run OpenHands, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, or other ACP-compatible agents together

zh.tag: 基于 WebGPU 的 3D 建筑编辑器，支持分享与本地运行。
zh.what: Pascal Editor 是一个使用 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU 构建的 3D 建筑编辑器，允许用户创建和分享建筑项目。它提供了完整的编辑工具、3D 渲染运行时，并支持通过 CLI 在本地运行。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 Turborepo monorepo，包含 Next.js 应用、核心包（core）、查看器（viewer）、编辑器（editor）、节点定义（nodes）、CLI 和 MCP 服务器等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU，采用 Turborepo 管理 monorepo，并发布多个 npm 包。
zh.hot: 凭借 WebGPU 带来的高性能 3D 渲染和便捷的本地运行方式，项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 22k+ 星标，今日新增 168 星。
uses: 建筑师和设计师：快速创建和分享 3D 建筑概念模型。
开发者：在 React 应用中集成 3D 编辑器或查看器。
教育工作者：用于教学演示或学生项目。

en.tag: A WebGPU-powered 3D architectural editor for creating and sharing projects.
en.what: Pascal Editor is a 3D building editor built with React Three Fiber and WebGPU, enabling users to create and share architectural projects. It offers a full editing toolset, a 3D rendering runtime, and can be run locally via CLI.
en.content: The repository is a Turborepo monorepo containing a Next.js app, core packages (core, viewer, editor, nodes), CLI, and MCP server.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on React Three Fiber and WebGPU, managed as a Turborepo monorepo, and published as multiple npm packages.
en.hot: With high-performance 3D rendering via WebGPU and easy local setup, the project has gained 22k+ stars, including 168 today.
uses: Architects and designers: quickly create and share 3D architectural concepts.
Developers: integrate the 3D editor or viewer into React applications.
Educators: use for teaching demonstrations or student projects.

zh.tag: 把各类 AI 编程工具接到 40+ 免费/廉价模型上的智能路由与省 token 网关
zh.what: 9Router 是一个本地运行的 AI 路由网关，把 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Cline、Copilot 等编程工具统一接到 40+ 家供应商、100+ 模型上。它通过订阅→廉价→免费的自动降级、多账号轮询和 RTK token 压缩，让开发者尽量不撞限额、少花钱。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 JavaScript 项目，核心是本地路由服务（默认 http://localhost:20128/v1）与 Web 仪表盘，包含 RTK token 压缩、格式转换（OpenAI ↔ Claude）、配额追踪与自动刷新等模块，并提供 npm 包、Docker 镜像与多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主语言 JavaScript，以 npm 包和 Docker/ GHCR 镜像分发，对外暴露 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 接口，依赖各 AI 供应商的 API 与订阅凭证。
zh.hot: 它以“无限免费 AI 编程”和 20-40% token 节省直击开发者成本痛点，已积累 28k+ star，今日再涨 186，冲上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 4。
uses: 日常用 Claude Code、Cursor、Cline 等工具但担心额度与费用的个人开发者
需要统一管理多家 AI 供应商、做成本与配额控制的小团队
希望用免费或廉价模型替代高价 API 的独立开发者与创业者
想自建本地 AI 网关、避免供应商锁定的技术用户

en.tag: Smart router that connects AI coding tools to 40+ free/cheap model providers while saving tokens
en.what: 9Router is a locally-run AI routing gateway that connects coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline and Copilot to 40+ providers and 100+ models. It uses subscription→cheap→free auto-fallback, multi-account round-robin and RTK token compression so developers rarely hit limits or overspend.
en.content: It's a JavaScript project centered on a local routing server (default http://localhost:20128/v1) plus a web dashboard, with modules for RTK token compression, OpenAI↔Claude format translation, quota tracking and auto token refresh, shipped via npm, Docker and multi-language READMEs.
en.stack: Written mainly in JavaScript, distributed as an npm package and Docker/GHCR image, exposing an OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint and relying on various provider APIs and subscription credentials.
en.hot: It hits developers' cost pain with "unlimited free AI coding" and 20-40% token savings, racking up 28k+ stars and another 186 today to rank #4 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript).
uses: Individual developers using Claude Code, Cursor or Cline who worry about quotas and costs
Small teams needing unified multi-provider management with cost and quota control
Indie developers and founders wanting free or cheap models instead of pricey APIs
Technical users who want a self-hosted local AI gateway to avoid vendor lock-in

zh.tag: 跨平台开源 JavaScript 运行时，服务端 JS 的事实标准
zh.what: Node.js 是一个开源、跨平台的 JavaScript 运行时环境，让 JavaScript 可以脱离浏览器在服务器和命令行中运行。它基于 V8 引擎与事件驱动、非阻塞 I/O 模型，适合构建高并发的网络服务与工具链。
zh.content: 仓库是 Node.js 的核心源码与治理中心，包含 lib、src、deps、test、doc 等目录，以及 GOVERNANCE、发布流程、TSC 与协作者名单等社区文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 与 C++ 编写，核心依赖 V8、libuv、OpenSSL、zlib 等；通过 CMake/GYP 与 Python 构建，支持多平台二进制分发。
zh.hot: 作为服务端 JavaScript 的基石，它已积累 122003 颗星，本周再增 1098 星并登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 周榜第 7，说明生态关注度长期稳定。
uses: 后端与全栈开发者，用于构建 API、微服务与实时应用
前端/工具链工程师，运行构建脚本、CLI 与打包工具
DevOps 与平台团队，部署高并发网络服务与 Serverless 函数
学习者与教学场景，用同一门语言贯通前后端开发

en.tag: The open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime that powers server-side JS
en.what: Node.js is an open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime that lets JavaScript run outside the browser, on servers and the command line. Built on the V8 engine with an event-driven, non-blocking I/O model, it suits high-concurrency network services and tooling.
en.content: The repo is the core source and governance hub of Node.js, with lib, src, deps, test and doc directories plus GOVERNANCE, release process, TSC and collaborator docs.
en.stack: Written mainly in JavaScript and C++, depending on V8, libuv, OpenSSL and zlib; built via CMake/GYP and Python, with multi-platform binary distribution.
en.hot: As the cornerstone of server-side JavaScript, it has reached 122,003 stars, adding 1,098 this week and ranking 7th on GitHub Trending's weekly JavaScript list, showing sustained ecosystem attention.
uses: Backend and full-stack developers building APIs, microservices and realtime apps
Frontend and tooling engineers running build scripts, CLIs and bundlers
DevOps and platform teams deploying high-concurrency services and serverless functions
Learners and educators using one language across frontend and backend

zh.tag: 各大 AI 聊天机器人系统提示词泄露合集，持续更新
zh.what: 这个仓库逐字收集并整理各大 AI 产品在用户发出第一条消息前所收到的隐藏系统提示词与规则，涵盖 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、xAI 等厂商。内容按厂商与模型分门别类，并持续追踪最新版本。
zh.content: 仓库以 Markdown 文件为主，按厂商目录（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、xAI、Meta 等）存放各模型提示词，如 Claude Fable 5.1、Codex GPT-6-Astra、Gemini 3.7 Flash、Grok 4.6 等，并附最近更新表格。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript 为主语言，仓库本身基本是纯文本 Markdown 内容，依赖极少，主要靠社区 PR 与定期人工抓取维护。
zh.hot: 凭借 64,573 颗星和日增 125 星登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 5，加上《华盛顿邮报》等媒体基于其内容做报道，关注度持续走高。
uses: AI 研究者与提示词工程师，用于分析各家模型的隐藏规则与对齐策略

Product managers and founders referencing competitors' system prompts when designing their own AI products
Journalists and content creators investigating and reporting on the rules behind model behavior
General developers and enthusiasts curious about the actual instructions ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and others receive

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的市场营销技能库

zh.tag: 构建 Web 与原生界面的声明式 UI 库
zh.what: React 是用于构建用户界面的 JavaScript 库，以声明式、组件化的方式开发交互式 UI。它既能在浏览器端渲染，也能通过 Node 做服务端渲染，并借助 React Native 驱动移动应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 React 核心运行时源码（packages/react、react-dom、react-native-renderer 等）、React Compiler 编译器、测试套件与官方文档站点源码。

移动端团队用 React Native 复用逻辑开发原生应用

en.tag: The declarative library for web and native user interfaces
en.what: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces in a declarative, component-based way. It renders in the browser, on the server via Node, and powers mobile apps through React Native.
en.content: The repo holds the React core runtime (packages/react, react-dom, react-native-renderer, etc.), the React Compiler, test suites, and the source for the official docs site.

Existing projects adopting component architecture incrementally

zh.tag: AI 代理技能，一键生成可验证的交互式系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 AI 代理技能，可将代码库或系统描述转化为精美的交互式系统地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种预设、明暗主题和内置品牌标识，并能生成自包含的 HTML 文件，方便演示和分享。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和生成器代码，支持通过 npx 命令安装到 Raven、Cursor、Claude Code 等代理。提供项目页面、场景指南和画廊，展示不同用例。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML，使用 TypeScript 生成确定性校验的 JSON IR，并输出 HTML、PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式。依赖 npx 进行安装，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 18k+ 星标和日增千星的势头，Archify 满足了开发者对可视化架构文档的迫切需求，尤其在 AI 辅助开发场景下，能快速生成可验证的图表，提升代码审查和沟通效率。
uses: 开发者希望在代码审查前快速生成架构对比图，确保变更可验证。
技术写作者或架构师需要为系统设计生成交互式演示文档，便于向团队或客户展示。
AI 代理用户希望将代码库映射为可视化图表，以便更直观地理解系统结构和数据流。

en.tag: Agent skill that turns codebases into beautiful, verifiable interactive architecture diagrams
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that transforms a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive system map. It supports five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and built-in brand marks, producing self-contained HTML files for easy presentation and sharing.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, documentation, examples, and generator code, installable via npx into agents like Raven, Cursor, and Claude Code. It includes a project page, scenario guide, and gallery showcasing various use cases.
en.stack: Primarily HTML-based, using TypeScript to generate deterministically checked JSON IR, outputting HTML, PNG, SVG, WebM, and more. Installed via npx, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 18k+ stars and a daily gain of 1k, Archify addresses the urgent need for visual architecture documentation, especially in AI-assisted development, enabling quick generation of verifiable diagrams that boost code review and communication efficiency.
uses: Developers who want to quickly generate architecture comparison diagrams before code review to ensure changes are verifiable.
Technical writers or architects needing interactive presentation documents for system designs to share with teams or clients.
AI agent users who want to map codebases into visual diagrams for better understanding of system structure and data flow.

zh.tag: 洛雪音乐播放器的第三方音源脚本合集

en.hot: LX Music has a large user base but limited official sources, driving strong demand for community sources; the repo has reached 8,826 stars with 261 added this week, ranking 13th on the JavaScript weekly trending list.

en.tag: A free service giving developers a sweet-looking .is-a.dev subdomain
en.what: is-a.dev is a free subdomain service that lets any developer claim a clean, sweet-looking .is-a.dev subdomain for their personal site, blog, or project. You register by opening a pull request with your DNS records, and they go live within minutes of being merged.

uses: Indie developers wanting a clean domain for a personal homepage, blog, or portfolio
Students and open-source hobbyists who want a professional-looking URL on a budget
Teams needing a quick domain for a small project or demo site
Beginners learning DNS records and the GitHub PR workflow

zh.what: three.js 是一个易用、轻量、跨浏览器的 JavaScript 3D 库，让开发者用少量代码在网页中构建场景、相机、几何体与动画。它封装了底层图形 API，把复杂的 3D 渲染流程变成直观的对象模型。

en.tag: The general-purpose 3D library for the browser, powered by WebGL and WebGPU
en.what: three.js is an easy-to-use, lightweight, cross-browser JavaScript 3D library that lets developers build scenes, cameras, geometries and animations in the browser with minimal code. It wraps low-level graphics APIs, turning complex rendering pipelines into an intuitive object model.
en.content: The repo contains the core library source, WebGL and WebGPU renderers, plus addons such as SVG and CSS3D renderers, alongside extensive examples, docs, a manual and a wiki migration guide.

uses: Frontend developers adding 3D scenes, models or interactive effects to web pages
Data visualization and creative marketing pages needing high-performance graphics
Game, digital twin and VR/AR prototypers building 3D apps quickly
Teaching and learning scenarios using examples and docs to get started with Web 3D

en.what: This is a Claude Code plugin that lets users use OpenAI Codex directly within their Claude Code workflow for code reviews or task delegation. zh.tag: 为AI代理压缩命令输出的CLI代理，节省高达90%token
zh.what: RTK是一个高性能的CLI代理，在命令输出进入LLM上下文之前进行过滤和压缩，可减少60-90%的token消耗。它拦截shell命令，将冗长的输出转换为紧凑格式，例如将ls输出转为带文件计数的树形结构，仅保留git diff的关键变更等。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个用Rust编写的单一二进制文件，支持100多种命令，如ls、cat、grep、git、cargo test等。还提供安装脚本、文档（包括架构说明）和多语言README。
zh.stack: 纯Rust实现，零依赖，单一二进制文件，开销小于10ms。
zh.hot: 随着AI编程助手普及，token成本成为痛点，RTK能大幅削减成本，且安装简单、性能高，因此迅速走红。
uses: 使用Claude Code、Codex等AI编程助手的开发者，希望减少token消耗和费用。
需要处理大量命令行输出的DevOps工程师，通过压缩日志和状态信息提高效率。
对Rust高性能工具感兴趣的开发者，可学习其架构和实现。

en.tag: CLI proxy that compresses command output for AI agents, cutting token usage by up to 90%
en.what: RTK is a high-performance CLI proxy that filters and compresses command output before it reaches the LLM context, reducing token consumption by 60-90%. It intercepts shell commands and converts verbose output into compact formats, such as turning ls output into a tree with file counts and keeping only essential changes from git diff.
en.content: The repository contains a single Rust binary supporting over 100 commands like ls, cat, grep, git, cargo test, etc. It also includes installation scripts, documentation (including architecture), and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Pure Rust implementation, zero dependencies, single binary, overhead under 10ms.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants become popular, token costs are a pain point. RTK significantly cuts costs, is easy to install, and performs well, hence its rapid rise.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Codex who want to reduce token usage and costs.
DevOps engineers dealing with large command outputs, improving efficiency by compressing logs and status info.
Developers interested in high-performance Rust tools, who can learn from its architecture and implementation.

zh.tag: Rust 开源 CAD，支持 2D/3D 与 DWG/DXF 原生读写

zh.tag: 终端里找片、下载、播放影视与直播的 TUI 工具

zh.tag: 一条命令为你的硬件找到最合适的 LLM 模型
zh.what: llmfit 是一个终端工具，能根据你的系统 RAM、CPU 和 GPU 自动检测硬件，并为数百个模型和提供商评分，告诉你哪些模型能在你的机器上流畅运行。它提供交互式 TUI 和经典 CLI 两种模式，支持多 GPU、MoE 架构、动态量化选择、速度估算以及本地运行时提供商（如 Ollama、llama.cpp 等）。

zh.hot: 星标数达 32k，今日新增近 200，因其解决了本地 LLM 选型的痛点，且新版本支持基准测试并贡献结果，让用户获得真实硬件上的实测数据，迅速走红。

en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that detects your hardware and scores hundreds of models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, telling you which ones will run well on your machine. Developers: evaluate model performance in dev environments to optimize inference speed and resource usage.

在注册/登录流程中做邮箱真实性校验的后端开发者

en.what: check-if-email-exists is a Rust tool that determines whether an email address actually exists by performing SMTP handshakes, MX record lookups, syntax and domain checks, all without sending any email. It works as a Rust library, a CLI, or an HTTP backend service.
en.content: The repo contains the core Rust library, a standalone CLI binary, and a Docker-based HTTP backend (backend directory), plus a live demo at reacher.email.
en.stack: Written in Rust with the Tokio async runtime for SMTP communication, published on crates.io and docs.rs, with the backend distributed as a Docker image.

Backend developers validating email authenticity during signup or login flows

Ops teams self-hosting an HTTP email verification service for data control

en.content: The repo contains Argo CD's core controllers, API server, CLI, web UI, Helm charts, docs, and example manifests, along with integration tests and security scorecards.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it uses Kubernetes controller patterns and CRDs, integrates Helm, Kustomize, and Jsonnet, and ships as container images and Helm charts.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, Argo CD is a de facto GitOps standard with 24k+ stars and 65 added this week, ranking 6th on the Go weekly trending list amid strong community and enterprise adoption.

Teams needing auditability and rollback by version-controlling all app configs
Cloud-native orgs wanting a unified Helm/Kustomize release workflow
Developers and operators learning GitOps and declarative continuous delivery

en.tag: Standardized distributed generative and predictive AI inference platform on Kubernetes
en.what: KServe is a standardized distributed AI inference platform on Kubernetes that unifies both generative AI (LLMs) and predictive AI (traditional ML models) deployment. It offers an OpenAI-compatible inference protocol, multi-framework support, and autoscaling, so everything from quick experiments to enterprise-scale inference runs on one platform.
en.content: The repo is implemented in Go and contains controllers, CRDs, inference runtimes, and webhooks, along with docs diagrams and examples. It integrates generative backends like vLLM, llm-d, and Hugging Face, plus predictive frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, and ONNX.
en.stack: Built primarily in Go using Kubernetes CRD/Controller patterns, it depends on cloud-native components like Knative and Istio, and supports GPU acceleration, model caching, and KV cache offloading.
en.hot: As a CNCF incubating project adopted by many organizations, KServe hit GitHub Trending's Go daily list at #16 with 5,926 stars and 21 new stars today, reflecting sustained interest in cloud-native AI inference infrastructure.

Application developers who want to quickly integrate LLM inference via an OpenAI-compatible protocol
Enterprise MLOps teams seeking autoscaling, multi-framework support, and model explainability

zh.tag: 为现有 AI 编程代理提供记忆、工作流与可验证证据的确定性工程环境

uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理的开发者，希望增强代理的记忆和工作流能力。
团队需要规格驱动开发和可验证的代理行为，以提升代码质量和可审计性。
希望避免代理锁定，灵活切换或组合多种 AI 编程工具的用户。

Teams needing Spec-Driven Development and verifiable agent behavior for better code quality and auditability.
Users who want to avoid agent lock-in and flexibly switch or combine multiple AI coding tools.
AI engineering practitioners interested in advanced features like MCP servers, skill libraries, and personas.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理提供安全可控的多设备 MCP 运行时
zh.what: AgentDock 是一个独立的 AI 代理工具运行时，通过 MCP 协议让 ChatGPT、Claude、Codex 等客户端安全地操作本地电脑、远程服务器和容器。它统一提供文件、命令、Git、Skill、MCP、浏览器自动化和任务执行能力，并支持多实例编排，在一次对话中完成多机工作流。它本身不提供聊天界面，也不做模型推理，只负责在明确权限边界内执行操作并返回结构化、可追溯的结果。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 编写的服务端为核心，包含 MCP 运行时、多设备编排模块、权限与安全控制层，以及 Docker 镜像与发布产物。配套有文档站、CI 工作流和 logo/示意图等资源。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，基于 MCP 协议实现，提供 Docker Hub 与 GHCR 镜像，并配有 GitHub Actions CI。依赖以标准库和 MCP 相关组件为主，强调轻量部署与跨平台运行。

uses: 想让 AI 代理安全操作本地电脑或远程服务器的开发者
需要在一段对话中编排多台机器与容器工作流的运维/SRE 团队
希望复用现有 ChatGPT/Claude 订阅、避免额外编码额度的个人用户
为 AI 代理构建 MCP 工具链、关注权限边界的平台工程师

en.tag: Secure MCP runtime for AI agents across local machines, servers and containers
en.what: AgentDock is an independent tool runtime for AI agents that lets clients like ChatGPT, Claude and Codex securely operate local machines, remote servers and containers over MCP. It unifies file, command, Git, Skill, MCP, browser automation and task execution, and supports multi-instance orchestration so multi-machine workflows finish in one conversation. It provides no chat UI and no model inference—only permission-bounded execution with structured, traceable results.

Platform engineers building MCP toolchains with strict permission boundaries for agents

en.content: The repo contains the full C++ inference engine source, GGUF model loading and optimization, an Arena comparison UI, documentation and performance reports, plus GGUF model packages on Hugging Face and ModelScope.

en.hot: It gained 89 stars today, reaching 2,590 total, and topped GitHub Trending daily for C++. Its pure C++ no-Python approach, high performance (1.8-8x faster TTS on CUDA vs Python), and broad model support attract significant attention.
uses: C++ developers deploying local audio models (TTS/STT/voice conversion)
Engineers seeking high-performance inference without Python dependencies
Researchers running audio AI on edge devices or CPU-only machines
AI app developers comparing different audio model outputs

zh.tag: 用 ESP32-CAM 把老式水电气表数字化的边缘 AI 方案
zh.what: 这是一个基于 ESP32-CAM 的边缘计算项目，用摄像头拍摄传统机械式水表、电表、燃气表的读数，再通过本地运行的神经网络识别数字，把模拟表盘变成可联网的智能设备。整个过程在设备端完成，无需上云，成本低、易部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 固件源码（code/）、TensorFlow Lite 模型与训练工具、Web 配置界面、外壳 3D 打印文件、MkDocs 文档以及烧录工具和发布包。
zh.stack: 主语言为 C++，运行在 ESP32 上，集成 TensorFlow Lite Micro 做本地推理，配 Web 前端界面和 SD 卡存储，依赖 ESP-IDF 工具链。
zh.hot: 8731 颗星且今日新增 45，登上 C++ 日榜第一；它把边缘 AI 落到极其实用的抄表场景，硬件便宜、教程完整，吸引了大量 DIY 和物联网爱好者。
uses: 想把家里老式水表/电表/燃气表接入智能家居的 DIY 玩家
做物联网、边缘计算教学或课程项目的师生
需要低成本远程抄表方案的物业或小型公用事业运营者
对 ESP32 与 TensorFlow Lite 嵌入式 AI 感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: Edge AI on ESP32-CAM to digitize old water, gas and power meters
en.what: This is an edge-computing project built on the ESP32-CAM that photographs traditional mechanical water, power and gas meters and uses an on-device neural network to read the digits, turning analog meters into connected smart devices. Everything runs locally without the cloud, keeping it cheap and easy to deploy.
en.content: The repo ships C++ firmware source (code/), TensorFlow Lite models and training tools, a web configuration interface, 3D-printable casing files, MkDocs documentation, plus flashing tools and release packages.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ and running on the ESP32, it integrates TensorFlow Lite Micro for on-device inference, with a web frontend and SD-card storage, built on the ESP-IDF toolchain.
en.hot: With 8,731 stars and 45 added today, it tops the C++ daily trending list; it applies edge AI to the very practical task of meter reading, with cheap hardware and thorough docs that appeal to DIY and IoT enthusiasts.
uses: DIY hobbyists wanting to connect old water, power or gas meters to their smart home
Teachers and students doing IoT or edge-computing coursework
Property managers or small utilities needing low-cost remote meter reading
Developers curious about ESP32 and TensorFlow Lite embedded AI

zh.tag: 自托管游戏串流服务端，配合 Moonlight 使用
zh.what: Sunshine 是一个自托管的游戏串流服务端，兼容 Moonlight 客户端。它允许用户将 PC 上的游戏和应用串流到其他设备，支持低延迟和高画质。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建脚本、文档和图标资源。提供多种安装方式，如 Docker、Flatpak、Windows 安装包等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 FFmpeg、CUDA 等编解码库。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 4 万星标，本月新增 1103 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 22 名。其受欢迎程度源于对 NVIDIA GameStream 的替代需求，以及开源社区对自托管串流方案的青睐。
uses: 游戏玩家：将 PC 游戏串流到局域网内的其他设备，如笔记本、手机或电视。
远程办公或学习：远程访问高性能 PC 上的应用，实现移动办公。
开源爱好者：自建串流服务，摆脱对商业服务的依赖，保障隐私和自由度。

en.tag: Self-hosted game streaming host for Moonlight
en.what: Sunshine is a self-hosted game stream host that works with Moonlight clients. It enables users to stream games and applications from their PC to other devices with low latency and high quality.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, build scripts, documentation, and icon assets. Multiple installation methods are available, including Docker, Flatpak, Windows installers, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relying on FFmpeg, CUDA, and other codec libraries. Supports Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms.
en.hot: With over 40,000 stars and 1,103 new stars this month, ranking 22nd on the C++ monthly trending list, its popularity stems from the need for a replacement for NVIDIA GameStream and the community's preference for self-hosted streaming solutions.
uses: Gamers: stream PC games to other devices on the local network, such as laptops, phones, or TVs.
Remote work or study: remotely access applications on a high-performance PC for mobile productivity.
Open-source enthusiasts: self-host streaming services to avoid commercial dependencies, ensuring privacy and freedom.

zh.tag: 纯C/C++的高性能LLM推理引擎
zh.what: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。它针对本地部署和资源受限环境进行了优化，无需依赖庞大的深度学习框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理库 libllama、命令行工具、REST API 服务器（llama-server）以及 WebUI。支持多种量化格式（如 GGUF）和模型架构（如 LLaMA、GPT-OSS）。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，依赖 ggml 张量库，可选支持 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 等 GPU 加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的本地 LLM 推理方案之一，llama.cpp 持续获得社区关注，今日新增 159 星，总星数突破 12 万。其高性能、跨平台和易用性使其成为 AI 开发者和爱好者的首选。
uses: AI 开发者：在本地或边缘设备上运行和测试大语言模型
隐私敏感用户：无需联网即可使用 LLM，数据完全本地化
研究人员：探索模型量化、推理优化和自定义模型架构

en.tag: High-performance LLM inference engine in pure C/C++
en.what: llama.cpp is a high-performance LLM inference engine written in pure C/C++, optimized for CPU and GPU execution. It enables efficient local deployment without heavy deep learning frameworks.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library libllama, CLI tools, a REST API server (llama-server), and a WebUI. It supports various quantization formats (e.g., GGUF) and model architectures (e.g., LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
en.stack: Pure C/C++ implementation, relies on the ggml tensor library, with optional GPU backends like CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal.
en.hot: As one of the most popular local LLM inference solutions, llama.cpp continues to gain community traction with 159 new stars today, surpassing 120K total. Its performance, cross-platform support, and ease of use make it a top choice for AI developers and enthusiasts.
uses: AI developers: run and test LLMs locally or on edge devices
Privacy-conscious users: use LLMs offline with full data locality
Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures

zh.tag: 基于 Citra 的开源 3DS 模拟器，支持 PC 与移动端。
zh.what: Azahar 是一款免费开源的任天堂 3DS 模拟器，旨在让 3DS 玩家在 PC 和移动设备上以更高分辨率、现代控制器支持和即时存档等功能重温游戏库。它也是自制软件开发者的调试中心，以及 3DS 生态的研究与保存平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码，主要用 C++ 编写，并提供了 Windows、macOS 和 Android 的构建版本。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 C++ 为核心，依赖 CMake 构建系统，并使用了 Qt 等图形界面库。
zh.hot: 作为 Citra 的延续，Azahar 继承了其成熟技术并持续更新，获得了 8102 颗星，今日新增 12 星，位列 C++ 日榜第 4 名。
uses: 3DS 游戏玩家 —— 在 PC 或手机上以更高画质和便捷功能游玩 3DS 游戏。
自制软件开发者 —— 利用模拟器进行调试和测试。
游戏保存研究者 —— 用于 3DS 生态的研究与保存。

en.tag: An open-source 3DS emulator based on Citra, supporting PC and mobile.
en.what: Azahar is a free and open-source Nintendo 3DS emulator that lets 3DS owners enjoy their game library on PC and mobile with enhancements like higher resolutions, modern controller support, and save states. It also serves as a debugging hub for homebrew developers and a research and preservation platform for the 3DS ecosystem.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, primarily written in C++, with builds available for Windows, macOS, and Android.
en.stack: The tech stack is centered on C++, with CMake as the build system and libraries like Qt for the graphical interface.
en.hot: As a continuation of Citra, Azahar inherits its mature technology and is actively developed, earning 8,102 stars with 12 new stars today, ranking 4th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: 3DS game players — enjoy 3DS games on PC or mobile with enhanced graphics and convenient features.
Homebrew developers — use the emulator for debugging and testing.
Game preservation researchers — for research and preservation of the 3DS ecosystem.

zh.tag: OpenAI Whisper 语音识别模型的纯 C/C++ 高性能推理实现
zh.what: whisper.cpp 是 OpenAI Whisper 自动语音识别模型的 C/C++ 移植版，无需依赖即可运行。它面向多平台提供高性能、可离线、端侧部署的语音转文字能力。
zh.content: 核心实现集中在 include/whisper.h 与 src/whisper.cpp，其余依赖 ggml 机器学习库；仓库还包含 iOS、Android、WASM、Java 等多平台示例与绑定。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 编写，基于 ggml 张量库，支持 ARM NEON、Metal、Core ML、AVX、Vulkan、CUDA、ROCm、OpenVINO 等硬件加速与整数量化。
zh.hot: 凭借 53668 颗星与本周 192 新增，它稳居 C++ 周榜第 13 名，是端侧语音识别最受信赖的开源方案之一。
uses: 需要在手机、树莓派等边缘设备上离线运行语音识别的开发者
希望把语音转文字集成进桌面或移动应用的工程师
研究 ASR 模型量化与跨平台推理优化的技术团队
对隐私敏感、要求数据不出本地的语音处理场景

en.tag: High-performance C/C++ inference of OpenAI's Whisper ASR model
en.what: whisper.cpp is a dependency-free C/C++ port of OpenAI's Whisper automatic speech recognition model. It delivers high-performance, offline, on-device speech-to-text across many platforms.
en.content: The core lives in include/whisper.h and src/whisper.cpp, with the rest built on the ggml ML library; the repo also ships examples and bindings for iOS, Android, WASM, Java and more.
en.stack: Written in plain C/C++ on top of the ggml tensor library, with ARM NEON, Metal, Core ML, AVX, Vulkan, CUDA, ROCm and OpenVINO acceleration plus integer quantization.
en.hot: With 53,668 stars and 192 added this week, it ranks 13th on the C++ trending list, cementing its status as a go-to open-source solution for on-device speech recognition.
uses: Developers needing offline speech recognition on phones, Raspberry Pi and other edge devices
Engineers integrating speech-to-text into desktop or mobile apps
Teams researching ASR quantization and cross-platform inference optimization
Privacy-sensitive scenarios where audio must stay on-device

zh.tag: 开源像素画与动画精灵编辑器，跨三大桌面平台
zh.what: Aseprite 是一款用于制作动画精灵（sprite）的像素画编辑器，把图层与帧作为独立概念管理，支持实时预览与洋葱皮等动画辅助功能。它面向像素艺术家与独立游戏开发者，可导入导出精灵表、GIF 与 PNG 序列等多种格式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 编写的编辑器核心源码、构建脚本与 CI 配置，以及文档、翻译和脚本扩展相关目录，可自行编译出 Windows、macOS、Linux 版本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 CMake 构建，并集成 Lua 脚本引擎与 Skia 等图形库，通过 GitHub Actions 做多平台构建。
zh.hot: 作为像素画领域的经典开源工具，它已积累近 3.94 万 star，本周再增 191 星并登上 C++ 周榜第 4，说明像素风游戏与独立开发热度持续。
uses: 像素艺术家与独立游戏开发者制作角色动画和精灵图
游戏美术需要导出精灵表、GIF 或 PNG 序列接入引擎
想用 Lua 脚本和 CLI 自动化批量处理素材的技术美术
在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上寻找免费开源像素编辑器的用户

en.tag: Open-source animated sprite editor & pixel art tool for Windows, macOS and Linux
en.what: Aseprite is a pixel art editor for creating animated sprites, treating layers and frames as separate concepts with real-time preview and onion skinning. Aimed at pixel artists and indie game developers, it imports and exports sprite sheets, GIFs and PNG sequences among other formats.
en.content: The repo holds the C++ editor core source, build scripts and CI configs, plus docs, translations and scripting-related directories, letting you compile builds for Windows, macOS and Linux.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ with CMake builds, integrating a Lua scripting engine and graphics libraries such as Skia, with multi-platform builds via GitHub Actions.
en.hot: A classic open-source tool in the pixel art space, it has nearly 39.4k stars and gained 191 more this week, ranking 4th on the C++ weekly trending list, reflecting the ongoing popularity of pixel-art games and indie development.
uses: Pixel artists and indie game developers creating character animations and sprites
Game artists who need to export sprite sheets, GIFs or PNG sequences into engines
Technical artists automating asset pipelines with Lua scripting and the CLI
Users on Windows, macOS or Linux looking for a free open-source pixel editor

zh.tag: 全球首款免费开源的 PS3 模拟器与调试器
zh.what: RPCS3 是一款用 C++ 编写的 PlayStation 3 模拟器和调试器，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 FreeBSD。它允许用户在 PC 上运行 PS3 游戏，并提供调试功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器的完整源代码、构建脚本、文档（如 BUILDING.md）以及 Wiki 链接。项目还设有 Discord 服务器和论坛，用于讨论和兼容性报告。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖图形驱动和 Visual C++ 运行库。构建环境配置详见 BUILDING.md。
zh.hot: 作为 PS3 模拟器的先驱，RPCS3 持续吸引关注，本月新增 317 星，总星数达 19651，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 14 名。其活跃的社区和不断改进的兼容性是其热度来源。
uses: 游戏玩家：在 PC 上体验 PS3 独占游戏，无需主机硬件。
开发者：研究 PS3 架构，参与模拟器开发或逆向工程。
测试人员：贡献游戏兼容性报告，帮助改进模拟器。

en.tag: World's first free & open-source PS3 emulator/debugger
en.what: RPCS3 is a PlayStation 3 emulator and debugger written in C++, supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD. It allows users to run PS3 games on PC and provides debugging capabilities.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the emulator, build scripts, documentation (e.g., BUILDING.md), and links to the Wiki. The project also has a Discord server and forums for discussion and compatibility reports.
en.stack: Primarily C++, relies on graphics drivers and Visual C++ redistributables. Build environment setup is detailed in BUILDING.md.
en.hot: As a pioneer PS3 emulator, RPCS3 continues to attract attention, gaining 317 stars this month to reach 19,651 total, ranking 14th on the C++ trending list. Its active community and improving compatibility drive its popularity.
