Developers: Study PS3 architecture, contribute to emulator development or reverse engineering.
Testers: Submit game compatibility reports to help improve the emulator.

zh.tag: 跨显卡厂商的通用超分与帧生成桥接工具
zh.what: OptiScaler 是一款游戏画质增强工具，允许玩家在已支持 DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS 的游戏中替换超分方案，并管理帧生成功能。它还能通过实验性 OptiFG 在 DX12 游戏中启用帧生成，甚至支持 Nukem 模组将 DLSSG 转为 FSR3 帧生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 源代码、编译脚本、安装说明、已知问题列表以及详细的 Wiki 文档，并提供稳定版和 nightly 版下载。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 DirectX 12、Vulkan 等图形 API，并涉及 DLSS、FSR、XeSS 等超分技术。
zh.hot: 凭借跨显卡厂商的通用超分与帧生成能力，解决了玩家在非 Nvidia 显卡上无法使用 DLSS 等痛点，已获得 10726 颗星，今日新增 60 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 分类第 13 名。
uses: PC 游戏玩家：希望在非 Nvidia 显卡上使用 DLSS 或启用帧生成功能。
游戏模组爱好者：想要自定义游戏画质设置，替换超分方案。
技术研究者：对超分和帧生成技术跨平台实现感兴趣。
低配置玩家：通过帧生成提升游戏流畅度。

en.tag: Universal upscaling and frame generation bridge across GPU vendors
en.what: OptiScaler is a tool that lets you replace upscalers in games already supporting DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS, and manage frame generation. It can enable frame generation in DX12 games via experimental OptiFG, and supports the Nukem mod to convert DLSSG to FSR3 frame generation.
en.content: The repo contains C++ source code, build scripts, installation instructions, a known issues list, and detailed Wiki documentation, with stable and nightly releases available.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on graphics APIs like DirectX 12 and Vulkan, and integrates upscaling technologies such as DLSS, FSR, and XeSS.
en.hot: With its cross-vendor upscaling and frame generation capabilities, it solves the pain point of using DLSS on non-Nvidia GPUs, earning 10,726 stars with 60 added today, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending daily list for C++.
uses: PC gamers: want to use DLSS or enable frame generation on non-Nvidia GPUs.
Game modding enthusiasts: want to customize graphics settings and replace upscalers.
Tech researchers: interested in cross-platform implementations of upscaling and frame generation.
Low-spec players: improve game smoothness through frame generation.

zh.tag: 无膨胀的C++即时模式GUI库，极简依赖，适合工具开发
zh.what: Dear ImGui 是一个为 C++ 设计的无膨胀图形用户界面库，它输出优化的顶点缓冲区，可在支持 3D 管线的应用中随时渲染。它快速、可移植、渲染器无关且自包含，专为内容创建和调试工具而设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库文件（imgui.cpp、imgui.h 等）、多个后端（如 OpenGL、Vulkan、DirectX）和示例项目，以及文档和测试套件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，无外部依赖，支持多种渲染后端和平台绑定。
zh.hot: 凭借其轻量、高效和易集成的特点，Dear ImGui 在游戏开发和工具制作社区广受欢迎，已获得超过 76,000 颗星，本周新增 122 颗，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 16 名。
uses: 游戏开发者 —— 用于快速构建游戏内调试工具和编辑器界面
工具开发者 —— 创建内容创建工具和可视化调试工具
图形程序员 —— 集成到 3D 应用中实现即时 UI 渲染
C++ 学习者 —— 学习即时模式 GUI 设计和轻量级库架构

en.tag: Bloat-free immediate-mode GUI library for C++ with minimal dependencies, ideal for tooling
en.what: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free graphical user interface library for C++ that outputs optimized vertex buffers for rendering anytime in 3D-pipeline-enabled applications. It is fast, portable, renderer-agnostic, and self-contained, designed for content creation and debug tools.
en.content: The repository contains core library files (imgui.cpp, imgui.h, etc.), multiple backends (e.g., OpenGL, Vulkan, DirectX), example projects, documentation, and a test suite.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ with no external dependencies, supporting various rendering backends and platform bindings.
en.hot: With its lightweight, efficient, and easy-to-integrate nature, Dear ImGui is widely popular in game development and tooling communities, boasting over 76,000 stars with 122 added this week, ranking 16th on the C++ trending list.
uses: Game developers — for quickly building in-game debug tools and editor interfaces
Tool developers — for creating content creation and visualization/debug tools
Graphics programmers — for integrating immediate UI rendering into 3D applications
C++ learners — for studying immediate-mode GUI design and lightweight library architecture

zh.tag: 国产工业级深度学习框架，支持大规模分布式训练与跨平台部署
zh.what: 飞桨（PaddlePaddle）是中国首个自主研发的深度学习平台，2016 年开源，覆盖核心框架、基础模型库、端到端开发套件与服务平台。它面向工业实践，支持动态/静态图统一、自动并行与训推一体，服务超 2333 万开发者与 76 万家企业。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++/Python 框架源码、算子库、分布式训练与推理引擎、模型库及开发套件，并配有中英日多语言文档与安装脚本。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为核心实现，提供 Python 前端 API，依赖 CUDA/cuDNN、oneDNN、NCCL 等加速库，支持 Linux、Windows、macOS 及国产芯片平台。
zh.hot: 作为国产深度学习框架代表，本周登上 GitHub Trending C++ 周榜第 11 名，累计 24089 星，持续吸引关注工业级 AI 落地的开发者。
uses: 企业 AI 团队：需要工业级分布式训练与跨平台部署方案
高校与研究机构：用于深度学习教学、科研与国产化替代
算法工程师：希望快速构建从训练到推理的端到端流水线
国产芯片适配开发者：在信创环境下部署深度学习应用

en.tag: China's industrial-grade deep learning framework for large-scale distributed training and cross-platform deployment
en.what: PaddlePaddle is China's first independently developed deep learning platform, open-sourced in 2016, covering core frameworks, model libraries, end-to-end toolkits and service platforms. Built for industrial practice, it supports unified dynamic/static graphs, automatic parallelism and integrated training-inference, serving over 23.33M developers and 760K companies.
en.content: The repo contains the core C++/Python framework source, operator libraries, distributed training and inference engines, model libraries and development kits, plus multilingual docs and install scripts.
en.stack: Core implemented in C++ with a Python frontend API, depending on CUDA/cuDNN, oneDNN, NCCL and more, supporting Linux, Windows, macOS and domestic chip platforms.
en.hot: As a flagship domestic deep learning framework, it ranked 11th on GitHub Trending's weekly C++ list this week with 24,089 stars, drawing developers focused on industrial AI deployment.
uses: Enterprise AI teams needing industrial-grade distributed training and cross-platform deployment
Universities and research institutes for deep learning teaching, research and domestic alternatives
Algorithm engineers building end-to-end pipelines from training to inference
Domestic chip adaptation developers deploying deep learning in Xinchuang environments

zh.tag: 以源码为文档、保存数十年软硬件历史的多元模拟框架
zh.what: MAME 是一个多用途模拟框架，旨在保存数十年的软硬件历史，防止老旧的电子游戏、计算机和计算器被遗忘。它通过记录硬件及其运作方式来实现这一目标，而软件可运行则主要用于验证这份“文档”的准确性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 MAME 源代码，涵盖街机、家用电脑、游戏主机和计算器等大量系统的模拟实现，并配有 CI 配置、文档构建脚本和翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SDL 2.0 等库，支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 平台，可通过 make 命令构建。
zh.hot: 作为拥有超过 1 万 star 的经典开源项目，MAME 本周新增 32 star 并登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 C++ 第 14 名，体现了社区对数字保存与复古模拟的持续关注。
uses: 复古游戏爱好者，用于在现代设备上运行和体验经典街机与主机游戏
软件历史与数字保存研究者，用于研究早期硬件架构和软件生态
模拟器开发者，可参考其硬件文档化方法和模拟实现
教育场景，用于向学生展示计算机体系结构与历史演变

en.tag: A multi-purpose emulation framework preserving decades of software and hardware history through source code as documentation
en.what: MAME is a multi-purpose emulation framework dedicated to preserving decades of software and hardware history, keeping vintage electronic games, computers and calculators from being lost. It documents hardware and how it functions, with the software being usable primarily serving to validate the accuracy of that documentation.
en.content: The repository contains the complete MAME source code, covering emulation implementations for a vast range of arcade machines, home computers, consoles and calculators, along with CI configs, documentation build scripts and translation files.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on libraries such as SDL 2.0, supports Linux, macOS and Windows, and can be built via make.
en.hot: As a classic open-source project with over 10,000 stars, MAME gained 32 stars this week and ranked 14th on GitHub Trending's weekly C++ list, reflecting sustained community interest in digital preservation and retro emulation.
uses: Retro gaming enthusiasts who want to run and experience classic arcade and console games on modern devices
Software history and digital preservation researchers studying early hardware architectures and software ecosystems
Emulator developers who can reference its hardware documentation approach and emulation implementations
Educational settings for demonstrating computer architecture and historical evolution to students

zh.tag: DHH 打造的精致现代 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Omarchy 是一个由 DHH（Ruby on Rails 创始人）打造的 Linux 发行版，注重美观、现代和明确的观点。它提供了一套完整的桌面环境，包括终端、编辑器、AI 工具等，并配有详尽的用户手册。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 manual/ 目录，内含 51 篇 Markdown 格式的手册章节，涵盖入门、导航、应用、配置等主题。此外还有安装脚本和配置文件，用于构建和定制系统。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本进行系统配置和安装，依赖 Linux 生态中的各种开源工具（如 Neovim、终端模拟器等）。手册使用 Markdown 编写，并托管在 learn.omacom.io。
zh.hot: 凭借 DHH 的知名度和对美观、现代体验的强调，Omarchy 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 6475 星，总星数达 34824，登上趋势榜第三。
uses: 喜欢 DHH 风格、追求开箱即用且美观的 Linux 桌面用户
希望从 Mac/Windows 迁移到 Linux 并希望有完整指南的用户
对 Linux 发行版定制和配置感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: A beautiful, modern & opinionated Linux distro by DHH
en.what: Omarchy is a Linux distribution created by DHH (creator of Ruby on Rails), focusing on beauty, modernity, and strong opinions. It provides a complete desktop environment including terminal, editor, AI tools, and comes with an extensive user manual.
en.content: The repository contains a manual/ directory with 51 Markdown chapters covering topics like getting started, navigation, applications, and configuration. It also includes installation scripts and configuration files for building and customizing the system.
en.stack: Primarily uses Shell scripts for system configuration and installation, relying on various open-source tools from the Linux ecosystem (e.g., Neovim, terminal emulators). The manual is written in Markdown and hosted on learn.omacom.io.
en.hot: Thanks to DHH's fame and the emphasis on beautiful, modern experience, Omarchy quickly gained popularity on GitHub, adding 6,475 stars this week to reach 34,824 total, ranking #3 on the trending list.
uses: Linux desktop users who appreciate DHH's style and want a beautiful, out-of-the-box experience
Users migrating from Mac/Windows to Linux who want a comprehensive guide
Developers interested in customizing and configuring a Linux distribution

zh.tag: Claude 社区插件市场，只读镜像，每日同步
zh.what: 这是 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 的社区插件市场仓库，包含可安装的插件列表。它由 Anthropic 内部审核流程同步，所有插件都经过安全扫描和批准。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含一个 marketplace.json 文件，列出了所有社区插件及其元数据。此外还有 README 说明如何使用和提交插件。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Python，但仓库本身是静态 JSON 数据，由自动化流程同步。
zh.hot: 今日新增 190 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，因为 Claude 插件生态正在快速增长，开发者需要官方认可的插件来源。
uses: Claude Code 用户：通过命令行快速安装社区插件，扩展功能。
插件开发者：提交插件到官方市场，获得分发和曝光。
企业团队：在受控环境中使用经过安全审核的插件。

en.tag: Read-only mirror of Claude community plugin marketplace, synced nightly
en.what: This is the community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code, containing a list of installable plugins. It is synced from Anthropic's internal review pipeline, and all plugins have passed security scanning and approval.
en.content: The repository mainly contains a marketplace.json file listing all community plugins with their metadata, plus a README explaining how to use and submit plugins.
en.stack: Primary language is Python, but the repo itself is static JSON data synced by automated processes.
en.hot: Gained 190 stars today and hit the trending list, as the Claude plugin ecosystem is rapidly growing and developers need an official source for plugins.
uses: Claude Code users: quickly install community plugins via CLI to extend functionality.
Plugin developers: submit plugins to the official marketplace for distribution and visibility.
Enterprise teams: use security-reviewed plugins in controlled environments.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个开源的罗技外设配置工具，通过 HID++ 协议直接与设备通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 等功能。它无需罗技账号，不收集遥测数据，所有配置以本地 TOML 文件保存，强调隐私和本地优先。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个组件：OpenLogi GUI（GPUI 桌面应用，提供交互式鼠标图示、按键动作选择器、DPI 预设、SmartShift、RGB 键盘灯效、按应用配置文件等）、OpenLogi agent（后台服务，负责输入钩子和设备 I/O）以及相关的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 GPUI（Zed 编辑器所用的框架），通过 HID++ 协议与罗技设备通信，支持 Logi Bolt、Unifying 接收器、蓝牙直连和 USB 连接。
zh.hot: 作为罗技官方 Options+ 的开源替代品，它解决了用户对官方软件臃肿、遥测和账号要求的痛点，在 Rust 社区和追求隐私的用户中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 8600，今日新增 115。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的臃肿和遥测，获得本地优先的配置体验
Rust 开发者：对 GPUI 桌面应用开发或 HID++ 协议实现感兴趣的开发者
隐私倡导者：拒绝账号绑定和数据收集，偏好开源软件的用户

en.tag: A native, local-first Logitech Options+ alternative in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is an open-source Logitech peripheral configuration tool that communicates directly with devices via HID++, supporting button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift. It requires no Logitech account, collects no telemetry, and stores all configuration in local TOML files, emphasizing privacy and local-first principles.
en.content: The repository contains three components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI desktop app with interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles), OpenLogi agent (background service owning input hook and device I/O), plus documentation and config examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, the GUI is built with GPUI (the framework used by Zed editor), communicates with Logitech devices via HID++ protocol, supporting Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, and USB connections.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Logitech's official Options+, it addresses user pain points with bloat, telemetry, and account requirements, quickly gaining popularity in the Rust community and among privacy-conscious users, with over 8.6k stars and 115 added today.
uses: Logitech peripheral users who want a local-first config experience without bloat and telemetry
Rust developers interested in GPUI desktop app development or HID++ protocol implementation
Privacy advocates who reject account requirements and data collection, preferring open-source software

zh.tag: GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库
zh.what: 这是一个为 GPT-Image2 图像生成模型打造的提示词工程资源库，包含 500+ 逆向工程案例和 20+ 工业级模板，将提示词视为代码进行管理和复用。项目提供可视化网站用于浏览和复制提示词，并持续更新。
zh.content: 仓库包含数据目录（案例图片与提示词）、源码（网站前端）、模板库、技能提炼文档，以及多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主要基于 JavaScript，可能使用前端框架（如 React/Vue）构建可视化网站，依赖 GitHub Pages 或类似服务部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 500+ 逆向工程案例和 20+ 工业级模板，为 GPT-Image2 用户提供高质量提示词参考，今日新增 409 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: AI 图像生成爱好者：快速获取高质量提示词，提升生成效果。
提示词工程师：学习逆向工程案例，提炼可复用的技能。
产品团队：将提示词作为代码管理，实现工业化生成流程。

en.tag: Industrial prompt engine & template library for GPT-Image2
en.what: This is a prompt engineering resource library for the GPT-Image2 image generation model, featuring 500+ reverse-engineered cases and 20+ industrial templates, treating prompts as code for management and reuse. It provides a visual website for browsing and copying prompts, with continuous updates.
en.content: The repository contains data directories (case images and prompts), source code (website frontend), template library, skill extraction docs, and multilingual README.
en.stack: Primarily based on JavaScript, likely using a frontend framework (e.g., React/Vue) for the visual website, deployed via GitHub Pages or similar.
en.hot: With 500+ reverse-engineered cases and 20+ industrial templates, it offers high-quality prompt references for GPT-Image2 users, gaining 409 stars today and trending on GitHub.
uses: AI image generation enthusiasts: quickly obtain high-quality prompts to improve output.
Prompt engineers: learn from reverse-engineered cases and extract reusable skills.
Product teams: manage prompts as code for industrial generation workflows.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程助手提供 38 种编辑级图表模板
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Codex 和 Pi）设计的技能包，提供 38 种编辑级质量的图表类型。它生成自包含的 HTML+SVG 文件，无需构建步骤或外部依赖，并强调无阴影、无 Mermaid 风格的设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含 38 种图表类型的定义，每种都有浅色、深色和全编辑三种静态变体，以及文档和截图。还包含语义模式系统，可将行为与布局分离，并支持从 draw.io 或 Mermaid 源重绘图表。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML 和 SVG，无 JavaScript 或外部图像依赖。设计为与 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 等 AI 代理兼容，并支持 Agent Skills 标准。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得超过 30.9k 星标，今日新增 437 星。它解决了 AI 生成图表质量差的痛点，提供了设计师认可的高质量模板，并持续更新新图表类型。
uses: 开发者使用 Claude Code 或 Codex 生成架构图、流程图等，避免手动调整样式
内容创作者需要快速制作编辑级图表，用于博客、文档或演示
团队希望统一图表风格，通过读取网站自动匹配品牌视觉

en.tag: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi
en.what: A skill pack for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, offering 38 editorial-quality diagram types. It generates self-contained HTML+SVG files with no build step or external dependencies, emphasizing a clean design without shadows or Mermaid-style output.
en.content: The repo contains definitions for 38 diagram types, each with minimal light, minimal dark, and full-editorial static variants, plus docs and screenshots. It also includes a semantic pattern system that separates behavior from layout, and can redraw draw.io or Mermaid sources.
en.stack: Primarily HTML and SVG, with no JavaScript or external image dependencies. Designed to work with AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, and compatible with Agent Skills.
en.hot: The repo has gone viral on GitHub with over 30.9k stars and 437 stars today. It addresses the pain point of low-quality AI-generated diagrams by offering designer-approved templates, and it continuously adds new diagram types.
uses: Developers using Claude Code or Codex to generate architecture diagrams, flowcharts, etc., without manual styling
Content creators needing quick editorial-quality diagrams for blogs, docs, or presentations
Teams wanting consistent diagram styling, with automatic brand matching by reading a website

zh.tag: 一个菜单栏图标，替代十几个付费 Mac 应用
zh.what: Vorssaint 是一个免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具包，将音量控制、系统监控、窗口管理等多种实用功能整合到一个菜单栏图标中。它旨在替代多个付费应用，提供简洁统一的用户体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Swift 项目源码，包括菜单栏面板（如混音器、系统监控、窗口控制）、文档、CI 配置和发布资源。
zh.stack: 使用 Swift 开发，面向 macOS 14+ 和 Apple Silicon，采用 GPL-3.0 许可证，并依赖 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1.1 万星，总星数达 1.5 万，因其免费开源、功能强大且替代多个付费应用而广受欢迎，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 希望减少付费 Mac 应用数量、追求性价比的用户
需要快速访问音量、系统监控和窗口管理的效率工作者
对开源和隐私保护有要求的 macOS 用户

en.tag: One menu bar icon replacing a dozen paid Mac apps
en.what: Vorssaint is a free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit that consolidates volume control, system monitoring, window management, and other utilities into a single menu bar icon. It aims to replace multiple paid apps with a clean, unified experience.
en.content: The repository contains the full Swift project source, including menu bar panels (mixer, system monitor, window controls), documentation, CI config, and release assets.
en.stack: Built with Swift, targeting macOS 14+ and Apple Silicon, licensed under GPL-3.0, and uses GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: Gained 11k stars this month, reaching 15k total, popular for being free, open-source, and replacing multiple paid apps, trending on GitHub.
uses: Users wanting to reduce paid Mac apps and seek cost-effectiveness
Productivity workers needing quick access to volume, system monitoring, and window controls
macOS users who value open-source and privacy

zh.tag: 本地多智能体框架，复用现有订阅，打造你的克隆办公室
zh.what: Munder Difflin 是一个本地多智能体运行框架，能将你已有的 Claude Code、Codex 等终端编码 CLI 转化为你的克隆体，让它们在你离开时继续工作。它协调整个智能体办公室，在你的机器上并行处理任务，并支持消息传递、路由和记忆。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 桌面应用，提供可视化办公室楼层，智能体以头像形式在工位上并行工作，并配有指挥中心和实时终端。核心组件包括智能体协调器、消息路由和记忆系统。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 Electron 和 React 作为桌面框架，Pixi.js 渲染可视化，xterm.js 和 node-pty 提供终端模拟。支持多种 CLI 工具和本地 LLM。
zh.hot: 本月新增 6210 星，总星数达 7432，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 12 名，因其能复用现有订阅、免费开源且性能出色而迅速走红。
uses: 开发者希望自动化日常编码任务，同时利用现有 AI 订阅
团队需要并行处理多个编码任务，提高效率
个人用户想要一个本地、可定制的多智能体工作环境

en.tag: Local multi-agent harness that reuses your subscriptions to run an office of clones
en.what: Munder Difflin is a local multi-agent harness that turns your existing terminal coding CLIs, like Claude Code and Codex, into clones of you that keep working while you're away. It coordinates an entire office of agents on your own machine, with messaging, routing, and memory.
en.content: The repo contains an Electron desktop app featuring a visual office floor where agents work in parallel as avatars at desks, along with a command center and live agent terminals. Core components include an agent coordinator, message routing, and memory system.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using Electron and React for the desktop app, Pixi.js for visualization, and xterm.js with node-pty for terminal emulation. Supports various CLI tools and local LLMs.
en.hot: Gained 6,210 stars this month, reaching 7,432 total, and ranked #12 on GitHub Trending monthly. It's hot because it reuses existing subscriptions, is free and open source, and performs well.
uses: Developers looking to automate daily coding tasks while leveraging existing AI subscriptions
Teams needing to parallelize multiple coding tasks for efficiency
Individuals wanting a local, customizable multi-agent work environment

zh.tag: 统一 AI 开发与部署平台，含 MAX 框架与 Mojo 语言
zh.what: Modular Platform 是一个开源平台，旨在统一 AI 开发与部署流程，包含 MAX 框架（用于模型推理和部署）和 Mojo 语言（一种面向 AI 的高性能编程语言）。它提供从模型编译、优化到服务部署的完整工具链，并支持 OpenAI 兼容的端点。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Mojo 编译器、Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库、MAX 推理服务器、MAX 模型流水线以及大量代码示例。目录结构清晰，分为 /KGEN、/mojo、/max 等模块，方便开发者浏览和贡献。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Mojo 语言编写，同时涉及 Python（用于 MAX 的 Python API）和 C++（底层内核）。依赖 LLVM 等编译器基础设施，并遵循 Apache 2.0 许可证（含 LLVM 例外）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 268 星，总星数 27933，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。Mojo 语言和 MAX 框架的独特定位吸引了大量 AI 开发者，其高性能和统一平台理念备受关注。
uses: AI 开发者：使用 Mojo 语言编写高性能 AI 模型，或利用 MAX 框架进行模型部署和推理。
MLOps 工程师：通过 MAX 推理服务器快速搭建 OpenAI 兼容的模型服务。
研究人员：在 MAX 流水线中集成自定义模型架构，并利用加速器库优化性能。
开源贡献者：参与 Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库等模块的开发和改进。

en.tag: Unified AI development & deployment platform, including MAX framework and Mojo language
en.what: The Modular Platform is an open-source platform that unifies AI development and deployment, including the MAX framework for model inference and deployment, and the Mojo language, a high-performance programming language for AI. It provides a complete toolchain from model compilation and optimization to service deployment, with OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
en.content: The repo contains the Mojo compiler, Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, MAX inference server, MAX model pipelines, and numerous code examples. The directory structure is clear, with modules like /KGEN, /mojo, /max, making it easy to navigate and contribute.
en.stack: Primarily written in Mojo, with Python for MAX's Python API and C++ for low-level kernels. It relies on LLVM and other compiler infrastructure, and is licensed under Apache 2.0 with LLVM exceptions.
en.hot: With 268 stars added today and 27,933 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. The unique positioning of Mojo and MAX attracts AI developers, drawing attention to its high performance and unified platform concept.
uses: AI developers: Use Mojo to write high-performance AI models or leverage MAX for deployment and inference.
MLOps engineers: Quickly set up OpenAI-compatible model serving with the MAX inference server.
Researchers: Integrate custom model architectures in MAX pipelines and optimize performance with the accelerator library.
Open-source contributors: Contribute to the Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, and more.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，日志即运行时
zh.what: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，用于实际工作而非仅仅回答问题。它通过受控权限检查项目、执行工具、生成工件，并将模型消息和工具调用记录为可恢复的执行事实。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（Electron + React）、终端 TUI 和 CLI（maka, maka run）、评估工具（maka eval run），以及核心的 Runtime Host 和 Runtime Event Log 实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，桌面端基于 Electron 和 React，支持多种模型连接（云 API、本地模型或兼容网关），并包含本地工具如 Read、Write、Edit、Bash、Glob 和 Grep。
zh.hot: 今日新增 460 星，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜第 7，因其本地优先、日志即运行时的创新架构，以及 Apache 孵化项目的背书，吸引了关注 AI 代理可靠性和可恢复性的开发者。
uses: 日常 AI 辅助开发：在本地项目中安全地让代理读写文件、执行命令。
需要可审计、可恢复的 AI 代理工作流的团队，用于记录和回溯每次工具调用。
AI 代理评估：使用 maka eval 进行可复现的基准测试。
偏好本地优先、数据不出机器的隐私敏感用户。

en.tag: Local-first AI agent workspace with log-as-runtime architecture
en.what: Apache Maka is a local-first AI agent workspace built for real work. It inspects projects, executes tools, produces artifacts with controlled permissions, and preserves model messages and tool calls as recoverable execution facts.
en.content: The repo includes a desktop app (Electron + React), a terminal TUI and CLI (maka, maka run), an evaluation tool (maka eval run), and the core Runtime Host and Runtime Event Log implementation.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Electron and React for the desktop app, supporting multiple model connections (cloud API, local model, or compatible gateway), and local tools including Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, and Grep.
en.hot: With 460 stars added today and ranking #7 on the TypeScript trending list, its local-first, log-as-runtime architecture and Apache incubation status attract developers focused on AI agent reliability and recoverability.
uses: Daily AI-assisted development: let agents safely read/write files and run commands in local projects.
Teams needing auditable and recoverable AI agent workflows, with logs of every tool call.
AI agent evaluation: use maka eval for reproducible benchmark experiments.
Privacy-conscious users preferring local-first, data-stays-on-machine solutions.

zh.tag: Google 时序预测基础模型，支持多变量与协变量
zh.what: TimesFM 是 Google Research 开发的预训练时序基础模型，用于时间序列预测。它采用 decoder-only 架构，在大量时序数据上预训练，能够进行零样本预测。最新 3.0 版本支持原生多变量预测和协变量，并在多个基准上排名第一。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型源码、预训练权重（Hugging Face）、示例和文档。代码结构分版本管理，最新 3.0 在根目录，旧版本归档在 v1 子目录。
zh.stack: 基于 PyTorch 实现，依赖 Hugging Face Transformers 等。提供 pip 包安装，支持 Python。
zh.hot: 近期发布 3.0 版本，带来多变量预测和协变量支持，在三大基准上排名第一，引发社区关注。今日新增 1618 star，总星标超 3 万。
uses: 时间序列预测研究者：用于零样本预测和模型对比实验
数据科学家：快速进行多变量预测，无需大量训练数据
企业应用开发者：集成到 BigQuery ML 或 Vertex AI 进行规模化预测

en.tag: Google's pretrained time-series foundation model for forecasting, with multivariate & covariate support
en.what: TimesFM is a pretrained time-series foundation model by Google Research for time-series forecasting. It uses a decoder-only architecture pretrained on diverse time-series data, enabling zero-shot forecasting. The latest 3.0 version natively supports multivariate forecasting and covariates, ranking #1 on multiple benchmarks.
en.content: The repo contains model source code, pretrained weights (on Hugging Face), examples, and docs. Code is organized by version; latest 3.0 is at root, older versions archived under v1.
en.stack: Implemented in PyTorch, leveraging Hugging Face Transformers. Installable via pip, Python-based.
en.hot: The recent 3.0 release with native multivariate forecasting and covariates, achieving #1 on three major benchmarks, has sparked interest. Gained 1,618 stars today, total over 30k.
uses: Time-series researchers: for zero-shot forecasting and model benchmarking
Data scientists: for quick multivariate forecasting without extensive training data
Enterprise developers: integrating with BigQuery ML or Vertex AI for scalable forecasting

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理提供跨工具、跨机器的长期记忆与交接协议
zh.what: ai-memory 为 AI 编码 CLI 提供长期记忆层，让不同厂商的代理共享同一份项目记忆。中途退出 Claude Code 后，可在同目录用 Codex 继续任务，无需重新解释架构、失败尝试和未决问题。记忆存放在自托管服务器上，支持跨机器与团队共享。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的单二进制服务端与生命周期钩子，记忆以 git 管理的普通 Markdown wiki 为真源，数据库只是可重建的派生索引。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 1.95+ 编写，MIT 许可，依赖自托管服务器与 git 仓库，默认路径零 LLM 调用、无需 API key。
zh.hot: 本月新增 5269 星、总数达 6694，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 13 名，切中多代理协作中记忆孤岛的痛点。
uses: 在多个 AI 编码 CLI 之间切换的开发者，希望任务无缝交接
需要跨台式机与笔记本共享项目记忆的个人开发者
希望团队共享代理会话知识并保留审计日志的工程团队
偏好用 Markdown 和 git 管理记忆、不想维护向量库的用户

en.tag: Long-term memory and handoff protocol for AI coding agents across tools and machines
en.what: ai-memory provides a long-term memory layer for AI coding CLIs, letting agents from different vendors share one project memory. Quit Claude Code mid-task, open Codex in the same directory, and continue without re-explaining the architecture, failed approaches, or open questions. Memory lives on a self-hosted server, enabling cross-machine and team sharing.
en.content: The repo contains a single Rust binary server plus lifecycle hooks; memory's source of truth is a git-backed wiki of plain Markdown files, with the database as a rebuildable derived index.
en.stack: Written in Rust 1.95+ under MIT license, relying on a self-hosted server and git repo; the default path uses zero LLM calls and needs no API key.
en.hot: Gained 5,269 stars this month for 6,694 total, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending monthly, hitting the pain point of memory silos in multi-agent workflows.
uses: Developers switching between multiple AI coding CLIs who want seamless task handoff
Solo developers wanting shared project memory across desktop and laptop
Engineering teams needing shared agent session knowledge with audit logs
Users who prefer Markdown and git over maintaining a vector store

zh.tag: 聚合34家免费LLM提供商的统一API网关
zh.what: FreeLLMAPI 是一个开源项目，将数十家免费 LLM 提供商的免费额度聚合到一个 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 端点后面。它提供智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥管理，让开发者无需管理多个 API 密钥即可访问大量免费模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 TypeScript 编写的 API 网关，支持 Docker 自托管、桌面应用（macOS/Windows）和 Android 应用。它提供了一个仪表板，用于监控每月 token 预算，并包含一个自动更新的模型目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，支持 Docker 部署，并提供桌面和移动端应用。依赖 OpenAI 兼容 API 标准，集成多个 LLM 提供商。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得近 2 万星标，日增 174 星。它解决了开发者对免费 LLM 资源分散、难以管理的痛点，提供了一站式解决方案。
uses: 个人开发者：快速集成多个免费 LLM，无需单独注册和付费。
原型开发：在项目初期使用免费模型验证想法，降低开发成本。
学习与研究：探索不同 LLM 的能力，进行对比实验。
自动化工具：为聊天机器人、内容生成等应用提供统一 API 接口。

en.tag: Unified API gateway aggregating 34 free LLM providers
en.what: FreeLLMAPI is an open-source project that aggregates free tiers from dozens of LLM providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. It offers smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key management, allowing developers to access a vast array of free models without managing multiple API keys.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based API gateway with Docker self-hosting, desktop apps for macOS/Windows, and an Android app. It includes a dashboard for monitoring monthly token budgets and an auto-updating model catalog.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Docker deployment and desktop/mobile apps. Relies on OpenAI-compatible API standards and integrates multiple LLM providers.
en.hot: The project has gained nearly 20k stars with 174 new stars today, addressing the pain point of scattered free LLM resources by offering a one-stop solution.
uses: Individual developers: Quickly integrate multiple free LLMs without separate registrations and payments.
Prototyping: Validate ideas with free models in early stages, reducing development costs.
Learning and research: Explore capabilities of different LLMs and run comparative experiments.
Automation tools: Provide a unified API for chatbots, content generation, and more.

zh.tag: 为专业 AI 编程代理打造的安全验证技能注册表
zh.what: 这是一个面向 AI 编程代理的技能注册表，提供经过验证、测试且安全的能力包，用于扩展 Antigravity、Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等工具。它针对市面上超过 13% 的技能存在严重漏洞的问题，主打安全可信。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能包集合、MCP 服务器实现、文档站点以及贡献指南，以 TypeScript 编写的 CLI 和库形式发布到 npm。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript（100%）和 Node.js（>=22），使用 Nx Cloud 进行构建，采用 semantic-release 管理版本，并发布为 npm 包 @tech-leads-club/agent-skills。
zh.hot: 项目今日新增 265 星，总星数达 5658，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4 名，反映出开发者对 AI 代理技能安全性的高度关注。
uses: AI 编程代理用户，希望安全地扩展 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具的能力
开发团队，需要为内部 AI 代理引入经过验证的技能包
安全工程师，关注 AI 技能供应链漏洞并寻求可信来源
技能贡献者，想要发布和维护经过审核的代理技能

en.tag: The secure, validated skill registry for professional AI coding agents
en.what: This is a skill registry for AI coding agents, offering verified, tested, and safe capability packages to extend tools like Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot. It addresses the fact that over 13% of marketplace skills contain critical vulnerabilities, focusing on security and trust.
en.content: The repo contains a collection of skill packages, an MCP server implementation, documentation site, and contribution guidelines, published to npm as a TypeScript CLI and library.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript (100%) and Node.js (>=22), using Nx Cloud for builds, semantic-release for versioning, and published as the npm package @tech-leads-club/agent-skills.
en.hot: It gained 265 stars today, reaching 5,658 total and ranking 4th on GitHub Trending daily, reflecting strong developer interest in the security of AI agent skills.
uses: AI coding agent users who want to safely extend tools like Claude Code and Cursor
Development teams needing verified skill packages for internal AI agents
Security engineers concerned about AI skill supply chain vulnerabilities and seeking trusted sources
Skill contributors who want to publish and maintain vetted agent skills

zh.tag: 2小时从零训练64M超小语言模型，全流程开源教程
zh.what: MiniMind 是一个从零开始训练超小语言模型（64M参数）的开源项目，仅需3块钱成本和2小时即可在单张消费级GPU上完成训练。项目覆盖从数据清洗、预训练到SFT、RLHF、Agentic RL等完整链路，并扩展了视觉、多模态等变体。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的训练代码、模型结构定义、数据预处理脚本、训练教程和多个模型变体（如MiniMind-V、MiniMind-O）。所有核心算法均用PyTorch原生实现，不依赖高层封装库。
zh.stack: 基于Python和PyTorch，从零实现Transformer、MoE、LoRA、DPO、PPO等算法，不依赖transformers/trl等库。
zh.hot: 以极低成本（3元/2小时）训练LLM的颠覆性理念，加上全流程开源和教程性质，吸引了大量希望深入理解LLM的开发者。56k星标和日增近500星，说明其精准切中了个人开发者复现大模型的需求。
uses: LLM初学者：通过从零实现和训练，深入理解大模型内部机制，而非仅使用现成库。
个人开发者/研究者：在消费级GPU上快速实验预训练、微调、RLHF等全流程。
教育场景：作为高校或培训机构的AI课程实战项目，低成本复现前沿技术。
对模型压缩和高效训练感兴趣者：探索64M小模型的性能边界和扩展方向。

en.tag: Train a 64M LLM from scratch in 2h with full pipeline, open-source tutorial
en.what: MiniMind is an open-source project to train a tiny 64M-parameter LLM from scratch, costing only $0.4 and 2 hours on a single consumer GPU. It covers the full pipeline from data cleaning, pretraining to SFT, RLHF, Agentic RL, and extends to vision and multimodal variants.
en.content: The repo contains full training code, model architecture definitions, data preprocessing scripts, tutorials, and several model variants (e.g., MiniMind-V, MiniMind-O). All core algorithms are implemented natively in PyTorch without high-level wrappers.
en.stack: Built with Python and PyTorch, implementing Transformer, MoE, LoRA, DPO, PPO from scratch, without relying on libraries like transformers/trl.
en.hot: The disruptive idea of training an LLM for just $0.4 and 2 hours, combined with full open-source pipeline and tutorial nature, attracts developers eager to understand LLMs deeply. With 56k stars and ~500 daily additions, it hits the need for personal reproduction of LLMs.
uses: LLM beginners: gain deep understanding of LLM internals by implementing and training from scratch, not just using off-the-shelf libraries.
Individual developers/researchers: quickly experiment with pretraining, fine-tuning, RLHF on consumer GPUs.
Educational settings: as a hands-on project for AI courses, reproducing cutting-edge techniques at low cost.
Those interested in model compression and efficient training: explore the performance limits of 64M small models.

zh.tag: 免费公共 API 大全，开发者资源宝库
zh.what: 这是一个由社区维护的免费公共 API 集合，涵盖动物、动漫、反恶意软件、艺术与设计、认证与授权、区块链、书籍、商业、日历、云存储与文件等众多领域。它为开发者提供了丰富的 API 资源，方便他们快速查找和集成到自己的项目中。
zh.content: 仓库以 README 为主，按类别列出所有 API，每个 API 包含名称、描述、认证方式、是否支持 HTTPS 和 CORS 等信息。此外，还包含贡献指南和 API 提交要求。
zh.stack: 仓库本身是纯文档，主要使用 Markdown 编写。主语言标记为 Python，但实际内容不涉及代码。
zh.hot: 该仓库拥有超过 46 万 star，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的资源列表之一。今日新增 2260 star，持续受到开发者关注，因为它提供了免费 API 的集中索引，节省了开发者搜索和筛选的时间。
uses: 开发者寻找免费 API 用于个人项目或原型开发
技术爱好者探索不同领域的 API，学习集成方法
产品经理或创业者调研可用的 API 服务，评估可行性
教育场景中作为教学资源，帮助学生了解 API 生态

en.tag: A curated list of free public APIs for developers
en.what: This is a community-maintained collection of free public APIs, covering a wide range of categories such as Animals, Anime, Anti-Malware, Art & Design, Authentication & Authorization, Blockchain, Books, Business, Calendar, Cloud Storage & File, and more. It provides developers with a rich resource of APIs to quickly find and integrate into their projects.
en.content: The repository is primarily a README that lists all APIs by category, with each API including name, description, auth, HTTPS, and CORS. It also includes contribution guidelines and API submission requirements.
en.stack: The repository is documentation-only, written in Markdown. The primary language is marked as Python, but there is no actual code.
en.hot: With over 460k stars, this is one of the most popular resource lists on GitHub. Today it gained 2260 stars, remaining a go-to for developers as it provides a centralized index of free APIs, saving time on searching and filtering.
uses: Developers looking for free APIs for personal projects or prototyping
Tech enthusiasts exploring APIs across domains to learn integration
Product managers or entrepreneurs researching available API services for feasibility
Educational use as a teaching resource to understand the API ecosystem

zh.tag: 把任意 AI 代理变成科学家的技能库，覆盖生物、化学、医学等 163 个技能
zh.what: 这是一个开源的科学 Agent 技能库，提供 163 个即用型技能和 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物学、化学、医学和药物发现。它兼容 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理，并遵循开放的 Agent Skills 标准，让任何 AI 代理都能执行科学任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、测试用例、文档和示例，以及一个可选的本地 AI 协同科学家工具 K-Dense BYOK。技能以标准格式组织，便于集成和扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Agent Skills 标准，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3.47 万星标和 17.5 万科学家用户，它填补了 AI 代理在科学领域应用的空白，成为最受欢迎的科学技能库。
uses: 科研人员：快速让 AI 代理执行文献分析、实验设计等任务。
开发者：为 AI 代理集成科学技能，构建垂直领域应用。
教育者：在教学中使用 AI 辅助科学探索，提升学生参与度。

en.tag: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist with 163 validated skills and 100+ scientific databases.
en.what: An open-source library of scientific Agent Skills, offering 163 ready-to-use skills and 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. It works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents, following the open Agent Skills standard, enabling any agent to perform scientific tasks.
en.content: The repo contains skill definitions, tests, documentation, examples, and an optional local AI co-scientist tool K-Dense BYOK. Skills are organized in a standard format for easy integration and extension.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, relying on the Agent Skills standard, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 34.7k stars and 175k+ scientist users, it fills a gap in AI agent applications for science, becoming the most popular scientific skills library.
uses: Researchers: quickly enable AI agents to perform literature analysis, experiment design, etc.
Developers: integrate scientific skills into AI agents to build domain-specific applications.
Educators: use AI-assisted scientific exploration in teaching to boost student engagement.

zh.tag: 全自动去除语言模型审查的优化工具
zh.what: Heretic 是一个无需昂贵后训练即可移除 Transformer 语言模型审查（安全对齐）的工具。它结合方向消融（abliteration）与基于 TPE 的参数优化器，自动寻找高质量消融参数，同时最小化拒绝次数和与原始模型的 KL 散度，从而保留模型智能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 实现、命令行界面、自动优化流程、支持多种模型架构（稠密、MoE、混合如 Qwen3.5），并提供示例配置和基准测试结果。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers、Optuna（TPE 优化器）等，实现方向消融和参数优化。
zh.hot: 2.87 万星标，日增 150，登上日榜第 6。它让非专家也能一键去除模型审查，且效果媲美人工调优，引发广泛关注。
uses: AI 研究人员和开发者，希望快速去除模型审查而不损失性能。
对模型安全对齐机制感兴趣，想探索方向消融技术的实践者。
需要定制模型行为、去除内容限制的普通用户，无需深入理解内部原理。

en.tag: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models via TPE-based optimization
en.what: Heretic is a tool that removes censorship (safety alignment) from transformer-based language models without expensive post-training. It combines directional ablation (abliteration) with a TPE-based parameter optimizer to automatically find high-quality parameters that minimize refusals and KL divergence from the original model, preserving intelligence.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python implementation, CLI, automatic optimization pipeline, support for dense, MoE, and hybrid models (e.g., Qwen3.5), along with example configs and benchmark results.
en.stack: Built with Python, leveraging PyTorch, Transformers, and Optuna for TPE-based optimization, implementing directional ablation.
en.hot: With 28.7k stars and +150 daily, ranking #6 on the daily trend, it enables non-experts to decensor models with one command, rivaling manual abliteration, sparking wide interest.
uses: AI researchers and developers seeking to remove model censorship quickly without performance loss.
Practitioners interested in safety alignment mechanisms and directional ablation techniques.
General users who need to customize model behavior or remove content restrictions without deep technical knowledge.

zh.tag: 截图秒变前端代码的AI工具
zh.what: 这是一个利用AI将截图、设计稿、Figma设计甚至屏幕录制转换为干净、可运行的前端代码（如HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue）的工具。用户只需上传图片或录制视频，即可获得对应的功能原型或代码实现。
zh.content: 仓库包含React/Vite前端和FastAPI后端，支持多种技术栈（HTML+Tailwind、React+Tailwind、Vue+Tailwind等），并集成多个AI模型（如Gemini、GPT、Claude）用于代码生成和图像处理。
zh.stack: 主要使用Python（FastAPI）作为后端，前端采用React/Vite，依赖OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini等AI模型API，以及Replicate用于图像生成和编辑。
zh.hot: 凭借75.5K星标和今日新增326星，该工具因其直观的“截图转代码”功能而广受欢迎，大幅降低了前端开发门槛，尤其适合快速原型制作。
uses: 前端开发者快速将设计稿或截图转化为可用的HTML/CSS/React代码
产品经理或设计师验证UI概念，无需手动编写代码
教育场景中教学前端开发，通过示例直观展示代码生成

en.tag: Turn screenshots into clean frontend code with AI
en.what: This is a tool that uses AI to convert screenshots, mockups, Figma designs, and even screen recordings into clean, functional frontend code (e.g., HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue). Users upload an image or recording and get a working prototype or code implementation.
en.content: The repo includes a React/Vite frontend and a FastAPI backend, supporting multiple stacks (HTML+Tailwind, React+Tailwind, Vue+Tailwind, etc.) and integrating several AI models (e.g., Gemini, GPT, Claude) for code generation and image processing.
en.stack: Primarily Python (FastAPI) backend with React/Vite frontend, relying on AI model APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Replicate for image generation/editing.
en.hot: With 75.5K stars and +326 today, this tool is popular for its intuitive 'screenshot-to-code' capability, significantly lowering the barrier for frontend development, especially for rapid prototyping.
uses: Frontend developers quickly convert design mockups or screenshots into usable HTML/CSS/React code
Product managers or designers validate UI concepts without manually writing code
Educational settings for teaching frontend development by visually demonstrating code generation

zh.tag: 开源零加价 LLM 网关，统一路由 BYOK 与 1000+ 模型
zh.what: Experiential 是一个面向 Agent 工作流的开源网关与路由器，用一套 OpenAI 兼容 API 统一接入托管、BYOK 和本地模型。它还能基于你的真实流量学习，推荐更优模型、压缩成本，并训练出你专属的路由器或模型。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Python 实现的网关服务，含首次运行设置向导、身份与预算控制、用量仪表盘，以及面向 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等编码 Agent 的 SETUP.md 接入提示。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主，提供 OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic Messages 接口，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Azure、Bedrock、Fireworks、OpenRouter 等多家供应商密钥。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4288 星、总数 4647，几乎全部热度来自最近一个月，说明「零加价 + 自带密钥 + 可训练专属模型」的定位精准击中了团队对 LLM 成本与治理的痛点。

en.tag: Open-source zero-markup LLM gateway routing BYOK and 1000+ models
en.what: Experiential is an open-source gateway and router for agent workflows that unifies hosted, BYOK, and local models behind one OpenAI-compatible API. It also learns from your production traffic to cut costs, recommend better models, and train a specialized router or model you own.
en.content: The repo centers on a Python gateway service with a first-run setup wizard, identity and budget controls, a usage dashboard, and SETUP.md prompts for wiring in coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
en.stack: Primarily Python, exposing OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages APIs, with support for provider keys from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure, Bedrock, Fireworks, and OpenRouter.
en.hot: It gained 4,288 of its 4,647 stars this month, meaning nearly all traction is recent — its zero-markup, BYOK, train-your-own-model pitch clearly hits teams' LLM cost and governance pain points.
uses: Engineering teams needing unified key and budget management across LLM providers
AI platform teams wanting to train custom routers or models from their own traffic
Developers pointing coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor at a self-hosted gateway
Tech leads focused on LLM cost optimization and usage observability

zh.tag: 全栈 AI 红队平台，守护 AI 生态安全
zh.what: AI-Infra-Guard 是一个全栈 AI 红队平台，用于扫描和评估 AI 生态系统的安全性。它支持 Agent 扫描、技能扫描、MCP 扫描、AI 基础设施扫描以及 LLM 越狱评估，帮助发现潜在漏洞。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台代码，包括扫描器、评估模块、文档和 Docker 镜像。提供多语言 README（中文、日文、西班牙文等），并集成了 ClawHub 和 OpenClaw 等工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，支持 Docker 部署，并可能涉及 LLM 评估框架和云原生技术。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 安全日益重要，该平台提供了全面的红队测试方案，本月新增近 1800 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，反映了社区对 AI 安全工具的高需求。
uses: 安全研究人员：用于评估 AI 系统的安全性，发现潜在漏洞。
AI 开发者：在开发过程中集成安全测试，确保 AI 应用合规。
企业安全团队：部署平台以监控和保护 AI 基础设施。

en.tag: Full-stack AI Red Teaming platform securing AI ecosystems
en.what: AI-Infra-Guard is a full-stack AI red teaming platform that scans and evaluates the security of AI ecosystems. It supports agent scanning, skills scanning, MCP scanning, AI infrastructure scanning, and LLM jailbreak evaluation to uncover potential vulnerabilities.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform code, including scanners, evaluation modules, documentation, and Docker images. It offers multi-language READMEs (Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, etc.) and integrates with tools like ClawHub and OpenClaw.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, supports Docker deployment, and may involve LLM evaluation frameworks and cloud-native technologies.
en.hot: As AI security becomes increasingly critical, this platform offers comprehensive red teaming solutions. With nearly 1,800 stars added this month and trending on GitHub, it reflects the community's high demand for AI security tools.
uses: Security researchers: to evaluate the security of AI systems and uncover vulnerabilities.
AI developers: to integrate security testing during development and ensure compliance.
Enterprise security teams: to deploy the platform for monitoring and protecting AI infrastructure.

zh.tag: 面向 Claude Code 的 GEO 优先 SEO 技能，让网站被 AI 搜索引用
zh.what: 这是一个为 Claude Code 打造的 SEO 技能包，主打 GEO（生成式引擎优化），帮助网站被 ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity、Gemini 和 Google AI Overviews 等 AI 搜索引用。它在传统 SEO 基础上增加了可引用性评分、AI 爬虫分析、品牌权威度、Schema 标记和 PDF 报告等能力。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 实现，包含安装脚本（install.sh / install-win.sh）、Claude Code 技能与 agent 定义文件，以及 /geo audit、/geo quick、/geo citability、/geo crawlers、/geo llmstxt 等命令模块。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.8+，依赖 Claude Code CLI 与 Git，可选 uv 加速依赖安装、Playwright 用于截图；依赖装在 ~/.claude/skills/geo/.venv/ 独立虚拟环境中。
zh.hot: AI 搜索正在蚕食传统搜索流量，GEO 服务市场被看好，而只有 23% 的营销者布局 GEO，这个工具正好切中空白；本月新增 1297 star，总 star 达 10626，冲上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Python 第 18 名。
uses: SEO/内容营销人员，想为网站争取 AI 搜索引用流量
独立开发者与站长，希望低成本做 GEO 优化和审计
数字营销代理商，为客户提供 AI 搜索可见性报告
想学习 GEO 方法论并落地到真实业务的技术从业者

en.tag: GEO-first SEO skill for Claude Code that makes websites citable by AI search engines
en.what: A Claude Code skill focused on GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) that helps websites get cited by AI search engines like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews. Beyond classic SEO, it adds citability scoring, AI crawler analysis, brand authority, schema markup and PDF reports.
en.content: Implemented in Python, it ships install scripts (install.sh / install-win.sh), Claude Code skill and agent definition files, plus command modules such as /geo audit, /geo quick, /geo citability, /geo crawlers and /geo llmstxt.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.8+, requiring the Claude Code CLI and Git, with optional uv for faster installs and Playwright for screenshots; dependencies live in an isolated venv at ~/.claude/skills/geo/.venv/.
en.hot: AI search is eating traditional search traffic, the GEO services market is projected to boom, yet only 23% of marketers invest in GEO — this tool hits that gap. It gained 1,297 stars this month for a total of 10,626, ranking #18 on GitHub Trending's monthly Python list.
uses: SEO and content marketers who want AI search citation traffic for their sites
Indie developers and site owners seeking low-cost GEO audits and optimization
Digital marketing agencies delivering AI search visibility reports to clients
Technical practitioners who want to learn and apply GEO methodology to real business

zh.tag: macOS 菜单栏原生 LLM 推理服务器，支持连续批处理与 SSD 缓存
zh.what: oMLX 是一个专为 Apple Silicon 优化的 LLM 推理服务器，提供连续批处理和分层 KV 缓存，将热数据保存在内存、冷数据存储在 SSD，并支持跨请求复用缓存。用户可通过 macOS 菜单栏直接管理模型、切换上下文长度，并监控性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 macOS 应用（.dmg 安装包）、Homebrew 安装支持、CLI 工具（~/.omlx/bin/omlx）以及可选的 MCP 支持。还提供多语言 README（中/英/韩/日）和基准测试页面。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.11-3.13，针对 Apple Silicon 优化，可能包含自定义内核（如 GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3）。支持 Homebrew 安装，可选安装 MCP 依赖。
zh.hot: 针对 Mac 用户痛点：在便利性和控制力之间取得平衡，通过菜单栏管理 LLM 服务器，并利用 SSD 缓存实现长上下文复用，适合本地 AI 开发。Star 数近 1.9 万，今日新增 78，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 8 名。
uses: Mac 用户希望在本地运行 LLM，并通过菜单栏轻松管理模型和上下文
开发者使用 Claude Code 等工具进行真实编码，需要跨请求缓存以提升效率
需要灵活控制内存和 SSD 缓存、自动切换模型的高级用户
通过 Homebrew 或 CLI 集成到自动化工作流（如 Apple Shortcuts）

en.tag: Native macOS menu bar LLM inference server with continuous batching & SSD caching
en.what: oMLX is an LLM inference server optimized for Apple Silicon, featuring continuous batching and tiered KV caching that persists hot data in memory and cold data on SSD, enabling cache reuse across requests. Users can manage models, switch context lengths, and monitor performance directly from the macOS menu bar.
en.content: The repository includes a full macOS app (.dmg installer), Homebrew installation support, a CLI shim (~/.omlx/bin/omlx), and optional MCP support. It also provides multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/KO/JA) and a benchmarks page.
en.stack: Primarily Python 3.11-3.13, optimized for Apple Silicon, possibly with custom kernels (e.g., GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3). Supports Homebrew installation, with optional MCP dependencies.
en.hot: Addresses Mac users' pain point: balancing convenience and control by managing LLM servers from the menu bar, with SSD caching for long-context reuse, ideal for local AI development. With ~19k stars and +78 today, it ranks #8 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Mac users who want to run LLMs locally and manage models/context from the menu bar
Developers using tools like Claude Code for real coding, needing cross-request caching for efficiency
Power users who need flexible control over memory/SSD caching and auto-swapping models
Those integrating with automation workflows via Homebrew or CLI (e.g., Apple Shortcuts)

zh.tag: 523 节课、20 阶段的 AI 工程从零到上线开源课程
zh.what: 这是一套系统性的 AI 工程学习课程，覆盖从基础原理到实际部署的完整链路，强调「学它、造它、交付它」。每节课都产出一个可复用产物，如提示词、技能、智能体或 MCP 服务器。
zh.content: 仓库包含 523 节课、20 个阶段、约 342 小时内容，配有网站、路线图、多语言 README 与 i18n 翻译分支，以及 assets 中的横幅等资源。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，课程同时覆盖 TypeScript、Rust 和 Julia，采用 MIT 许可证，配套静态网站与构建脚本。
zh.hot: 凭借 53694 颗星、今日新增 343 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 11 名，它切中了「84% 学生用 AI 但仅 18% 自认能专业使用」的痛点。

需要把 AI 能力落地到产品的开发者，直接复用课程产出的提示词与智能体
团队技术负责人，用课程作为内部培训与工程规范参考
希望用多语言材料教学的教师，可借助 i18n 分支与翻译页面

en.tag: A 523-lesson, 20-phase open-source curriculum for AI engineering from scratch
en.what: A systematic AI engineering curriculum covering the full path from fundamentals to deployment, built around the motto 'Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.' Every lesson ships a reusable artifact such as a prompt, skill, agent, or MCP server.
en.content: The repo holds 523 lessons across 20 phases (~342 hours), plus a website, roadmap, multilingual READMEs, an i18n translations branch, and assets like the banner.
en.stack: Primarily Python, with lessons also covering TypeScript, Rust, and Julia; MIT-licensed with a companion static site and build scripts.
en.hot: With 53,694 stars, +343 today, and #11 on GitHub Trending daily, it hits the gap that '84% of students use AI tools but only 18% feel prepared to use them professionally.'
uses: Students and career switchers wanting a structured, phase-by-phase intro to AI engineering
Developers shipping AI features who can reuse the prompts, skills, and agents each lesson produces
Tech leads using it as an internal training and engineering-standards reference
Instructors teaching in multiple languages via the i18n branch and translated pages

zh.tag: 一键生成高清短视频的AI自动化工具
zh.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一个一站式 AI 短视频生成工具，用户只需提供主题或关键词，它就能自动完成脚本撰写、素材匹配、字幕生成、背景音乐合成，最终输出高清短视频。它支持 WebUI 和 API 两种交互方式，适合快速批量制作视频内容。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 项目源码，提供 WebUI 图形界面和 API 服务，内置视频生成工作流，支持多种素材源和 AI 模型接入，并附带详细的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，依赖 AI 大模型（如 Kimi K3）进行文案生成，使用自动化工作流处理素材下载、字幕生成和视频合成，支持跨平台运行（Windows/macOS/Linux）。
zh.hot: 凭借 12 万+ Star 和月增近 2 万的热度，它精准切中短视频创作者对高效内容生产的需求，将复杂的视频制作流程简化为一次点击，极大降低了创作门槛。
uses: 短视频创作者：快速将热点话题或关键词转化为成片，提升内容产出效率。
自媒体运营者：批量生成不同主题的视频，用于多平台分发和测试。
营销人员：制作产品宣传或广告短视频，无需专业视频编辑技能。
开发者：通过 API 集成到自己的应用或流程中，实现自动化视频生成。

en.tag: One-click AI tool to auto-generate HD short videos
en.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an all-in-one AI short video generator. Users only need to provide a topic or keyword, and it automatically handles script writing, footage matching, subtitle generation, background music synthesis, and outputs HD short videos. It offers both WebUI and API interfaces, enabling rapid batch video production.
en.content: The repository contains complete Python source code, offering a WebUI and API service with a built-in video generation workflow. It supports multiple footage sources and AI model integrations, along with detailed documentation and examples.
en.stack: Built with Python 3.11+, leveraging AI LLMs (e.g., Kimi K3) for script generation, and using automated workflows for footage downloading, subtitle creation, and video composition. Cross-platform support for Windows/macOS/Linux.
en.hot: With over 120K stars and nearly 20K monthly additions, it addresses the high demand for efficient short-video creation, simplifying complex production into one click and drastically lowering the barrier for creators.
uses: Short-video creators: Quickly turn trending topics or keywords into finished videos to boost productivity.
Social media managers: Batch-generate videos on various themes for multi-platform distribution and testing.
Marketers: Create promotional or ad videos without professional editing skills.
Developers: Integrate the API into custom applications or workflows for automated video generation.

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。

uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 开源 AI 研究代理，命令行驱动深度调研
zh.what: Feynman 是一个开源的 AI 研究代理，通过命令行界面帮助用户进行深度研究。它能够自主规划研究步骤、收集信息并生成结构化报告，支持多种本地和云端模型提供商。

开发者与技术人员：通过命令行集成到工作流中，快速获取技术文档和代码库信息。
隐私敏感用户：使用本地模型（如 Ollama）进行离线研究，避免数据上传云端。

en.tag: Open-source AI research agent with a CLI-driven deep research workflow

en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, packaged as a standalone native bundle with its own Node.js runtime, also available via npm. Dependencies include Node.js and various AI model APIs (OpenAI-compatible, OpenRouter, etc.).
en.hot: Gained 292 stars this week, reaching 9,042 total, and appeared on the GitHub Trending list. Its positioning as an open-source AI research agent attracts users interested in automated research tools, and local model support addresses privacy concerns.
uses: Researchers and academics: Use the AI agent to automatically gather literature and organize materials, accelerating literature reviews.
Developers and technical professionals: Integrate into workflows via CLI to quickly obtain technical documentation and codebase information.
Privacy-conscious users: Leverage local models (e.g., Ollama) for offline research, avoiding data upload to the cloud.

zh.tag: 自托管个人图书馆与阅读平台
zh.what: BookOrbit 是一个自托管的图书馆和阅读平台，支持电子书、PDF、有声书和漫画。它提供网页阅读器、Kobo 和 KOReader 支持，并同步阅读进度、高亮和状态。

en.content: The repo ships the full front-end source (operation modules and UI under src), Node.js build scripts, a Dockerfile, GitHub Actions release workflows, an npm package and the official hosted site.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, bundled with Webpack and built on Node.js v24; deployable via Docker, with core crypto/encoding logic leaning on libraries like crypto-js.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source security tool from GCHQ, it has reached 35,839 stars with 290 added this month, ranking 20th on the JavaScript monthly trending list—proof of steady demand in security analysis and CTF work.
uses: Security analysts and pentesters: quickly decode, decrypt and inspect suspicious data
CTF players and reverse engineers: chain operations to reverse encoding/encryption pipelines
Data engineers and ops: parse IPv6, X.509 certificates and binary/hex dumps
Teaching and training: demonstrate encoding and crypto concepts with zero install

zh.tag: 基于 GPUI 的 Rust 跨平台桌面 UI 组件库
zh.what: GPUI Kit 是一个用于构建高性能跨平台桌面应用的 Rust 框架，提供 60+ 生产级 UI 组件和完整的数据、布局、编辑能力。它基于 Zed 编辑器使用的 GPUI 构建，并支持 JavaScript 扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个子 crate：gpui-base（无样式行为、状态和基础设施）、gpui-shell（JavaScript 扩展）、gpui-component（完整样式化 UI 系统）。主 crate 重新导出所有层，应用只需依赖 gpui-kit 即可。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 GPUI（Zed 编辑器使用的 GPU 加速 UI 框架），支持 macOS、Windows、Linux，集成 Tree-sitter、LSP 等。
zh.hot: 凭借 13.9K stars 和日增 179 登顶 Rust 日榜，因为它是首个将 GPUI 从 Zed 中解耦并打包成通用组件库的项目，填补了 Rust 桌面 UI 生态的空白。
uses: Rust 开发者希望用 Rust 构建跨平台桌面应用，并追求高性能和原生体验。
需要数据表格、虚拟列表、代码编辑器等复杂组件的桌面应用开发场景。
希望复用 Zed 编辑器 UI 能力但不想直接依赖 Zed 的团队。
对 GPUI 感兴趣，想学习其架构或基于 gpui-base 自定义 UI 系统的开发者。

en.tag: Rust desktop UI component library built on GPUI for cross-platform apps
en.what: GPUI Kit is a Rust framework for building high-performance cross-platform desktop apps, offering 60+ production-ready UI components and full data, layout, and editing capabilities. It is built on GPUI, the UI framework used by Zed editor, and supports JavaScript extensions.
en.content: The repo contains three sub-crates: gpui-base (unstyled behavior, state, and infrastructure), gpui-shell (JavaScript extensions), and gpui-component (complete styled UI system). The main crate re-exports all layers, so apps only need to depend on gpui-kit.
en.stack: Built on Rust and GPUI (GPU-accelerated UI framework used by Zed editor), supports macOS, Windows, Linux, integrates Tree-sitter, LSP, etc.
en.hot: With 13.9K stars and +179 today, it tops the Rust daily chart as the first project to decouple GPUI from Zed and package it as a general-purpose component library, filling a gap in the Rust desktop UI ecosystem.
uses: Rust developers who want to build cross-platform desktop apps with high performance and native feel.
Desktop app development requiring complex components like data tables, virtual lists, and code editors.
Teams that want to reuse Zed's UI capabilities without depending on Zed directly.
Developers interested in GPUI, learning its architecture, or building custom UI systems on gpui-base.

zh.tag: 为 LLM 应用按成本与能力智能路由模型，兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 原生 API
zh.what: Switchyard 为每次 LLM 调用挑选最便宜但仍能完成任务的模型，从而在保持准确率的同时降低总成本。它不改变你的 agent 代码，而是作为路由层插入现有网关或独立代理中。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心库 switchyard-libsy、LLM 客户端 switchyard-llm-client、独立代理服务器 switchyard-server，以及 NeMo Relay 插件和 LiteLLM 集成示例。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为主，提供 Python 包 nemo-switchyard 和 Rust crate switchyard-libsy，可嵌入 LiteLLM、NeMo Relay 或自建网关。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1493 stars，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 7 名，反映出开发者对 LLM 成本优化与多模型路由的强烈需求。
uses: 正在构建 LLM agent 或应用的开发者，希望在不改代码的情况下降低推理成本
需要跨多个模型提供商做基准测试和性能/成本权衡的团队
已有 LiteLLM 或 NeMo Relay 网关、想加入智能路由能力的平台工程师
想用 Claude Code、Codex CLI 等工具但希望按轮次自动选择模型的高级用户

en.tag: Route LLM calls across models and providers while keeping native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility
en.what: Switchyard picks the cheapest model that can still do the job for each LLM call, cutting total cost while preserving accuracy. It requires no changes to your agent code, acting as a routing layer inside existing gateways or as a standalone proxy.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core library switchyard-libsy, an LLM client switchyard-llm-client, a standalone proxy server switchyard-server, plus a NeMo Relay plugin and LiteLLM integration examples.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, with a Python package nemo-switchyard and Rust crate switchyard-libsy, embeddable into LiteLLM, NeMo Relay, or custom gateways.
en.hot: It gained 1,493 stars this month and ranked 7th on GitHub Trending's monthly Rust list, reflecting strong demand for LLM cost optimization and multi-model routing.
uses: Developers building LLM agents or apps who want to cut inference costs without changing code
Teams benchmarking across multiple model providers and balancing cost versus performance
Platform engineers with existing LiteLLM or NeMo Relay gateways who want to add smart routing
Power users of Claude Code, Codex CLI, or similar tools who want per-turn model selection

zh.tag: 为无服务器计算打造的安全高速 microVM 虚拟化技术
zh.what: Firecracker 是 AWS 开源的轻量级虚拟化技术，用 microVM 运行容器与函数工作负载。它把硬件虚拟化的安全隔离性与容器的速度、灵活性结合起来，专为多租户无服务器场景设计。
zh.content: 核心是一个基于 Linux KVM 的虚拟机监控器（VMM），采用极简设计，剔除多余设备与 guest 功能以缩小内存占用和攻击面；仓库还包含构建工具链、快速入门与生产主机配置文档。
zh.stack: 主要用 Rust 编写，依赖 Linux KVM 与 Unix/Linux 主机环境，可通过 Docker 开发容器和 bash 脚本构建。
zh.hot: 作为 AWS Lambda 与 Fargate 的底层虚拟化引擎，Firecracker 是云原生安全隔离的事实标准之一，本月新增 707 star、总数达 36739，稳居 Rust 月榜第 12 名。
uses: 云平台与无服务器服务商：需要安全多租户隔离的容器/函数运行环境
容器运行时开发者：如 Kata Containers、Flintlock 等集成 microVM 隔离
基础设施与安全工程师：评估轻量虚拟化的启动速度、内存开销与攻击面
学习虚拟化与 KVM 的 Rust 开发者：研究生产级 VMM 实现

en.tag: Secure and fast microVMs for serverless computing
en.what: Firecracker is an open-source virtualization technology from AWS that runs container and function workloads inside lightweight microVMs. It combines the security and isolation of hardware virtualization with the speed and flexibility of containers, purpose-built for multi-tenant serverless services.
en.content: At its core is a minimalist KVM-based virtual machine monitor (VMM) that strips out unnecessary devices and guest-facing features to cut memory footprint and attack surface; the repo also ships a build toolchain, quickstart guide, and production host setup docs.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it relies on Linux KVM and a Unix/Linux host, and can be built via a Docker dev container and bash scripts.
en.hot: As the virtualization engine behind AWS Lambda and Fargate, Firecracker is a de facto standard for secure cloud-native isolation, gaining 707 stars this month for a total of 36,739 and ranking 12th on the monthly Rust trending list.
uses: Cloud and serverless providers needing secure multi-tenant isolation for containers and functions
Container runtime developers integrating microVM isolation, such as Kata Containers and Flintlock
Infrastructure and security engineers evaluating lightweight virtualization for boot speed, memory overhead, and attack surface
Rust developers learning virtualization and KVM by studying a production-grade VMM

zh.tag: 友好且类型安全的可扩展系统编程语言
zh.what: Gleam 是一门静态类型编程语言，旨在构建类型安全且可扩展的系统。它编译到 Erlang 和 JavaScript，让开发者能利用 BEAM 虚拟机的并发与容错能力，或在前端/Node.js 环境中运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Gleam 编译器的 Rust 源代码、标准库、构建工具以及文档和示例。主要目录有 compiler-core（编译器核心）、compiler-cli（命令行工具）和 test 等。
zh.stack: Gleam 编译器使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Rust 生态的库如 serde、clap 等。运行时目标为 Erlang/OTP 和 JavaScript，因此需要相应的运行时环境。
zh.hot: Gleam 因其友好的错误信息、强大的类型系统和多目标编译能力而受到关注，本月新增 194 颗星，总星数达 21894，在 GitHub Trending 月榜（Rust）中排名第 15。
uses: 希望构建高并发、容错后端系统的开发者，可利用 Erlang 生态。
需要类型安全且能编译到 JavaScript 的前端或全栈开发者。
对函数式编程和静态类型语言感兴趣的学习者与研究者。
寻求替代 TypeScript 或 Elixir 等语言的团队，用于构建可扩展应用。

en.tag: A friendly language for building type-safe, scalable systems
en.what: Gleam is a statically typed programming language designed for building type-safe and scalable systems. It compiles to Erlang and JavaScript, allowing developers to leverage the concurrency and fault-tolerance of the BEAM virtual machine or run in frontend/Node.js environments.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust source code for the Gleam compiler, standard library, build tool, and documentation/examples. Key directories include compiler-core (compiler core), compiler-cli (CLI tool), and test.
en.stack: The Gleam compiler is written in Rust, depending on Rust ecosystem crates like serde and clap. Runtime targets are Erlang/OTP and JavaScript, requiring corresponding runtime environments.
en.hot: Gleam gains attention for its friendly error messages, powerful type system, and multi-target compilation. It added 194 stars this month, reaching 21,894 total stars, ranking 15th on GitHub Trending monthly (Rust).
uses: Developers building highly concurrent, fault-tolerant backend systems leveraging the Erlang ecosystem.
Frontend or full-stack developers needing type safety with JavaScript compilation.
Learners and researchers interested in functional programming and statically typed languages.
Teams seeking alternatives to TypeScript or Elixir for building scalable applications.

zh.tag: 本地优先的跨平台个人 AI 超级智能体
zh.what: OpenHuman 是一款面向 Mac、Windows 和 Linux 的开源个人 AI，强调本地优先的记忆能力、智能体编排与深度研究。它把「记住一切的大脑」、编排器和研究员三合一，让个人数据留在本地。
zh.content: 仓库以 Rust 实现核心，包含 GitBook 文档目录（gitbooks/）与演示截图，并配有 Discord、Reddit、X 等社区入口。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，提供跨平台桌面应用；文档基于 GitBook，社区与分发依托 GitHub Discussions、Discord 与 Product Hunt。
zh.hot: 上线即获 Product Hunt 日榜/周榜 Top Post，GitHub 星标已达 39586，本月新增 3715，位列 Rust 月榜第 20 名，本地优先隐私叙事正好踩中当下热点。
uses: 希望把个人 AI 助手跑在本地、数据不出设备的隐私敏感用户
需要长期记忆与深度研究能力的知识工作者和研究者
想用 Rust 构建或扩展桌面 AI 智能体的开发者

en.tag: A local-first personal AI superintelligence for Mac, Windows and Linux
en.what: OpenHuman is an open source personal AI for Mac, Windows and Linux, built around local-first memory, agent orchestration and deep research. It combines a brain that remembers everything, an orchestrator and a deep researcher into one local-first assistant.
en.content: The repo ships a Rust core, a GitBook docs directory (gitbooks/) with demo screenshots, plus community links to Discord, Reddit and X.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust as a cross-platform desktop app; docs are built with GitBook, with community and distribution via GitHub Discussions, Discord and Product Hunt.
en.hot: It landed Product Hunt daily and weekly top-post badges, and has reached 39,586 stars with 3,715 added this month, ranking 20th on the Rust monthly trending list — its local-first privacy pitch rides today's wave.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want a personal AI assistant running locally with data kept on-device
Knowledge workers and researchers needing long-term memory and deep research capabilities
Developers who want to build or extend a desktop AI agent in Rust

zh.tag: 快速、节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器
zh.what: pnpm 是一个快速且节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器，通过内容寻址存储来链接文件，避免重复下载。它支持 monorepo，提供严格的依赖访问控制，并具有确定性的锁文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 pnpm 的完整源代码、文档、基准测试脚本，以及一个用 Rust 编写的实验性 CLI 移植版本（pacquet）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/TypeScript 编写，并包含 Rust 组件（pacquet）。依赖 Node.js 生态，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。
zh.hot: pnpm 因其卓越的性能和磁盘效率而广受欢迎，在 GitHub 上拥有 36,310 颗星，并持续获得关注。其 Rust 移植版本也吸引了开发者的兴趣。
uses: 适用于大型 monorepo 项目，可显著减少依赖安装时间和磁盘占用。
适合对包管理性能有严格要求的开发团队，尤其是 CI/CD 环境。
适合希望使用严格依赖隔离和确定性锁文件的 Node.js 开发者。

en.tag: Fast, disk space efficient package manager for Node.js
en.what: pnpm is a fast and disk space efficient package manager for Node.js. It links files from a single content-addressable storage to avoid duplication, supports monorepos, enforces strict dependency access, and provides deterministic lockfiles.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, benchmark scripts, and an experimental Rust port of the CLI called pacquet.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript/TypeScript with a Rust component (pacquet). Depends on Node.js ecosystem, supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: pnpm is popular for its superior performance and disk efficiency, with 36,310 stars on GitHub and ongoing attention. Its Rust port also attracts developers.
uses: Ideal for large monorepo projects, significantly reducing install time and disk usage.
Suitable for teams with strict performance requirements, especially in CI/CD environments.
Great for Node.js developers who want strict dependency isolation and deterministic lockfiles.

zh.tag: 终端里的轻量 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的本地运行编码代理，能在终端中直接执行代码任务。它支持与 ChatGPT 计划集成，也可通过 API 密钥使用，提供命令行交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、二进制发布包及文档，支持 npm、Homebrew 等安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 OpenAI API 或 ChatGPT 认证，支持跨平台（macOS、Linux、Windows）。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方开源项目，今日新增 2729 星，总星数突破 11 万，登顶 GitHub 日榜，开发者期待在终端中直接使用 AI 编程。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中快速执行 AI 辅助编码任务，无需离开命令行环境。
使用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 等计划的用户，可无缝集成现有订阅进行编程。
需要轻量级、可脚本化的代码生成与修改工具的技术团队。

en.tag: Lightweight AI coding agent that runs in your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. It executes coding tasks directly in the terminal, integrates with ChatGPT plans, and can also be used with an API key.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based CLI tool, installation scripts, binary release assets, and documentation, with support for npm and Homebrew installation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, it relies on OpenAI API or ChatGPT authentication, and supports cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows).
en.hot: As an official OpenAI open-source project, it gained 2,729 stars today, surpassing 110k total stars and topping the daily GitHub trending list. Developers are eager to use AI coding directly in the terminal.
uses: Developers who want to perform AI-assisted coding tasks quickly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Users with ChatGPT Plus/Pro plans who can seamlessly integrate their existing subscription for coding.
Tech teams needing a lightweight, scriptable tool for code generation and modification.

zh.tag: 跨 50+ 编程工具的 AI 技能统一管理桌面应用
zh.what: Skills Manager 是一个轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、同步和组织 AI 代理的技能（skills），支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini CLI 等 50 多种编程工具。它提供一个集中的技能库，用户可以从 Git 仓库、本地文件夹、压缩包或 skills.sh 市场安装技能，并支持全局、代理、项目等多种工作区。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的桌面应用源码，提供技能库、市场浏览、全局/代理/项目工作区、备份与多设备同步等功能，并配有界面截图和概念图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 开发，可能涉及 Tauri 或类似框架，依赖 Git 和文件系统操作，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 本周新增 228 星，总星数达 4283，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Rust）第 13 名。AI 编程工具激增，跨工具管理技能的需求旺盛，该应用填补了这一空白。
uses: AI 编程工具用户：统一管理 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具的技能，避免重复配置。
开发者团队：通过备份与多设备同步，确保团队成员技能配置一致。
技能开发者：在市场中发布技能，并利用工作区测试和部署。

en.tag: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools
en.what: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and Gemini CLI. It provides a unified skill library, allowing users to install skills from Git repos, local folders, archives, or the skills.sh marketplace, with support for global, agent, and project workspaces.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-based desktop app source code, featuring a unified skill library, marketplace browsing, global/agent/project workspaces, backup and multi-device sync, along with UI screenshots and a concept map.
en.stack: Built primarily with Rust, likely using Tauri or similar framework, with dependencies on Git and file system operations, supporting cross-platform.
en.hot: Gained 228 stars this week, reaching 4,283 total, and ranked #13 on GitHub Trending (Rust) weekly. With the proliferation of AI coding tools, the need to manage skills across tools is high, and this app fills that gap.
uses: AI coding tool users: centrally manage skills for Claude Code, Cursor, etc., avoiding duplicate configurations.
Development teams: ensure consistent skill configurations across members via backup and multi-device sync.
Skill developers: publish skills to the marketplace and use workspaces for testing and deployment.

zh.tag: 更聪明的 cd 命令，记住常用目录实现秒级跳转
zh.what: zoxide 是一个受 z 和 autojump 启发的智能目录跳转工具，它会记录你访问最频繁的目录，让你用几个按键就能跳转过去。它同时兼容 cd 的常规用法，并支持所有主流 shell。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心二进制、各 shell 的初始化脚本与补全、安装文档、配置说明以及第三方集成示例，并配有演示动图。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，通过 crates.io 分发，支持 Nix 构建，并依赖 fzf 实现交互式选择。
zh.hot: 作为经典效率工具，zoxide 已积累 39,323 颗星，今日再增 57 星并登上 Rust 日榜第 18 名，说明终端用户对快速导航的需求持续旺盛。
uses: 经常在终端中切换目录的开发者与运维人员，可大幅减少 cd 输入
使用 bash、zsh、fish 等主流 shell 并希望提升命令行效率的用户
喜欢 fzf 交互式选择、追求个性化终端工作流的高级用户

en.tag: A smarter cd command that remembers your most-used directories for instant jumps
en.what: zoxide is a smarter cd command inspired by z and autojump. It remembers which directories you use most frequently so you can jump to them in just a few keystrokes, while still working like a regular cd command across all major shells.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core binary, shell init scripts and completions, installation and configuration docs, third-party integration examples, plus a demo GIF.
en.stack: Written in Rust, distributed via crates.io, built with Nix support, and relies on fzf for interactive selection.
en.hot: As a classic productivity tool, zoxide has reached 39,323 stars, gaining 57 more today and ranking 18th on the Rust daily trending list, showing sustained demand for fast terminal navigation.
uses: Developers and sysadmins who frequently switch directories in the terminal and want to cut down on cd typing
Users of bash, zsh, fish and other major shells looking to boost command-line efficiency
Power users who enjoy fzf interactive selection and a personalized terminal workflow

zh.tag: Rust 原生高性能量化交易平台
zh.what: NautilusTrader 是一个基于 Rust 的高性能量化交易平台，采用确定性事件驱动架构，专为生产环境设计。它提供低延迟、高吞吐量的交易执行和回测能力，同时支持 Python 接口，便于策略开发和集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心交易引擎、回测模块、市场数据适配器、策略框架以及多种交易所连接器。代码主要用 Rust 编写，同时提供 Python 绑定，包含完整的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，支持 Python 3.12-3.14，兼容 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。依赖包括 PyO3 用于 Python 绑定，以及 Arrow 等用于数据处理。
zh.hot: 凭借 25.9k 星标和今日新增 120 星，NautilusTrader 因其生产级 Rust 性能、确定性架构和活跃社区而备受关注，成为量化交易领域的热门选择。
uses: 量化交易员和算法工程师：用于构建低延迟交易策略和执行系统。
金融科技公司：作为交易基础设施的核心组件，支持回测和实盘交易。
研究人员：利用其高性能回测引擎进行策略研究和数据分析。
开发者：通过 Python API 快速原型设计，或使用 Rust 进行深度定制。

en.tag: Production-grade Rust-native algorithmic trading platform
en.what: NautilusTrader is a high-performance algorithmic trading platform built in Rust with a deterministic event-driven architecture, designed for production use. It offers low-latency, high-throughput execution and backtesting capabilities, with a Python API for strategy development and integration.
en.content: The repository contains the core trading engine, backtesting module, market data adapters, strategy framework, and various exchange connectors. The code is primarily in Rust with Python bindings, including comprehensive documentation and examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Python bindings for 3.12-3.14, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows. Dependencies include PyO3 for Python bindings and Arrow for data handling.
en.hot: With 25.9k stars and 120 new stars today, NautilusTrader gains attention for its production-grade Rust performance, deterministic architecture, and active community, making it a popular choice in algorithmic trading.
uses: Quant traders and algo engineers: for building low-latency trading strategies and execution systems.
Fintech companies: as a core component of trading infrastructure for backtesting and live trading.
Researchers: leveraging its high-performance backtesting engine for strategy research and data analysis.

en.what: FileBrowser Quantum is a self-hosted web-based file manager that allows users to easily access and manage files through a browser. It offers a modern responsive interface with advanced features for user management, access control, sharing, file preview, and editing.
en.content: The repository contains a full-featured file browser application with multi-source configuration, multiple login methods (OIDC, LDAP, JWT), real-time search, and thumbnails for office, video, album art, and 3D models. It includes a config.yaml file and Docker images.
